aldra/aldra_my_name_is_36103aad.speaker: aldra
aldra/aldra_my_name_is_36103aad.text: Aldra. My name is Aldra. And I will remember.

aldra/and_a_girl_with_18b6e458.speaker: aldra
aldra/and_a_girl_with_18b6e458.text: And a girl with a fire took it in an afternoon.

aldra/bettors_gold_it_spends_eeb13d98.speaker: aldra
aldra/bettors_gold_it_spends_eeb13d98.text: Bettors' gold. It spends the same as honest gold, which is the whole trouble with gold.

aldra/both_flanks_they_want_b3c08ec6.speaker: aldra
aldra/both_flanks_they_want_b3c08ec6.text: Both flanks! They want the children. Hold the stair!

aldra/coin_remembers_where_it_1225aa16.speaker: aldra
aldra/coin_remembers_where_it_1225aa16.text: Coin remembers where it was taken.

aldra/cracked_not_broken_ill_0e0569e2.speaker: aldra
aldra/cracked_not_broken_ill_0e0569e2.text: Cracked. Not broken. I'll be back before your seedlings are.

aldra/cracked_not_broken_torvald_c73e5da.speaker: aldra
aldra/cracked_not_broken_torvald_c73e5da.text: Cracked. Not broken. Torvald will hear of this.

aldra/crimson_lanterns_on_the_9290f15f.speaker: aldra
aldra/crimson_lanterns_on_the_9290f15f.text: Crimson lanterns on the water. Aurivane burns what it cannot buy.

aldra/crimson_sails_on_the_57646211.speaker: aldra
aldra/crimson_sails_on_the_57646211.text: Crimson sails on the water. They will shell the shore road. Sink them, or stay off it.

aldra/diamond_tithe_every_minute_064b69e.speaker: aldra
aldra/diamond_tithe_every_minute_064b69e.text: Diamond tithe. Every minute you stand there, my lord, the Archon pays. Every minute.

aldra/enough_green_this_wood_05da5390.speaker: aldra
aldra/enough_green_this_wood_05da5390.text: Enough green. This wood is ours by treaty, and by winter.

aldra/every_one_carries_the_6d9cd212.speaker: aldra
aldra/every_one_carries_the_6d9cd212.text: Every one carries the anchor. The Outwall's stamp.

aldra/he_only_looked_at_665606c4.speaker: aldra
aldra/he_only_looked_at_665606c4.text: He only looked at the ridge. Then he went back.

aldra/his_gift_at_the_544fa59f.speaker: aldra
aldra/his_gift_at_the_544fa59f.text: His gift at the auction was their wages. Tonight he came back for the men.

aldra/his_leg_is_cracking_5a7fc7a1.speaker: aldra
aldra/his_leg_is_cracking_5a7fc7a1.text: His leg is cracking! The glass sees it. Again, there!

aldra/hold_the_rime_when_a0531061.speaker: aldra
aldra/hold_the_rime_when_a0531061.text: Hold the rime. When the green stops beating, the wood is ours.

aldra/it_didnt_glow_at_474b3a8d.speaker: aldra
aldra/it_didnt_glow_at_474b3a8d.text: It didn't glow at all. That frightens me more.

aldra/it_is_bait_they_7d1f9055.speaker: aldra
aldra/it_is_bait_they_7d1f9055.text: It is bait. They want the gate open. They want the mere.

aldra/malriks_riders_came_at_b201fc35.speaker: aldra
aldra/malriks_riders_came_at_b201fc35.text: Malrik's riders came at dusk. He wants the Wall raised before the snow.

aldra/men_in_grey_masks_4349dd55.speaker: aldra
aldra/men_in_grey_masks_4349dd55.text: Men in grey masks, out of the old adit. They do not take coin. They take people.

aldra/my_lord_the_bazaar_618f9d14.speaker: aldra
aldra/my_lord_the_bazaar_618f9d14.text: My lord, the Bazaar. A dragon serves whoever filled the hoard last. Pay them to fly away.

aldra/my_lord_the_ice_62c8e28f.speaker: aldra
aldra/my_lord_the_ice_62c8e28f.text: My lord? The ice is singing. Can you hear it?

aldra/one_red_sail_under_e33416b6.speaker: aldra
aldra/one_red_sail_under_e33416b6.text: One red sail under. The sea keeps the coin, as usual.

aldra/one_strike_torvald_and_0ed13b62.speaker: aldra
aldra/one_strike_torvald_and_0ed13b62.text: One strike, Torvald, and the green war is over. Let me finish it.

aldra/rime_on_the_ramp_42787a6c.speaker: aldra
aldra/rime_on_the_ramp_42787a6c.text: Rime on the ramp, Torvald. They will not climb it twice.

aldra/send_the_wagons_to_712bb79d.speaker: aldra
aldra/send_the_wagons_to_712bb79d.text: Send the wagons to the harbour. And watch the shoals. The sun's riders are faster than ice.

aldra/silver_sinks_the_same_c98b52b1.speaker: aldra
aldra/silver_sinks_the_same_c98b52b1.text: Silver sinks the same as crimson, my lord. Slower, perhaps. Heavier pride.

aldra/steel_and_quilting_adamarchs_9f92e.speaker: aldra
aldra/steel_and_quilting_adamarchs_9f92e.text: Steel and quilting. Adamarch's coin, wearing our colours.

aldra/the_bettors_fled_with_a50f5e38.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_bettors_fled_with_a50f5e38.text: The bettors fled with their strongboxes and dropped half of them. Coin always runs downhill.

aldra/the_bettors_ledger_someone_5fb96a0.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_bettors_ledger_someone_5fb96a0.text: The bettors' ledger. Someone wagered against both cities, on the same night, before the duel.

aldra/the_first_coin_is_e5fc0178.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_first_coin_is_e5fc0178.text: The first coin is home. It smells of fish and diamonds.

aldra/the_glass_hall_is_5a6cfa8f.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_glass_hall_is_5a6cfa8f.text: The Glass Hall is open, my lord. It holds more than you think. Winter is roomy.

aldra/the_green_has_stopped_ac1b55c9.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_green_has_stopped_ac1b55c9.text: The green has stopped. Winter keeps this wood now.

aldra/the_halls_lamps_are_8dfa45d7.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_halls_lamps_are_8dfa45d7.text: The Hall's lamps are still lit, my lord. Someone is signing something.

aldra/the_harbour_is_burning_1d000a93.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_harbour_is_burning_1d000a93.text: The harbour is burning, my lord. Adamarch does not forgive a guest who loses its harbour.

aldra/the_lanes_are_empty_6114c739.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_lanes_are_empty_6114c739.text: The lanes are empty, my lord. There is nobody left to shelter.

aldra/the_longhouse_my_mothers_736557fc.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_longhouse_my_mothers_736557fc.text: The longhouse... my mother's nets were in there.

aldra/the_old_storm_sword_95684d1b.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_old_storm_sword_95684d1b.text: The old storm-sword crossed the river twice today.

aldra/the_orb_is_warm_844e4ceb.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_orb_is_warm_844e4ceb.text: The orb is warm. It hasn't been warm in a hundred years.

aldra/the_rock_is_his_1eb87b35.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_rock_is_his_1eb87b35.text: The rock is his. The stone will drink the whole strait now.

aldra/the_west_water_is_b35bd29f.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_west_water_is_b35bd29f.text: The west water is glass. Their galleys are stuck fast.

aldra/their_captain_comes_himself_ae1e5d.speaker: aldra
aldra/their_captain_comes_himself_ae1e5d.text: Their captain comes himself. Break his mask, my lord. I want to see what is under it.

aldra/then_i_hold_the_ce9235ad.speaker: aldra
aldra/then_i_hold_the_ce9235ad.text: Then I hold the mere alone. Do not be long.

aldra/then_i_will_keep_485c9782.speaker: aldra
aldra/then_i_will_keep_485c9782.text: Then I will keep it right back.

aldra/then_keep_it_with_df1d581c.speaker: aldra
aldra/then_keep_it_with_df1d581c.text: Then keep it with gold, my lord. Winter is patient. Markets are not.

aldra/they_are_not_coming_21b05990.speaker: aldra
aldra/they_are_not_coming_21b05990.text: They are not coming for the lake. Why are they not coming for the lake?

aldra/theyre_planting_go_and_8c3d161d.speaker: aldra
aldra/theyre_planting_go_and_8c3d161d.text: They're planting. Go and put the frost back. Gently. Nothing here should grow strong.

aldra/this_is_my_home_baf39936.speaker: aldra
aldra/this_is_my_home_baf39936.text: This is my home. I'll stay, if it's all the same to you.

aldra/through_my_glass_already_f0cbd6ee.speaker: aldra
aldra/through_my_glass_already_f0cbd6ee.text: Through my glass already? Go, then. The mere remembers every footstep.

aldra/too_many_lost_the_b295f93e.speaker: aldra
aldra/too_many_lost_the_b295f93e.text: Too many lost. The road is closed to them now.

aldra/torvald_the_big_one_6c9caf8e.speaker: aldra
aldra/torvald_the_big_one_6c9caf8e.text: Torvald! The big one is at your gate!

aldra/torvald_the_heartfrost_hums_bf5d68.speaker: aldra
aldra/torvald_the_heartfrost_hums_bf5d68.text: Torvald. The Heartfrost hums when the stone-men are near. It is humming now.

aldra/torvald_theyre_at_the_cc134df7.speaker: aldra
aldra/torvald_theyre_at_the_cc134df7.text: Torvald, they're at the gate. Whatever you're waiting for, it's here.

aldra/two_hundred_i_counted_aff24325.speaker: aldra
aldra/two_hundred_i_counted_aff24325.text: Two hundred. I counted them twice. Ten towers of twenty.

aldra/wake_old_guards_somebody_6827e0a6.speaker: aldra
aldra/wake_old_guards_somebody_6827e0a6.text: Wake, old guards. Somebody is knocking.

aldra/we_dont_know_what_d0f0e649.speaker: aldra
aldra/we_dont_know_what_d0f0e649.text: We don't know what follows them. We could wait. Just until we see.

aldra/will_you_ask_him_319f64e6.speaker: aldra
aldra/will_you_ask_him_319f64e6.text: Will you ask him, my lord?

aldra/winter_goes_home_torvald_953915fe.speaker: aldra
aldra/winter_goes_home_torvald_953915fe.text: Winter goes home, Torvald. Let the Bishop dig his own grave.

aldra/you_broke_my_glass_23340c70.speaker: aldra
aldra/you_broke_my_glass_23340c70.text: You broke my glass once, Ysolde. Once was enough.

aldra/you_called_before_i_9bfc0d5b.speaker: aldra
aldra/you_called_before_i_9bfc0d5b.text: You called. Before I asked. Winter's changing.

aldra/you_never_do_anything_2995fb51.speaker: aldra
aldra/you_never_do_anything_2995fb51.text: You never do anything alone, my lord. You only think you do.

aldra/you_thawed_his_wood_f112f4d1.speaker: aldra
aldra/you_thawed_his_wood_f112f4d1.text: You thawed his wood, Ysolde. You will not thaw his wall.

aldra/your_captains_are_asking_0ae06fd3.speaker: aldra
aldra/your_captains_are_asking_0ae06fd3.text: Your captains are asking why we pulled back.

aldra/ysolde_torvald_asked_me_34c86af9.speaker: aldra
aldra/ysolde_torvald_asked_me_34c86af9.text: Ysolde. Torvald asked me to keep this wood quiet. I keep what I'm asked to keep.

ashby/a_masters_forge_my_ca56e44a.speaker: ashby
ashby/a_masters_forge_my_ca56e44a.text: A Master's forge! My grandad would weep. Then he'd charge you for it.

ashby/and_whatever_he_sends_d55de451.speaker: ashby
ashby/and_whatever_he_sends_d55de451.text: And whatever he sends in the night, my queen.

ashby/built_you_a_tower_51b9f1fe.speaker: ashby
ashby/built_you_a_tower_51b9f1fe.text: Built you a tower on the west road, my queen. Learned that at the Millwatch.

ashby/burns_its_own_house_141f3457.speaker: ashby
ashby/burns_its_own_house_141f3457.text: "...burns its own house." Yes, my lady. We've all heard him say it.

ashby/did_the_queen_just_81755b0b.speaker: ashby
ashby/did_the_queen_just_81755b0b.text: Did the queen just say "we do not run"? I'm putting that in the regiment book.

ashby/emberguard_boots_on_we_41d6a1ed.speaker: ashby
ashby/emberguard_boots_on_we_41d6a1ed.text: Emberguard! Boots on! We march at first light!

ashby/every_rider_home_the_d41aeaa7.speaker: ashby
ashby/every_rider_home_the_d41aeaa7.text: Every rider home! The queen waited! Somebody ring a bell!

ashby/first_batch_out_of_2ebdc632.speaker: ashby
ashby/first_batch_out_of_2ebdc632.text: First batch out of the old forge, my queen! Blades that remember the fire.

ashby/from_the_queen_my_9fb0c812.speaker: ashby
ashby/from_the_queen_my_9fb0c812.text: From the queen, my lady. She said you'd know what it is.

ashby/hurlers_now_were_talking_39e301d5.speaker: ashby
ashby/hurlers_now_were_talking_39e301d5.text: Hurlers! Now we're talking. They throw farther than those towers can shoot.

ashby/it_was_my_lady_b2f0ecaa.speaker: ashby
ashby/it_was_my_lady_b2f0ecaa.text: It was, my lady. It's toast now. Very good toast.

ashby/just_a_scratch_carry_57b15a10.speaker: ashby
ashby/just_a_scratch_carry_57b15a10.text: Just a scratch! Carry on, my lady, I'll catch you up!

ashby/my_queen_work_crews_2b047376.speaker: ashby
ashby/my_queen_work_crews_2b047376.text: My queen! Work crew's on the stair. Find us a hearth to build around!

ashby/nature_folk_at_the_a2422e7b.speaker: ashby
ashby/nature_folk_at_the_a2422e7b.text: Nature folk at the gate! Open up, lads. Blankets, bread, and no questions.

ashby/reeds_my_lady_lovely_1d880bcd.speaker: ashby
ashby/reeds_my_lady_lovely_1d880bcd.text: Reeds, my lady. Lovely place to hide a knife. Let the lads go in first.

ashby/rider_at_the_gate_f3c9142f.speaker: ashby
ashby/rider_at_the_gate_f3c9142f.text: Rider at the gate! Make way!

ashby/scouts_on_the_far_5f47d5fe.speaker: ashby
ashby/scouts_on_the_far_5f47d5fe.text: Scouts on the far bank, my queen! Pinned at the old wagon road!

ashby/sergeant_ashby_my_lady_52feae74.speaker: ashby
ashby/sergeant_ashby_my_lady_52feae74.text: Sergeant Ashby, my lady. Vey says I'm to keep you alive. He says it's a full-time job.

ashby/shades_sitting_on_millstone_729117.speaker: ashby
ashby/shades_sitting_on_millstone_729117.text: Shades sitting on Millstone Cross, my queen. No caravan's getting through there.

ashby/shadow_at_the_camp_6531003e.speaker: ashby
ashby/shadow_at_the_camp_6531003e.text: Shadow at the camp, my queen! We'll hold the hall. Go!

ashby/shadow_is_massing_on_c69ae657.speaker: ashby
ashby/shadow_is_massing_on_c69ae657.text: Shadow is massing on the Dusk road. Ice keeps to its lakes. Nature has closed its borders.

ashby/thats_the_lot_my_866a8f5f.speaker: ashby
ashby/thats_the_lot_my_866a8f5f.text: That's the lot, my lady. The border's yours whenever you want it. The queen said so.

ashby/the_emberwatch_is_burning_7a9e83ae.speaker: ashby
ashby/the_emberwatch_is_burning_7a9e83ae.text: The Emberwatch is burning! Fall back, fall back!

ashby/the_forge_is_lost_082ed9e1.speaker: ashby
ashby/the_forge_is_lost_082ed9e1.text: The forge is lost! The hearth's gone cold!

ashby/the_saltwatch_is_lost_b481ccd1.speaker: ashby
ashby/the_saltwatch_is_lost_b481ccd1.text: The Saltwatch is lost! Get the queen out!

ashby/there_already_was_a_f884080e.speaker: ashby
ashby/there_already_was_a_f884080e.text: There already was a door, my lady. It had a latch.

ashby/there_in_the_reeds_422b8dfb.speaker: ashby
ashby/there_in_the_reeds_422b8dfb.text: There! In the reeds! That's what waiting buys you, my lady.

ashby/theyre_at_the_keep_72bc787d.speaker: ashby
ashby/theyre_at_the_keep_72bc787d.text: They're at the keep! Emberguard, hold! HOLD!

ashby/up_up_shadow_in_7a36b5e0.speaker: ashby
ashby/up_up_shadow_in_7a36b5e0.text: Up! Up! Shadow in the camp! Torches, all of you!

ashby/watchtowers_ours_my_queen_dd96ac81.speaker: ashby
ashby/watchtowers_ours_my_queen_dd96ac81.text: Watchtower's ours, my queen. We can see clear across the Hollowmere.

ashby/yes_my_lady_with_83ca507d.speaker: ashby
ashby/yes_my_lady_with_83ca507d.text: Yes, my lady. With the army, my lady. The army's the bit that walks behind you.

ashby/youre_glowing_my_lady_8a9619ac.speaker: ashby
ashby/youre_glowing_my_lady_8a9619ac.text: You're glowing, my lady. More than usual, I mean.

bettany/arrows_mostly_and_never_aa9c45aa.speaker: bettany
bettany/arrows_mostly_and_never_aa9c45aa.text: Arrows, mostly. And never having to go down there again.

bettany/eight_magpies_the_lodge_31433e94.speaker: bettany
bettany/eight_magpies_the_lodge_31433e94.text: Eight Magpies. The Lodge remembers who clears its road.

bettany/guides_are_with_you_e70f4481.speaker: bettany
bettany/guides_are_with_you_e70f4481.text: Guides are with you. Go before the Bishop buys the next one.

bettany/halfway_the_old_hunters_f6dbe445.speaker: bettany
bettany/halfway_the_old_hunters_f6dbe445.text: Halfway. The old hunters are starting to like you. Don't let it go to your head.

bettany/heads_up_firelady_the_940c22c7.speaker: bettany
bettany/heads_up_firelady_the_940c22c7.text: Heads up, Firelady. The Magpies are out. They like their caravans full and their guards absent.

bettany/it_did_the_lodge_b9bed1ca.speaker: bettany
bettany/it_did_the_lodge_b9bed1ca.text: It did. The Lodge pays better, and nobody here throws fire at the furniture.

bettany/mind_the_flags_firelady_0c85d80d.speaker: bettany
bettany/mind_the_flags_firelady_0c85d80d.text: Mind the flags, Firelady. Coin on a flag is the only order that lot understands.

bettany/one_wagon_five_to_27f8f10b.speaker: bettany
bettany/one_wagon_five_to_27f8f10b.text: One wagon. Five to go. The hunters count slow and they count twice.

bettany/six_paid_in_full_b206ca67.speaker: bettany
bettany/six_paid_in_full_b206ca67.text: Six. Paid in full. Here's your road down: a stair under Emberfall, the Sunrise Road.

bettany/the_crooked_lantern_is_5d905cc1.speaker: bettany
bettany/the_crooked_lantern_is_5d905cc1.text: The Crooked Lantern is open! Sellswords, cheap ale, no questions. First hire's on the house.

bettany/two_of_ours_will_8082354f.speaker: bettany
bettany/two_of_ours_will_8082354f.text: Two of ours will guide you. Nobody else has walked it since the Master.

brannet/dawn_and_the_outwalls_7a0566cb.speaker: brannet
brannet/dawn_and_the_outwalls_7a0566cb.text: Dawn, and the Outwall's still here. Nobody on the wall will ever thank you. So: thank you.

brannet/every_bells_rung_i_f300f10e.speaker: brannet
brannet/every_bells_rung_i_f300f10e.text: Every bell's rung. I never heard all five at once. Sounds like a festival.

brannet/facetguards_turned_back_by_af598.speaker: brannet
brannet/facetguards_turned_back_by_af598.text: Facetguards, turned back by an ice-king. I'll be telling that one in the tavern for years.

brannet/half_the_outwall_gone_213dc8e0.speaker: brannet
brannet/half_the_outwall_gone_213dc8e0.text: Half the Outwall gone! Ice-king, whatever you're guarding, it isn't us!

brannet/net_lane_out_follow_c4fcc567.speaker: brannet
brannet/net_lane_out_follow_c4fcc567.text: Net Lane, out! Follow the cold, it's the only thing tonight that isn't lying to us.

brannet/rope_rows_coming_mind_5da32ac8.speaker: brannet
brannet/rope_rows_coming_mind_5da32ac8.text: Rope Row's coming. Mind the old ones, they walk slow. Like you, no offence.

brannet/the_archons_press_took_e812bb2f.speaker: brannet
brannet/the_archons_press_took_e812bb2f.text: The Archon's press took a whole lane. They'll dig till they drop, and nobody'll count them.

brannet/the_boats_are_in_2b58d351.speaker: brannet
brannet/the_boats_are_in_2b58d351.text: The boats are in. Two crews, sixteen souls, and the whole night coming for them.

brannet/those_oars_were_ours_d3cda243.speaker: brannet
brannet/those_oars_were_ours_d3cda243.text: Those oars were ours! Nobody from the Outwall rows for the candle-man!

brannet/youre_the_ice_king_cd3a8473.speaker: brannet
brannet/youre_the_ice_king_cd3a8473.text: You're the ice-king? We've had kings before. They stand on the wall and watch.

child/is_it_true_were_f7514f0a.speaker: child
child/is_it_true_were_f7514f0a.text: Is it true? Were you really him?

child/were_you_sad_when_4203d4ce.speaker: child
child/were_you_sad_when_4203d4ce.text: Were you sad, when they stopped needing you?

dacian/enough_seraphine_the_cloth_33d751.speaker: dacian
dacian/enough_seraphine_the_cloth_33d751.text: Enough. Seraphine, the cloth. We end this on the sand, the old way.

dacian/first_blood_to_the_4446ec8f.speaker: dacian
dacian/first_blood_to_the_4446ec8f.text: First blood to the Sun. Now say your truth, Ice-king, and I will listen.

dacian/no_crowd_worth_the_0c4f381a.speaker: dacian
dacian/no_crowd_worth_the_0c4f381a.text: No crowd worth the name today, Diamond Wall. Just us, and a great deal of money.

dacian/no_she_was_the_342ef40a.speaker: dacian
dacian/no_she_was_the_342ef40a.text: No... she was the best of us. Both cities killed her today.

dacian/those_arent_mine_seraphine_76f215.speaker: dacian
dacian/those_arent_mine_seraphine_76f215.text: Those aren't mine! Seraphine, those are NOT mine!

dacian/those_were_never_ours_15f08abd.speaker: dacian
dacian/those_were_never_ours_15f08abd.text: Those were never ours. You knew before you came to the sand.

dacian/well_struck_twice_now_ef7e72f1.speaker: dacian
dacian/well_struck_twice_now_ef7e72f1.text: Well struck. Twice now an Adamarch guest has cut me. I am starting to take it personally.

dacian/you_want_the_truth_44f2781b.speaker: dacian
dacian/you_want_the_truth_44f2781b.text: You want the truth told on my sand, Ice-king? Then by the old rule. First blood, and no further.

dancer/come_on_my_queen_d768fe5e.speaker: dancer
dancer/come_on_my_queen_d768fe5e.text: Come on, my queen! One dance!

diamond_archon/an_archon_before_me_c3692.speaker: diamond_archon
diamond_archon/an_archon_before_me_c3692.text: An Archon before me did that once. The Year of Two Skies.

diamond_archon/empty_the_pits_all_240291.speaker: diamond_archon
diamond_archon/empty_the_pits_all_240291.text: Empty the pits. All of them. Let the sky be white and silver by noon.

diamond_archon/guard_my_pits_the_53c278f.speaker: diamond_archon
diamond_archon/guard_my_pits_the_53c278f.text: Guard my pits. The diamonds pay for your dragons. The Outwall can look after itself.

diamond_archon/ice_king_adamarch_did_27b.speaker: diamond_archon
diamond_archon/ice_king_adamarch_did_27b.text: Ice-king. Adamarch did not open its harbour to you so you could herd fishermen.

diamond_archon/my_pits_stood_empty_9229b.speaker: diamond_archon
diamond_archon/my_pits_stood_empty_9229b.text: My pits stood empty all night. Remember that I asked you, and that you chose.

diamond_archon/the_pits_held_adamarch_7d.speaker: diamond_archon
diamond_archon/the_pits_held_adamarch_7d.text: The pits held. Adamarch pays its debts, Ice-king. It never forgets them, either.

diamond_archon/those_beasts_are_the_da9e.speaker: diamond_archon
diamond_archon/those_beasts_are_the_da9e.text: Those beasts are the property of the Diamond Hall. You will answer for them.

gannet/all_five_lit_then_1a904c61.speaker: gannet
gannet/all_five_lit_then_1a904c61.text: All five lit? Then the whole vale can watch you lose. Boys! Fetch me that match!

gannet/burn_my_tents_would_333c3e7d.speaker: gannet
gannet/burn_my_tents_would_333c3e7d.text: Burn my tents, would you? I'll have your diggers and their shovels too.

gannet/come_on_match_come_94839023.speaker: gannet
gannet/come_on_match_come_94839023.text: Come on, match! Come and knock! I'm right here! Just you!

gannet/keep_the_fort_keep_3b900b6f.speaker: gannet
gannet/keep_the_fort_keep_3b900b6f.text: Keep the fort! Keep the fens! I'm keeping my neck!

gannet/little_match_three_years_1c805ac8.speaker: gannet
gannet/little_match_three_years_1c805ac8.text: Little match! Three years, and you still run in alone!

gannet/my_nest_my_lovely_f58fe7cf.speaker: gannet
gannet/my_nest_my_lovely_f58fe7cf.text: My nest! My lovely nest! The horn, boys! Blow the horn!

gannet/out_boys_knock_the_d947cadb.speaker: gannet
gannet/out_boys_knock_the_d947cadb.text: Out, boys! Knock the fire-throwers flat!

gannet/pretty_lights_in_the_db30aa29.speaker: gannet
gannet/pretty_lights_in_the_db30aa29.text: Pretty lights in the vale! Keep lighting them, little match. We'll follow them home.

gannet/she_burned_my_good_62b6b1b7.speaker: gannet
gannet/she_burned_my_good_62b6b1b7.text: She burned my good coat! Back to the fens! Back to the fens!

herald/a_woman_in_a_56342b7a.speaker: herald
herald/a_woman_in_a_56342b7a.text: A woman in a white mask. She never said a word. The knives followed her like ducklings.

herald/dont_hurt_me_i_625d6baa.speaker: herald
herald/dont_hurt_me_i_625d6baa.text: Don't hurt me! I only read the names! I saw the boat, a black boat, from the north side!

herald/neither_bleeds_by_the_8430d38b.speaker: herald
herald/neither_bleeds_by_the_8430d38b.text: Neither bleeds! By the law, it is a draw, and the sand is quiet!

herald/the_laurel_at_noon_804a95cc.speaker: herald
herald/the_laurel_at_noon_804a95cc.text: The Laurel at noon! By the Truce of the Stilled Sea: first blood, and no further!

herald/the_rock_is_held_1df0020b.speaker: herald
herald/the_rock_is_held_1df0020b.text: The rock is held! By the old law, its master speaks last at the hammer.

hush/and_the_people_in_38bfd736.speaker: hush
hush/and_the_people_in_38bfd736.text: And the people in the tents, Bishop?

hush/another_night_little_queen_cf1af060.speaker: hush
hush/another_night_little_queen_cf1af060.text: Another night, little queen. There is always another night.

hush/another_night_then_there_c783aa53.speaker: hush
hush/another_night_then_there_c783aa53.text: Another night, then. There is always another night.

hush/bishop_you_taught_me_2707df3a.speaker: hush
hush/bishop_you_taught_me_2707df3a.text: Bishop. You taught me the knife. The stone taught me the rest.

hush/did_you_miss_me_4ed8c8cb.speaker: hush
hush/did_you_miss_me_4ed8c8cb.text: Did you miss me, little ember? I missed you. Twice now.

hush/four_the_camp_will_8abdeae8.speaker: hush
hush/four_the_camp_will_8abdeae8.text: Four. The camp will wake hungry, Bishop.

hush/give_it_to_me_518b0fe5.speaker: hush
hush/give_it_to_me_518b0fe5.text: Give it to me. You never use it right. You use it SMALL.

hush/hold_still_little_queen_e14afc20.speaker: hush
hush/hold_still_little_queen_e14afc20.text: Hold still, little queen. It's kinder.

hush/hush_now_sunblade_the_1bbad2cf.speaker: hush
hush/hush_now_sunblade_the_1bbad2cf.text: Hush now, Sunblade. The war only needs one more death.

hush/hush_now_the_dark_083469dc.speaker: hush
hush/hush_now_the_dark_083469dc.text: Hush now. The dark only wants to be listened to.

hush/i_said_youd_want_fd00b40b.speaker: hush
hush/i_said_youd_want_fd00b40b.text: I said you'd want me back, Bishop. The dark got very loud.

hush/light_it_bishop_just_2e5a0a38.speaker: hush
hush/light_it_bishop_just_2e5a0a38.text: Light it, Bishop. Just this once.

hush/little_lambs_on_a_cb043ebd.speaker: hush
hush/little_lambs_on_a_cb043ebd.text: Little lambs on a little road. The Bishop sends his regards.

hush/old_man_you_still_ebc88833.speaker: hush
hush/old_man_you_still_ebc88833.text: Old man. You still owe me a night.

hush/once_is_enough_to_4025d01e.speaker: hush
hush/once_is_enough_to_4025d01e.text: Once is enough to remember, Bishop. Who is it tonight?

hush/one_horn_fewer_the_b84447ea.speaker: hush
hush/one_horn_fewer_the_b84447ea.text: One horn fewer. The valley will have to shout.

hush/one_more_night_ysolde_0b760e71.speaker: hush
hush/one_more_night_ysolde_0b760e71.text: One more night, Ysolde. The Bishop pays for every one.

hush/one_wagon_its_wheels_a0dd3082.speaker: hush
hush/one_wagon_its_wheels_a0dd3082.text: One wagon. Its wheels will not turn again.

hush/riders_at_the_reeds_637ae179.speaker: hush
hush/riders_at_the_reeds_637ae179.text: Riders at the reeds. Quick little sparks.

hush/the_bishop_sends_his_5bf20c82.speaker: hush
hush/the_bishop_sends_his_5bf20c82.text: The Bishop sends his regrets. I will deliver them in person, later.

hush/the_bishop_wanted_a_2737f8b9.speaker: hush
hush/the_bishop_wanted_a_2737f8b9.text: The Bishop wanted a look at the tree. I came to look first.

hush/the_knife_bends_not_c5154be6.speaker: hush
hush/the_knife_bends_not_c5154be6.text: The knife bends... Not tonight. Not...

hush/the_knife_never_misses_18829075.speaker: hush
hush/the_knife_never_misses_18829075.text: The knife never misses, Ysolde. It only waits for the right neck.

hush/the_little_ember_in_80809961.speaker: hush
hush/the_little_ember_in_80809961.text: The little ember, in the dark. You're a long way from your braziers.

hush/the_old_man_awake_880df431.speaker: hush
hush/the_old_man_awake_880df431.text: The old man. Awake, of course. He was awake that night too.

hush/the_old_man_bites_731539db.speaker: hush
hush/the_old_man_bites_731539db.text: The old man bites. How charming.

hush/then_they_can_lie_dd75e0d4.speaker: hush
hush/then_they_can_lie_dd75e0d4.text: Then they can lie down again. I'll help them.

hush/there_is_always_another_125c7767.speaker: hush
hush/there_is_always_another_125c7767.text: There is always another night, Ice-king. Ask your friend how he spends his.

hush/there_is_always_another_5a290e4e.speaker: hush
hush/there_is_always_another_5a290e4e.text: There is always another night, little ember. Another night.

hush/there_is_always_another_96ce6e3c.speaker: hush
hush/there_is_always_another_96ce6e3c.text: There is always another night, Ice-king. Tonight it is yours.

hush/there_is_always_another_ba7ab626.speaker: hush
hush/there_is_always_another_ba7ab626.text: There is always another night, Bishop!

hush/there_is_always_another_f7fb47ef.speaker: hush
hush/there_is_always_another_f7fb47ef.text: There is always another night, Bishop.

hush/there_she_sleeps_the_73b03a6b.speaker: hush
hush/there_she_sleeps_the_73b03a6b.text: There she sleeps. The little queen. One step, Bishop. Just one.

hush/whatever_moves_bishop_and_c666e91b.speaker: hush
hush/whatever_moves_bishop_and_c666e91b.text: Whatever moves, Bishop. And a few things that don't.

hush/youll_want_me_back_e5a4f69e.speaker: hush
hush/youll_want_me_back_e5a4f69e.text: You'll want me back. When the dark gets loud.

maelis/and_the_ford_malrik_5cb1ccca.speaker: maelis
maelis/and_the_ford_malrik_5cb1ccca.text: And the ford? Malrik will want his ford.

maelis/behind_us_the_wood_5440fe19.speaker: maelis
maelis/behind_us_the_wood_5440fe19.text: Behind us! The wood has a knife in it!

maelis/colder_than_last_night_bc8942c7.speaker: maelis
maelis/colder_than_last_night_bc8942c7.text: Colder than last night. The river froze to the bottom.

maelis/everything_they_have_left_b1664e8.speaker: maelis
maelis/everything_they_have_left_b1664e8.text: Everything they have left is coming. Good. It means we're nearly there.

maelis/fine_ill_take_the_dd7811de.speaker: maelis
maelis/fine_ill_take_the_dd7811de.text: Fine. I'll take the well. The wolves always come to the well.

maelis/good_morning_grandfather_the_9225.speaker: maelis
maelis/good_morning_grandfather_the_9225.text: Good morning, grandfather. There's a wall that needs leaning on.

maelis/her_glass_is_sand_06db398c.speaker: maelis
maelis/her_glass_is_sand_06db398c.text: Her glass is sand now. She'll have to sulk somewhere warmer.

maelis/i_went_to_see_79c2eba0.speaker: maelis
maelis/i_went_to_see_79c2eba0.text: I went to see the brook. It is cold, it is guarded, and it is very rude.

maelis/ill_run_ahead_and_fa64325f.speaker: maelis
maelis/ill_run_ahead_and_fa64325f.text: I'll run ahead and smell the road. Call me when your tree grows tall enough to shout.

maelis/im_fine_bitten_fine_b51bf55d.speaker: maelis
maelis/im_fine_bitten_fine_b51bf55d.text: I'm fine! Bitten. Fine. Keep planting.

maelis/larkrest_is_burning_theres_6b9036.speaker: maelis
maelis/larkrest_is_burning_theres_6b9036.text: Larkrest is burning. There's nothing left to walk away from.

maelis/listen_the_brooks_talking_0feef3f.speaker: maelis
maelis/listen_the_brooks_talking_0feef3f.text: Listen. The brook's talking again. It says thank you, roughly.

maelis/make_way_for_the_e90de15d.speaker: maelis
maelis/make_way_for_the_e90de15d.text: Make way for the old herd!

maelis/mm_and_it_brought_a61ca19b.speaker: maelis
maelis/mm_and_it_brought_a61ca19b.text: Mm. And it brought you a present.

maelis/nine_winters_and_a_a2ddf4f1.speaker: maelis
maelis/nine_winters_and_a_a2ddf4f1.text: Nine winters. And a girl with a seed sack beats me to him.

maelis/no_grain_no_carts_0fdcd5b5.speaker: maelis
maelis/no_grain_no_carts_0fdcd5b5.text: No grain, no carts. The valley can't feed them now.

maelis/nobody_saw_the_knife_e6c199b7.speaker: maelis
maelis/nobody_saw_the_knife_e6c199b7.text: Nobody saw the knife. Nobody ever does.

maelis/now_that_is_a_65198604.speaker: maelis
maelis/now_that_is_a_65198604.text: Now that is a tree with opinions.

maelis/old_whitepelt_ive_hunted_f43f65b0.speaker: maelis
maelis/old_whitepelt_ive_hunted_f43f65b0.text: Old Whitepelt. I've hunted him nine winters. He's never been this hungry.

maelis/one_mountain_fewer_mountains_6a50.speaker: maelis
maelis/one_mountain_fewer_mountains_6a50.text: One mountain fewer. Mountains are overrated.

maelis/rime_on_every_trunk_cd972719.speaker: maelis
maelis/rime_on_every_trunk_cd972719.text: Rime on every trunk. Aldra's totems in all five glades.

maelis/seed_in_the_snow_df0ca7c8.speaker: maelis
maelis/seed_in_the_snow_df0ca7c8.text: Seed in the snow, little one? The whole village is laughing at you.

maelis/stumpwood_breathes_again_the_c386.speaker: maelis
maelis/stumpwood_breathes_again_the_c386.text: Stumpwood breathes again. The forest remembers who froze it.

maelis/tall_enough_for_birds_ebb7f2ad.speaker: maelis
maelis/tall_enough_for_birds_ebb7f2ad.text: Tall enough for birds now. Big ones, with thorns.

maelis/that_branch_wont_come_be479804.speaker: maelis
maelis/that_branch_wont_come_be479804.text: That branch won't come back, you know.

maelis/the_chains_theyre_dragging_574c7e.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_chains_theyre_dragging_574c7e.text: The chains! They're dragging him back! The keys remember who they belong to!

maelis/the_forest_is_not_d03a0aa8.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_forest_is_not_d03a0aa8.text: The forest is not done with me. Neither am I.

maelis/the_glass_spire_aldra_292e03e1.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_glass_spire_aldra_292e03e1.text: The glass spire. Aldra will be waiting. She always is.

maelis/the_heartwoods_fallen_winter_41b8.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_heartwoods_fallen_winter_41b8.text: The Heartwood's fallen. Winter wins this one.

maelis/the_masters_tree_its_4648a288.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_masters_tree_its_4648a288.text: The Master's tree... It's gone dark.

maelis/the_new_heartwoods_fallen_a0fa620.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_new_heartwoods_fallen_a0fa620.text: The new Heartwood's fallen. The wood has nothing left to grow from.

maelis/the_scouts_are_back_6b2c3985.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_scouts_are_back_6b2c3985.text: The scouts are back from the Sighing Wood.

maelis/the_sighing_wood_then_71a2bf62.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_sighing_wood_then_71a2bf62.text: The Sighing Wood, then? Burnt, frozen, and still ours.

maelis/the_wagons_are_burning_4f36d989.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_wagons_are_burning_4f36d989.text: The wagons are burning. All of them, on the south road.

maelis/the_western_woods_are_c43d6097.speaker: maelis
maelis/the_western_woods_are_c43d6097.text: The western woods are old and full of ears. Some of those ears are Malrik's.

maelis/their_nest_is_ash_e1910c01.speaker: maelis
maelis/their_nest_is_ash_e1910c01.text: Their nest is ash. Malrik will need new hunters, and new excuses.

maelis/they_didnt_freeze_it_0d9cc04b.speaker: maelis
maelis/they_didnt_freeze_it_0d9cc04b.text: They didn't freeze it to hold it. They froze it so it would stay dead.

maelis/theyll_fight_you_child_513b461f.speaker: maelis
maelis/theyll_fight_you_child_513b461f.text: They'll fight you, child. They only know the one word you taught them.

maelis/this_is_all_of_ce049be9.speaker: maelis
maelis/this_is_all_of_ce049be9.text: This is all of us who can still hold a bow.

maelis/through_the_ford_little_268c1aa3.speaker: maelis
maelis/through_the_ford_little_268c1aa3.text: Through the ford, little ones. Slow is fine. Slow is alive.

maelis/torvald_holds_the_west_1d77f9ee.speaker: maelis
maelis/torvald_holds_the_west_1d77f9ee.text: Torvald holds the west. His glass warden holds the east. They're both very tidy.

maelis/turn_back_fire_child_b04181ab.speaker: maelis
maelis/turn_back_fire_child_b04181ab.text: Turn back, fire-child. The wolves already have your scent.

maelis/under_the_ice_by_ba2f6c51.speaker: maelis
maelis/under_the_ice_by_ba2f6c51.text: Under the ice by the west gate, something old is sleeping. Wake it, and it will owe you.

maelis/wolves_off_the_north_a1b11421.speaker: maelis
maelis/wolves_off_the_north_a1b11421.text: Wolves off the north ridge. Thin ones. Hungry ones.

maelis/you_called_me_out_f5c9f9cf.speaker: maelis
maelis/you_called_me_out_f5c9f9cf.text: You called me out of the wood. I've waited forty years to hear that.

maelis/you_never_speak_of_6b486b45.speaker: maelis
maelis/you_never_speak_of_6b486b45.text: You never speak of the night he went.

maelis/you_never_told_the_e44ddcb3.speaker: maelis
maelis/you_never_told_the_e44ddcb3.text: You never told the village you were right.

malrik/a_gardener_and_a_7eb3ea3b.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_gardener_and_a_7eb3ea3b.text: A gardener and a matchstick. Torvald, they are planting trees at us.

malrik/a_giant_made_of_5fb6ef9b.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_giant_made_of_5fb6ef9b.text: A giant made of rubble, in MY war? Shades, kill the pillars. Then kill Vessa.

malrik/a_ledger_graves_rings_7991c1d4.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_ledger_graves_rings_7991c1d4.text: A ledger. Graves, rings and prices. He sold the dead by the pound.

malrik/a_little_less_than_e9db75b8.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_little_less_than_e9db75b8.text: A little. Less than you would think.

malrik/a_little_you_always_0737e1db.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_little_you_always_0737e1db.text: A little. You always say a little.

malrik/a_map_to_the_5b99da9c.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_map_to_the_5b99da9c.text: A map to the deep. How generous. I'll take it off your body.

malrik/a_secret_apprentice_under_3ee198b.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_secret_apprentice_under_3ee198b.text: A secret apprentice under the lake.

malrik/a_thiefs_purse_sealed_e25f1c7a.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_thiefs_purse_sealed_e25f1c7a.text: A thief's purse, sealed with the Reeve's own seal. You pay robbers, Reeve?

malrik/an_old_man_and_16acc110.speaker: malrik
malrik/an_old_man_and_16acc110.text: An old man and a thunderstorm. Shades, fall back. I'll collect whatever is left.

malrik/and_every_one_of_e9f01242.speaker: malrik
malrik/and_every_one_of_e9f01242.text: And every one of them is mine.

malrik/and_me_he_gave_ad0ff01f.speaker: malrik
malrik/and_me_he_gave_ad0ff01f.text: And me? He gave me what was left over. The dark. As if it were a kindness.

malrik/and_the_cure_is_f19934f8.speaker: malrik
malrik/and_the_cure_is_f19934f8.text: And the cure is that I stop the war I'm winning. How convenient.

malrik/and_you_brought_fire_4350d292.speaker: malrik
malrik/and_you_brought_fire_4350d292.text: And you brought fire to a meadow. We all have our gifts, Vessa.

malrik/at_an_armys_supper_a3673f23.speaker: malrik
malrik/at_an_armys_supper_a3673f23.text: At an army's supper, Torvald. Hungry soldiers go home.

malrik/back_out_of_the_517e6048.speaker: malrik
malrik/back_out_of_the_517e6048.text: Back! Out of the light! It eats you.

malrik/bring_me_back_their_59d08381.speaker: malrik
malrik/bring_me_back_their_59d08381.text: Bring me back their axle pins.

malrik/burn_them_both_fleets_d02db0d5.speaker: malrik
malrik/burn_them_both_fleets_d02db0d5.text: Burn them. Both fleets, the sand, the cloth. A strait of dead feeds the stone for years.

malrik/by_morning_every_dragon_66972ad9.speaker: malrik
malrik/by_morning_every_dragon_66972ad9.text: By morning every dragon on the Coinwater is ours.

malrik/cold_in_here_you_33bb5ecc.speaker: malrik
malrik/cold_in_here_you_33bb5ecc.text: Cold in here. You should let Vessa redecorate. She's very keen on fire.

malrik/crack_do_you_hear_138941bb.speaker: malrik
malrik/crack_do_you_hear_138941bb.text: Crack. Do you hear it, Vessa? That is the sound of a lock giving up.

malrik/do_you_hear_it_527497b0.speaker: malrik
malrik/do_you_hear_it_527497b0.text: Do you hear it, Torvald? Every one of them is mine now. Every single one.

malrik/dont_all_stare_i_669c1ce4.speaker: malrik
malrik/dont_all_stare_i_669c1ce4.text: Don't all stare. I was invited. Especially, I'm told.

malrik/dying_in_the_dark_fb135b2c.speaker: malrik
malrik/dying_in_the_dark_fb135b2c.text: Dying in the dark. Twice in one war. I am starting to keep count.

malrik/empty_the_pits_your_c9ad667c.speaker: malrik
malrik/empty_the_pits_your_c9ad667c.text: Empty the pits, Your Radiance. All of them.

malrik/even_the_bishops_of_bb562140.speaker: malrik
malrik/even_the_bishops_of_bb562140.text: Even the bishops. Of course even the bishops.

malrik/even_thunder_falls_off_e2b72826.speaker: malrik
malrik/even_thunder_falls_off_e2b72826.text: Even thunder falls off a horse, old man.

malrik/every_grave_here_i_02269529.speaker: malrik
malrik/every_grave_here_i_02269529.text: Every grave here, I dug, or my father did. They know my shovel. They don't know this.

malrik/every_ring_in_wickmoor_d885da5c.speaker: malrik
malrik/every_ring_in_wickmoor_d885da5c.text: Every ring in Wickmoor, in one sack. With a receipt. Thieves are so tidy.

malrik/every_road_charges_a_48b23a8d.speaker: malrik
malrik/every_road_charges_a_48b23a8d.text: Every road charges a toll, Vessa. This one charges you.

malrik/every_vigil_out_at_11f98382.speaker: malrik
malrik/every_vigil_out_at_11f98382.text: Every vigil out at once. Someone has been very rude to my dead.

malrik/everyone_tells_my_story_b15bf545.speaker: malrik
malrik/everyone_tells_my_story_b15bf545.text: Everyone tells my story wrong. Let me try.

malrik/everyone_thinks_the_dark_30ca4f87.speaker: malrik
malrik/everyone_thinks_the_dark_30ca4f87.text: Everyone thinks the dark found me. I found it. By one candle. Let me show you.

malrik/everything_old_man_i_49ece533.speaker: malrik
malrik/everything_old_man_i_49ece533.text: Everything, old man. I took it all. That is the whole secret.

malrik/father_you_taught_me_bed0e595.speaker: malrik
malrik/father_you_taught_me_bed0e595.text: Father. You taught me where to dig. You never taught me when to stop.

malrik/feed_old_stone_take_42ea4b5b.speaker: malrik
malrik/feed_old_stone_take_42ea4b5b.text: Feed, old stone. Take what you need from me. I have plenty.

malrik/for_now_always_your_5368ebc4.speaker: malrik
malrik/for_now_always_your_5368ebc4.text: For now. Always your favourite words.

malrik/for_now_then_doors_efbbc32b.speaker: malrik
malrik/for_now_then_doors_efbbc32b.text: For now, then. Doors are only closed until someone opens them.

malrik/for_the_second_bid_7057e9af.speaker: malrik
malrik/for_the_second_bid_7057e9af.text: For the second bid, Torvald. A gift. Two hundred, in good gold.

malrik/ford_mud_my_father_60cd5c23.speaker: malrik
malrik/ford_mud_my_father_60cd5c23.text: Ford mud. My father said the same of grave clay: it never comes off.

malrik/four_people_who_hate_75d36660.speaker: malrik
malrik/four_people_who_hate_75d36660.text: Four people who hate each other, holding one rope. What could possibly go wrong.

malrik/four_wagons_hush_grain_95e6dc4e.speaker: malrik
malrik/four_wagons_hush_grain_95e6dc4e.text: Four wagons, Hush. Grain, arrows, oil, fodder. Hungry armies march slowly.

malrik/full_at_last_just_2ce58b75.speaker: malrik
malrik/full_at_last_just_2ce58b75.text: Full. At last. Just once, to be full.

malrik/go_on_then_run_d5638b5a.speaker: malrik
malrik/go_on_then_run_d5638b5a.text: Go on, then. Run ahead. I'll be right behind you, with the key you lack.

malrik/go_then_keep_your_e8004770.speaker: malrik
malrik/go_then_keep_your_e8004770.text: Go, then. Keep your knives sharp. I may need a friend who isn't a rock.

malrik/good_come_home_bring_4f690a73.speaker: malrik
malrik/good_come_home_bring_4f690a73.text: Good. Come home. Bring the night with you.

malrik/good_evening_vessa_mind_c8c23dd1.speaker: malrik
malrik/good_evening_vessa_mind_c8c23dd1.text: Good evening, Vessa. Mind the statue. It's been waiting a hundred years to stretch its legs.

malrik/he_gave_me_the_1a1c45a6.speaker: malrik
malrik/he_gave_me_the_1a1c45a6.text: He gave me the dark. What was left. He never said otherwise.

malrik/he_had_one_he_6b073ea7.speaker: malrik
malrik/he_had_one_he_6b073ea7.text: He had one. He wore it out honestly.

malrik/he_is_laughing_why_3b87ec97.speaker: malrik
malrik/he_is_laughing_why_3b87ec97.text: He is laughing. Why is he laughing?

malrik/hello_tobin_marsh_nobody_73d5b0d7.speaker: malrik
malrik/hello_tobin_marsh_nobody_73d5b0d7.text: Hello, Tobin Marsh. Nobody visits you either.

malrik/hello_you_came_when_2eb5e14d.speaker: malrik
malrik/hello_you_came_when_2eb5e14d.text: ...Hello. You came when I called. Nobody comes when I call.

malrik/her_banner_her_crystals_d1d89158.speaker: malrik
malrik/her_banner_her_crystals_d1d89158.text: Her banner, her crystals. Fire is generous when it isn't looking.

malrik/here_lies_edda_brack_007d2293.speaker: malrik
malrik/here_lies_edda_brack_007d2293.text: "Here lies Edda Brack. She was right about the roof." I believe you, Edda.

malrik/hm_help_that_arrives_dba0437e.speaker: malrik
malrik/hm_help_that_arrives_dba0437e.text: Hm. Help that arrives on time. Unsettling. Thank you.

malrik/hush_the_old_man_365a3fae.speaker: malrik
malrik/hush_the_old_man_365a3fae.text: Hush. The old man is with her. Wake the stones before he does.

malrik/i_came_out_at_d54a2802.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_came_out_at_d54a2802.text: I came out at dawn. Bored. The shadows came out with me.

malrik/i_did_not_ask_8e6eb56a.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_did_not_ask_8e6eb56a.text: I did not ask you anything.

malrik/i_have_heard_stop_28b1860c.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_have_heard_stop_28b1860c.text: I have heard “stop” all my life.

malrik/i_have_heard_stop_6b5d1395.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_have_heard_stop_6b5d1395.text: I have heard "stop" all my life.

malrik/i_heard_i_came_406b6094.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_heard_i_came_406b6094.text: I heard. I came. Don't make it a speech.

malrik/i_kept_something_a_95e665a5.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_kept_something_a_95e665a5.text: I kept something. A candle. A knife. A stone that still beats in my hand.

malrik/i_know_what_you_a21cdaea.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_know_what_you_a21cdaea.text: I know what you are. You're the last biscuit in the tin, forever.

malrik/i_sent_her_to_1effb834.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_sent_her_to_1effb834.text: I sent her to the wagons. You should be flattered she skipped your tent.

malrik/i_took_the_dark_7ada4fa9.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_took_the_dark_7ada4fa9.text: I took the dark and taught it to kneel. I took knives, and a woman who never misses.

malrik/i_was_a_gravediggers_c1b95674.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_was_a_gravediggers_c1b95674.text: I was a gravedigger's son. I grew up among the dead. They were better company.

malrik/i_was_given_the_41959a0d.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_was_given_the_41959a0d.text: I was given the leftovers, Vessa. I have learned to take the rest.

malrik/if_i_cant_have_19d09d54.speaker: malrik
malrik/if_i_cant_have_19d09d54.text: If I can't have the deep road, nobody walks it. Burn the market.

malrik/im_learning_late_youd_b1012410.speaker: malrik
malrik/im_learning_late_youd_b1012410.text: I'm learning, late. You'd say that's the family way. Sleep, old man.

malrik/im_not_using_you_04693cd7.speaker: malrik
malrik/im_not_using_you_04693cd7.text: I'm not using you. I'm carrying you. Like a parcel. To the hole you came from.

malrik/in_fairness_it_was_0dc45cc6.speaker: malrik
malrik/in_fairness_it_was_0dc45cc6.text: In fairness, it was a great deal of gold.

malrik/in_the_citadel_there_51cd46ff.speaker: malrik
malrik/in_the_citadel_there_51cd46ff.text: In the citadel there was always enough. I took more anyway.

malrik/it_did_take_my_6915a3c7.speaker: malrik
malrik/it_did_take_my_6915a3c7.text: It did. Take my keyhole's left side. And Hush... thank you.

malrik/it_is_me_torvald_03cb4e80.speaker: malrik
malrik/it_is_me_torvald_03cb4e80.text: It is me, Torvald. It has always been me.

malrik/it_knows_everyones_name_fd543fb1.speaker: malrik
malrik/it_knows_everyones_name_fd543fb1.text: It knows everyone's name. It is a stone with nothing else to do.

malrik/it_never_is_that_ed60c05e.speaker: malrik
malrik/it_never_is_that_ed60c05e.text: It never is. That is what I like about you.

malrik/it_whispers_let_it_f35c4d4b.speaker: malrik
malrik/it_whispers_let_it_f35c4d4b.text: It whispers. Let it. I am the one who listens, and I am the one who decides.

malrik/keep_it_warm_for_3523ab04.speaker: malrik
malrik/keep_it_warm_for_3523ab04.text: Keep it warm for me. The other three will come for it now.

malrik/keep_your_door_vessa_f658e6ec.speaker: malrik
malrik/keep_your_door_vessa_f658e6ec.text: Keep your door, Vessa. I have the key, and all the time in the world.

malrik/kesh_morrow_sunwake_i_2cd28d46.speaker: malrik
malrik/kesh_morrow_sunwake_i_2cd28d46.text: Kesh. Morrow. Sunwake. I filled your hoards to the brim. Earn them.

malrik/knights_to_the_shrine_e1873784.speaker: malrik
malrik/knights_to_the_shrine_e1873784.text: Knights, to the shrine glade. Burn whatever grew there twice.

malrik/let_go_hes_lying_062f6620.speaker: malrik
malrik/let_go_hes_lying_062f6620.text: Let go! He's lying! He's the one- let GO!

malrik/light_all_the_candles_d4719180.speaker: malrik
malrik/light_all_the_candles_d4719180.text: Light all the candles you like. The dark just gets a better view.

malrik/little_vessa_you_came_e419427c.speaker: malrik
malrik/little_vessa_you_came_e419427c.text: Little Vessa. You came a long way to lose something you never had.

malrik/look_at_it_the_489223a3.speaker: malrik
malrik/look_at_it_the_489223a3.text: Look at it. The last green country. Flowers to the knee. The Master's garden.

malrik/look_at_us_the_398a4516.speaker: malrik
malrik/look_at_us_the_398a4516.text: Look at us. The Master would weep. Mostly at your outfits.

malrik/lying_in_the_street_6af7eafc.speaker: malrik
malrik/lying_in_the_street_6af7eafc.text: Lying in the street, Torvald. Where coin usually lies.

malrik/magpies_in_my_fathers_f758690b.speaker: malrik
malrik/magpies_in_my_fathers_f758690b.text: Magpies. In my father's ossuary. Digging up my father's work.

malrik/mine_thank_you_for_88f1ef17.speaker: malrik
malrik/mine_thank_you_for_88f1ef17.text: Mine. Thank you for the escort, little ember.

malrik/more_diggers_more_knives_2ca08bff.speaker: malrik
malrik/more_diggers_more_knives_2ca08bff.text: More diggers, more knives. You should have burned my hall when you had the chance.

malrik/more_of_mine_wearing_5844f1bb.speaker: malrik
malrik/more_of_mine_wearing_5844f1bb.text: More of mine, wearing amber. I'm running out of ways to say I'm sorry about them.

malrik/my_father_dug_the_1f864ac0.speaker: malrik
malrik/my_father_dug_the_1f864ac0.text: My father dug the graves. I read them. Someone had to remember who was down there.

malrik/my_lock_is_wobbling_5d76350a.speaker: malrik
malrik/my_lock_is_wobbling_5d76350a.text: My lock is wobbling. Assistance would be... efficient.

malrik/not_mistakes_opportunities_j_ee9f.speaker: malrik
malrik/not_mistakes_opportunities_j_ee9f.text: Not mistakes. Opportunities. Just until the relics are in sensible hands.

malrik/not_today_today_i_c27aa9a4.speaker: malrik
malrik/not_today_today_i_c27aa9a4.text: Not today. Today I have a knife.

malrik/not_tonight_tonight_we_8a9dc5fc.speaker: malrik
malrik/not_tonight_tonight_we_8a9dc5fc.text: Not tonight. Tonight we starve them. Knives are for another night.

malrik/not_who_what_four_ce853308.speaker: malrik
malrik/not_who_what_four_ce853308.text: Not who. What. Four wagons on the south hill, one token each.

malrik/not_yet_not_while_cce07bfb.speaker: malrik
malrik/not_yet_not_while_cce07bfb.text: Not yet. Not while it is listening.

malrik/noted_ysolde_try_not_041e4600.speaker: malrik
malrik/noted_ysolde_try_not_041e4600.text: Noted. Ysolde, try not to plant anything on my keyhole.

malrik/of_course_he_waits_e35d5553.speaker: malrik
malrik/of_course_he_waits_e35d5553.text: Of course he waits until the last minute to speak. Family trait.

malrik/of_course_just_as_70e6c95d.speaker: malrik
malrik/of_course_just_as_70e6c95d.text: Of course. Just as it got interesting.

malrik/of_course_the_side_a93fe880.speaker: malrik
malrik/of_course_the_side_a93fe880.text: Of course. The side nobody picked. I have had a great deal of practice with those.

malrik/old_man_they_told_90dc11f1.speaker: malrik
malrik/old_man_they_told_90dc11f1.text: Old man. They told me you were dead. I was almost sad.

malrik/one_pillar_down_youre_dda66a45.speaker: malrik
malrik/one_pillar_down_youre_dda66a45.text: One pillar down. You're welcome, little ember. Don't get used to it.

malrik/one_thing_at_a_f1fe9ee5.speaker: malrik
malrik/one_thing_at_a_f1fe9ee5.text: One thing at a time. The ford first. Then we will talk about trees.

malrik/open_it_mason_let_c67d4853.speaker: malrik
malrik/open_it_mason_let_c67d4853.text: Open it, Mason. Let me see what the Master was so busy guarding.

malrik/out_out_i_decide_ca190619.speaker: malrik
malrik/out_out_i_decide_ca190619.text: Out. OUT. I decide. I have always decided.

malrik/patience_was_never_my_17e564fd.speaker: malrik
malrik/patience_was_never_my_17e564fd.text: Patience was never my virtue. Luckily, I brought shovels.

malrik/put_it_down_that_da2e3fa9.speaker: malrik
malrik/put_it_down_that_da2e3fa9.text: Put it down. That crown was never meant for someone who throws fire at her problems.

malrik/rest_im_sorry_they_397ba9cb.speaker: malrik
malrik/rest_im_sorry_they_397ba9cb.text: Rest. I'm sorry they woke you. It wasn't me. It was what I was holding.

malrik/rubble_with_eyes_your_191649c8.speaker: malrik
malrik/rubble_with_eyes_your_191649c8.text: Rubble with eyes. Your mess, Vessa. I'll be at my camp, enjoying the view.

malrik/shadow_marches_the_stone_6ca99af5.speaker: malrik
malrik/shadow_marches_the_stone_6ca99af5.text: Shadow marches. The stone stays in my pocket. Mostly I'm telling myself.

malrik/shadows_lock_is_turned_4050e916.speaker: malrik
malrik/shadows_lock_is_turned_4050e916.text: Shadow's lock is turned. You may thank me in writing.

malrik/she_missed_emberfall_then_fbb0540.speaker: malrik
malrik/she_missed_emberfall_then_fbb0540.text: She missed. Emberfall. Then the Hollow. I lost, and lost, and every time I lost,

malrik/she_tells_it_with_d5f8748d.speaker: malrik
malrik/she_tells_it_with_d5f8748d.text: She tells it with fireworks. Mine needs one candle.

malrik/sleep_you_did_your_12da7ef3.speaker: malrik
malrik/sleep_you_did_your_12da7ef3.text: Sleep. You did your share of standing.

malrik/someone_burned_my_barracks_41a810.speaker: malrik
malrik/someone_burned_my_barracks_41a810.text: Someone burned my barracks, so I brought fewer friends. Petty, little ember. I approve.

malrik/stand_with_me_hush_af4b0136.speaker: malrik
malrik/stand_with_me_hush_af4b0136.text: Stand with me, Hush. In daylight, for once.

malrik/struck_down_at_sunrise_b828d22f.speaker: malrik
malrik/struck_down_at_sunrise_b828d22f.text: Struck down at sunrise. How very Vessa.

malrik/struck_down_by_an_15035031.speaker: malrik
malrik/struck_down_by_an_15035031.text: Struck down... by an old man's weather.

malrik/tell_me_to_stop_e48f86d6.speaker: malrik
malrik/tell_me_to_stop_e48f86d6.text: Tell me to stop again tomorrow, Ysolde. I will not stop.

malrik/that_bell_he_rang_dbaa4cd0.speaker: malrik
malrik/that_bell_he_rang_dbaa4cd0.text: That bell. He rang it every dusk. Stop wearing my father's bell.

malrik/that_is_how_a_dfbf8c00.speaker: malrik
malrik/that_is_how_a_dfbf8c00.text: That is how a gravedigger's son grows strong: he never puts the shovel down.

malrik/that_was_always_the_b495dc4c.speaker: malrik
malrik/that_was_always_the_b495dc4c.text: That was always the plan, little ember.

malrik/thats_the_only_way_7d2e8fff.speaker: malrik
malrik/thats_the_only_way_7d2e8fff.text: That's the only way to use it, Hush. Small. Then never.

malrik/the_bishop_requests_assistan_cf5d.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_bishop_requests_assistan_cf5d.text: The Bishop requests assistance. Politely. Once.

malrik/the_dead_are_up_84123962.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_dead_are_up_84123962.text: The dead are up, Hush. My dead.

malrik/the_dead_dont_lie_56b18d5f.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_dead_dont_lie_56b18d5f.text: The dead don't lie. They've got nothing left to want.

malrik/the_ford_is_mine_a16120be.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_ford_is_mine_a16120be.text: The ford is mine. Write it down, Ysolde. You like things that last.

malrik/the_ford_is_mine_beebbaa5.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_ford_is_mine_beebbaa5.text: The ford is mine. The tree is not. Not today.

malrik/the_master_found_me_68a72082.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_master_found_me_68a72082.text: The Master found me reading tombstones by one candle. He said: this one, too.

malrik/the_reeve_hangs_him_d22cebc8.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_reeve_hangs_him_d22cebc8.text: The Reeve hangs him at dawn. So tonight I ask the dead. The dead don't lie to me.

malrik/the_ridge_is_mine_ebd65d79.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_ridge_is_mine_ebd65d79.text: The ridge is mine. The valley next. I will not stop.

malrik/the_shrine_glade_how_c74a206b.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_shrine_glade_how_c74a206b.text: The shrine glade. How fitting. Do pray, Ysolde. Nobody answered last time.

malrik/the_stone_is_in_dcd9ea2f.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_stone_is_in_dcd9ea2f.text: The stone is in its lock. Not in my hand. Who's next?

malrik/the_town_boys_dared_4d6496d1.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_town_boys_dared_4d6496d1.text: The town boys dared me into the crypt for a night. They waited outside.

malrik/the_west_harbour_is_8fa64de5.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_west_harbour_is_8fa64de5.text: The west harbour is yours, Torvald, the east is mine. Together we outbid the sun.

malrik/then_do_not_wake_124d2124.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_do_not_wake_124d2124.text: Then do not wake him further. Be the quiet thing in the dark.

malrik/then_he_vanished_and_877f4086.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_he_vanished_and_877f4086.text: Then he vanished and left us nothing. So I took. That is the whole secret.

malrik/then_ill_be_the_ea40568f.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_ill_be_the_ea40568f.text: Then I'll be the first who didn't. I do so like being first.

malrik/then_let_it_count_28665fc1.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_let_it_count_28665fc1.text: Then let it count. Whoever holds the Hollow holds the Master's seat. I intend to sit in it.

malrik/then_let_us_call_b733b445.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_let_us_call_b733b445.text: Then let us call it a tradition.

malrik/then_remember_it_after_ab7eeadd.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_remember_it_after_ab7eeadd.text: Then remember it after we win. Victory is a wonderful eraser.

malrik/then_the_living_stay_af34c0b4.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_the_living_stay_af34c0b4.text: Then the living stay in the crypt, and the dead go back to bed.

malrik/then_we_put_them_175a9b56.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_we_put_them_175a9b56.text: Then we put them back to bed. Gently. They were somebody's.

malrik/then_you_will_be_4255e249.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_you_will_be_4255e249.text: Then you will be a very busy gardener, Ysolde.

malrik/there_dark_again_the_3850cd4e.speaker: malrik
malrik/there_dark_again_the_3850cd4e.text: There. Dark again. The dark never asks me what I'm doing here.

malrik/there_is_id_like_9a985c3c.speaker: malrik
malrik/there_is_id_like_9a985c3c.text: There is. I'd like to sleep through one of them.

malrik/there_she_goes_she_f642cbb7.speaker: malrik
malrik/there_she_goes_she_f642cbb7.text: There she goes. She never looks behind her. Somebody should.

malrik/they_dont_need_it_674a359a.speaker: malrik
malrik/they_dont_need_it_674a359a.text: They don't need it any more. I do. That isn't stealing. It's... inheritance.

malrik/they_say_my_father_d57e7f7b.speaker: malrik
malrik/they_say_my_father_d57e7f7b.text: They say my father robs graves. My father can't rob a pie off a windowsill.

malrik/they_will_stand_there_52f7eb60.speaker: malrik
malrik/they_will_stand_there_52f7eb60.text: They will stand there and tell me to stop. Fire. Roots. An old man's storm.

malrik/those_are_mine_were_d61a1367.speaker: malrik
malrik/those_are_mine_were_d61a1367.text: Those are mine. Were mine. They followed the stone. They'll follow it into the ground.

malrik/three_relics_little_ember_f629f2a.speaker: malrik
malrik/three_relics_little_ember_f629f2a.text: Three relics, little ember. Hand them over and I'll let you keep the hat.

malrik/three_secrets_now_the_a081bb73.speaker: malrik
malrik/three_secrets_now_the_a081bb73.text: Three secrets. Now the whole town can hear them. Where's that bell?

malrik/today_we_finish_aurivane_64ae5f40.speaker: malrik
malrik/today_we_finish_aurivane_64ae5f40.text: Today we finish Aurivane, Torvald. Take the rock. I will handle the sky.

malrik/too_fourth_of_four_de85a128.speaker: malrik
malrik/too_fourth_of_four_de85a128.text: Too. Fourth of four. Fire was his joy, ice his patience, the wood his heart.

malrik/torvald_come_in_i_fd182282.speaker: malrik
malrik/torvald_come_in_i_fd182282.text: Torvald. Come in. I was just mourning.

malrik/torvald_now_both_bridges_9a488586.speaker: malrik
malrik/torvald_now_both_bridges_9a488586.text: Torvald, now. Both bridges. Let them choose which kingdom to lose.

malrik/torvald_the_east_bank_0f158a86.speaker: malrik
malrik/torvald_the_east_bank_0f158a86.text: Torvald, the east bank is yours. I will take the water. Hush, take whatever moves.

malrik/torvald_you_never_said_97a18d32.speaker: malrik
malrik/torvald_you_never_said_97a18d32.text: Torvald! You never said no to anyone in your life. Why start with me?

malrik/truces_are_what_weak_2931a710.speaker: malrik
malrik/truces_are_what_weak_2931a710.text: Truces are what weak men sign to sleep. You signed one with me, Torvald.

malrik/two_ysolde_will_count_632abf53.speaker: malrik
malrik/two_ysolde_will_count_632abf53.text: Two. Ysolde will count her sacks at dawn and come up short.

malrik/useful_do_not_get_30113307.speaker: malrik
malrik/useful_do_not_get_30113307.text: Useful. Do not get comfortable in there.

malrik/vessa_have_you_noticed_99b77995.speaker: malrik
malrik/vessa_have_you_noticed_99b77995.text: Vessa. Have you noticed whose side the winter is on now?

malrik/wagons_not_tents_i_5e634377.speaker: malrik
malrik/wagons_not_tents_i_5e634377.text: Wagons. Not tents. I grew up burying people who starved in tents.

malrik/wars_need_a_first_0af3b832.speaker: malrik
malrik/wars_need_a_first_0af3b832.text: Wars need a first blow. I only provided one.

malrik/we_will_see_who_bd411967.speaker: malrik
malrik/we_will_see_who_bd411967.text: We will see who waits longer, Torvald.

malrik/you_can_help_by_563a0e83.speaker: malrik
malrik/you_can_help_by_563a0e83.text: You can help by being quiet. Stones are usually good at that.

malrik/you_made_me_hungry_e66b6616.speaker: malrik
malrik/you_made_me_hungry_e66b6616.text: You made me hungry. Different thing.

malrik/you_raised_my_dead_6b92f487.speaker: malrik
malrik/you_raised_my_dead_6b92f487.text: You raised my dead, and now you sell me the shovel.

malrik/you_said_that_once_49824a77.speaker: malrik
malrik/you_said_that_once_49824a77.text: You said that once before, in your hall. "For now," you said.

malrik/you_taught_us_to_cdd26f26.speaker: malrik
malrik/you_taught_us_to_cdd26f26.text: You taught us to use what we were given. I was given leftovers. I used them.

malrik/your_lake_holds_the_f902ee86.speaker: malrik
malrik/your_lake_holds_the_f902ee86.text: Your lake holds the second relic. She'll come for it. Help me stop her.

malrik/youre_not_one_of_a1c1c21d.speaker: malrik
malrik/youre_not_one_of_a1c1c21d.text: You're not one of the Reeve's. Who are you? ...You're very tall.

malrik/youve_found_your_voice_5ec35afa.speaker: malrik
malrik/youve_found_your_voice_5ec35afa.text: You've found your voice. Pity. I liked you better as a whisper.

malrik/ysolde_step_aside_i_6f3c6bc7.speaker: malrik
malrik/ysolde_step_aside_i_6f3c6bc7.text: Ysolde! Step aside. I only want the tree.

malrik/ysolde_you_are_herding_ab197f06.speaker: malrik
malrik/ysolde_you_are_herding_ab197f06.text: Ysolde. You are herding sheep while I take your river. That is very you.

master/a_promise_i_made_64b7204a.speaker: master
master/a_promise_i_made_64b7204a.text: A promise I made to a stone. Something will come for it. Every winter.

master/a_sapling_coaxed_through_e4c497e1.speaker: master
master/a_sapling_coaxed_through_e4c497e1.text: A sapling, coaxed through the frost. In this cold?

master/a_thousand_years_i_f9c84268.speaker: master
master/a_thousand_years_i_f9c84268.text: A thousand years I held the world in one hand.

master/again_all_four_i_3f31022a.speaker: master
master/again_all_four_i_3f31022a.text: Again. All four. I am right beneath you.

master/aldra_stillwater_stay_with_3d554a.speaker: master
master/aldra_stillwater_stay_with_3d554a.text: Aldra Stillwater. Stay with it. The ice keeps its wardens.

master/all_four_of_you_02b63bbb.speaker: master
master/all_four_of_you_02b63bbb.text: All four of you, or none.

master/all_winter_for_men_247ba47b.speaker: master
master/all_winter_for_men_247ba47b.text: All winter? For men who were not coming?

master/and_for_a_thousand_0721b136.speaker: master
master/and_for_a_thousand_0721b136.text: And for a thousand years, the peace held. In one hand.

master/and_that_child_is_ccc7017f.speaker: master
master/and_that_child_is_ccc7017f.text: ...and that, child, is the end of the tale.

master/and_the_green_covered_f07668c6.speaker: master
master/and_the_green_covered_f07668c6.text: And the green covered every road. And every grave.

master/and_the_throne_stayed_6bf86fe6.speaker: master
master/and_the_throne_stayed_6bf86fe6.text: And the throne stayed empty. That was the peace: four hands, not one.

master/and_the_world_grew_4d19f924.speaker: master
master/and_the_world_grew_4d19f924.text: And the world grew very quiet. And very obedient.

master/armies_have_not_broken_946bc99e.speaker: master
master/armies_have_not_broken_946bc99e.text: Armies have not broken him, nor winters, nor time.

master/burn_her_forest_down_16f3dda5.speaker: master
master/burn_her_forest_down_16f3dda5.text: Burn her forest down, and it grows back. Every spring. Every time.

master/but_he_is_never_adfcea4c.speaker: master
master/but_he_is_never_adfcea4c.text: But he is never full. Whatever he holds, he wants more.

master/but_he_waits_too_7019f3d6.speaker: master
master/but_he_waits_too_7019f3d6.text: But he waits too long, and trusts slow ice more than quick friends.

master/but_she_never_waits_a66dd99c.speaker: master
master/but_she_never_waits_a66dd99c.text: But she never waits. And fire that will not wait burns its own house.

master/but_she_will_not_f0c2364f.speaker: master
master/but_she_will_not_f0c2364f.text: But she will not take a side, not even while the world burns.

master/dragons_great_and_small_d6939132.speaker: master
master/dragons_great_and_small_d6939132.text: Dragons great and small filled its sky, and not one breathed in anger.

master/five_banners_the_first_3b662c48.speaker: master
master/five_banners_the_first_3b662c48.text: Five banners. The first to hold three while the bell counts thirty wins. Nobody gets hurt.

master/give_her_a_wall_e312dd45.speaker: master
master/give_her_a_wall_e312dd45.text: Give her a wall, and she will burn a door through it.

master/he_raised_four_apprentices_1eed79.speaker: master
master/he_raised_four_apprentices_1eed79.text: He raised four apprentices, and gave each of them a kingdom.

master/he_thinks_i_gave_10970b83.speaker: master
master/he_thinks_i_gave_10970b83.text: He thinks I gave him leftovers. I gave the dark to the one it could not frighten.

master/his_citadel_rose_above_2e36d77d.speaker: master
master/his_citadel_rose_above_2e36d77d.text: His citadel rose above the clouds, a city of towers, bridges and bells.

master/hold_him_there_i_25d68e6a.speaker: master
master/hold_him_there_i_25d68e6a.text: Hold him there. I am almost with you.

master/i_cannot_open_it_0f91d8be.speaker: master
master/i_cannot_open_it_0f91d8be.text: I cannot open it. If I let go, what is under me comes up.

master/i_know_how_that_2d00c245.speaker: master
master/i_know_how_that_2d00c245.text: I know how that tale ends.

master/i_know_that_is_bbd3b3f2.speaker: master
master/i_know_that_is_bbd3b3f2.text: I know. That is why it is his.

master/i_know_this_tale_705bd7cd.speaker: master
master/i_know_this_tale_705bd7cd.text: I know this tale well, child. I was that wizard.

master/i_left_him_my_5d4b36a7.speaker: master
master/i_left_him_my_5d4b36a7.text: I left him my coldest secret. Torvald was my patience.

master/i_loved_all_four_d534ea63.speaker: master
master/i_loved_all_four_d534ea63.text: I loved all four of them. And still, they went to war.

master/i_would_say_show_1f5d14b4.speaker: master
master/i_would_say_show_1f5d14b4.text: I would say: show me again. And she always did. Ysolde was my heart.

master/it_takes_four_hands_2c5a3429.speaker: master
master/it_takes_four_hands_2c5a3429.text: It takes four hands to turn this lock.

master/it_will_not_hold_28cfd713.speaker: master
master/it_will_not_hold_28cfd713.text: It will not hold from up here. Not for long.

master/keep_this_cold_torvald_64738927.speaker: master
master/keep_this_cold_torvald_64738927.text: Keep this cold, Torvald. Keep it until I come back for it.

master/kings_brought_him_their_38ebe69c.speaker: master
master/kings_brought_him_their_38ebe69c.text: Kings brought him their quarrels, and went home as friends.

master/kings_cities_even_you_61dd410b.speaker: master
master/kings_cities_even_you_61dd410b.text: Kings. Cities. Even you four. I gave you kingdoms. You saw gold.

master/later_my_joy_both_e73c3f4a.speaker: master
master/later_my_joy_both_e73c3f4a.text: Later, my joy. Both of you, come up to the orrery. I have something for you.

master/listen_both_of_you_b938da9c.speaker: master
master/listen_both_of_you_b938da9c.text: Listen, both of you. Tell no one what sleeps here. If the world knows, the world will dig.

master/malrik_i_found_him_915e2c7f.speaker: master
master/malrik_i_found_him_915e2c7f.text: Malrik. I found him reading tombstones by the light of one candle.

master/malrik_kept_watch_over_ecbfe16c.speaker: master
master/malrik_kept_watch_over_ecbfe16c.text: Malrik kept watch over the deep. The dark still came when he called.

master/my_first_mistake_his_9bfeba82.speaker: master
master/my_first_mistake_his_9bfeba82.text: My first mistake. His name was Obren.

master/my_joy_you_came_4435f304.speaker: master
master/my_joy_you_came_4435f304.text: My joy. You came all this way.

master/my_regalia_are_its_7580d6b2.speaker: master
master/my_regalia_are_its_7580d6b2.text: My regalia are its keys. When I go, they will scatter. Never let them sit in one hand.

master/no_that_was_the_9f82d4c5.speaker: master
master/no_that_was_the_9f82d4c5.text: No. That was the whole point.

master/not_yet_old_friend_97e676b0.speaker: master
master/not_yet_old_friend_97e676b0.text: Not yet, old friend. Let her find her own fire first.

master/nothing_broke_again_nothing_624ac.speaker: master
master/nothing_broke_again_nothing_624ac.text: Nothing broke again. Nothing moved, either.

master/nothing_is_hidden_from_3efbf049.speaker: master
master/nothing_is_hidden_from_3efbf049.text: Nothing is hidden from him. The dark itself comes when he calls.

master/now_all_four_of_a723a2aa.speaker: master
master/now_all_four_of_a723a2aa.text: Now. All four of you. Turn them, and do not let go.

master/now_winter_has_stopped_13135897.speaker: master
master/now_winter_has_stopped_13135897.text: Now winter has stopped their war, child, and two of them remember how it began.

master/once_upon_a_time_8b62d3e8.speaker: master
master/once_upon_a_time_8b62d3e8.text: Once upon a time, the strongest wizard who ever lived ruled the world.

master/one_more_turn_my_4898e577.speaker: master
master/one_more_turn_my_4898e577.text: One more turn, my four. Then I will come up, and we will talk.

master/reading_tombstones_by_one_5379938.speaker: master
master/reading_tombstones_by_one_5379938.text: Reading tombstones by one candle, at midnight. And they told you everything.

master/she_burned_so_bright_fc0e0bc1.speaker: master
master/she_burned_so_bright_fc0e0bc1.text: She burned so bright that night never came again.

master/smaller_next_time_and_4b89dcdc.speaker: master
master/smaller_next_time_and_4b89dcdc.text: Smaller, next time. And not the barn.

master/so_i_will_not_bea5e899.speaker: master
master/so_i_will_not_bea5e899.text: So I will not hold it again.

master/someone_must_i_have_526e8b07.speaker: master
master/someone_must_i_have_526e8b07.text: Someone must. I have always been the one who must.

master/someone_will_always_want_4f686c72.speaker: master
master/someone_will_always_want_4f686c72.text: Someone will always want that seat. Choose, all four of you.

master/still_she_laughed_like_57d11b3e.speaker: master
master/still_she_laughed_like_57d11b3e.text: Still, she laughed like sunrise. Vessa was my joy.

master/the_harder_i_held_a30e25ee.speaker: master
master/the_harder_i_held_a30e25ee.text: The harder I held, the more it slipped.

master/the_seal_keep_them_eacf4286.speaker: master
master/the_seal_keep_them_eacf4286.text: The seal! Keep them off the stone!

master/the_two_harbour_cities_80ff2b80.speaker: master
master/the_two_harbour_cities_80ff2b80.text: The two harbour cities fought one more duel, and called it a draw.

master/then_between_one_breath_72b919e2.speaker: master
master/then_between_one_breath_72b919e2.text: Then, between one breath and the next, he was gone.

master/then_come_with_me_4926d673.speaker: master
master/then_come_with_me_4926d673.text: Then come with me. I need someone who keeps a light.

master/then_so_will_you_67e66592.speaker: master
master/then_so_will_you_67e66592.text: Then so will you. Every winter. You are my patience, Torvald.

master/then_we_will_both_bb146b98.speaker: master
master/then_we_will_both_bb146b98.text: Then we will both learn patience, Obren. I have had a good teacher.

master/they_called_him_only_31069c93.speaker: master
master/they_called_him_only_31069c93.text: They called him only the Master. For a thousand years, he kept the peace.

master/three_winters_and_not_885c5243.speaker: master
master/three_winters_and_not_885c5243.text: Three winters, and not one stone stood on your ice.

master/torvald_opened_his_gate_da1482d8.speaker: master
master/torvald_opened_his_gate_da1482d8.text: Torvald opened his gate, and he kept it open.

master/torvald_the_eldest_where_f5a25caa.speaker: master
master/torvald_the_eldest_where_f5a25caa.text: Torvald, the eldest. Where he stands, the ice holds, and so does the line.

master/vessa_malrik_the_two_2b96386c.speaker: master
master/vessa_malrik_the_two_2b96386c.text: Vessa. Malrik. The two harbour cities are yours now. Keep them in peace.

master/vessa_rebuilt_my_observatory_8d4c.speaker: master
master/vessa_rebuilt_my_observatory_8d4c.text: Vessa rebuilt my observatory, and taught children their first spark. She learned to wait.

master/vessa_the_youngest_she_0f7ca4c7.speaker: master
master/vessa_the_youngest_she_0f7ca4c7.text: Vessa, the youngest. She lit her first spark before she could spell her name.

master/vessa_would_burn_it_8f9ea272.speaker: master
master/vessa_would_burn_it_8f9ea272.text: Vessa would burn it open to see inside. Malrik would ask what it pays. No.

master/well_so_that_is_a0bf02e4.speaker: master
master/well_so_that_is_a0bf02e4.text: ...Well. So that is where it went.

master/whoever_sits_there_holds_8330a630.speaker: master
master/whoever_sits_there_holds_8330a630.text: Whoever sits there holds the world, as I did.

master/you_did_obren_it_41e9dfeb.speaker: master
master/you_did_obren_it_41e9dfeb.text: You did, Obren. It held me twelve years.

master/ysolde_i_found_her_85d2e563.speaker: master
master/ysolde_i_found_her_85d2e563.text: Ysolde. I found her coaxing a sapling through the frost.

master/ysolde_my_heart_keep_32ac3d92.speaker: master
master/ysolde_my_heart_keep_32ac3d92.text: Ysolde, my heart: keep growing things. Torvald, my patience: wait for me.

master/ysolde_planted_the_hollow_f8d924e.speaker: master
master/ysolde_planted_the_hollow_f8d924e.text: Ysolde planted the Hollow with oaks. She never closed a road again.

master/ysolde_torvald_hold_the_437f2c53.speaker: master
master/ysolde_torvald_hold_the_437f2c53.text: Ysolde. Torvald. Hold the isle. Whatever climbs out of the water must not touch this stone.

messenger/all_of_it_i_dea99842.speaker: messenger
messenger/all_of_it_i_dea99842.text: All of it. I saw it burn.

messenger/fernby_the_the_old_4a37d965.speaker: messenger
messenger/fernby_the_the_old_4a37d965.text: Fernby! The... the old stones are walking. Into the houses!

messenger/frost_on_the_road_3b83ebb9.speaker: messenger
messenger/frost_on_the_road_3b83ebb9.text: Frost on the road! They're going for the Heartseed!

messenger/hollins_cross_please_please_af.speaker: messenger
messenger/hollins_cross_please_please_af.text: Hollins Cross... please. Please, they're... they're at the mill.

messenger/my_lady_pipwell_pipwells_d1307.speaker: messenger
messenger/my_lady_pipwell_pipwells_d1307.text: My lady! Pipwell... Pipwell's burning. They... they asked for you. By name.

messenger/my_lady_the_hollow_9dae7ccd.speaker: messenger
messenger/my_lady_the_hollow_9dae7ccd.text: My lady, the hollow by the camp... it's frosted, but it's... it's still breathing.

messenger/my_lady_youre_really_066bd5bf.speaker: messenger
messenger/my_lady_youre_really_066bd5bf.text: My lady... you're really coming? Out here? With us?

messenger/natures_army_follows_you_36ae7.speaker: messenger
messenger/natures_army_follows_you_36ae7.text: Nature's army follows you down. All of it that can still walk.

messenger/she_said_remember_she_80a331e3.speaker: messenger
messenger/she_said_remember_she_80a331e3.text: She said... remember. She warned you.

messenger/thats_everyone_who_could_2b05a.speaker: messenger
messenger/thats_everyone_who_could_2b05a.text: That's everyone who could still walk.

messenger/thats_twenty_my_lady_2cf85946.speaker: messenger
messenger/thats_twenty_my_lady_2cf85946.text: That's... twenty, my lady. Twenty! The tree's getting... crowded.

messenger/the_ember_queen_which_0214be28.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_ember_queen_which_0214be28.text: The Ember Queen? Which one is...

messenger/the_first_ones_are_97f48f9e.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_first_ones_are_97f48f9e.text: The first ones are... they're ready, my lady. Ring the lantern and... they'll go.

messenger/the_hearts_slowing_please_4543.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_hearts_slowing_please_4543.text: The heart's slowing! Please don't let it stop!

messenger/the_heartwood_is_past_e8569950.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_heartwood_is_past_e8569950.text: The Heartwood is past the old tree. She's inside it.

messenger/the_heartwoods_down_but_7054cf.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_heartwoods_down_but_7054cf.text: The Heartwood's down! But we're still with you!

messenger/the_shadows_in_the_521a96cb.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_shadows_in_the_521a96cb.text: The Shadow's in the camp! Wake up!

messenger/up_the_hill_leave_daf330b5.speaker: messenger
messenger/up_the_hill_leave_daf330b5.text: Up the hill! Leave the... leave the goats! Up to the golden tree!

messenger/we_we_lost_too_a54f6deb.speaker: messenger
messenger/we_we_lost_too_a54f6deb.text: We... we lost too many on the road. My lady, we can't... we can't go on.

messenger/weve_lost_too_many_3aa0603f.speaker: messenger
messenger/weve_lost_too_many_3aa0603f.text: We've lost too many carriers. The seed's running out.

messenger/youre_alive_go_south_50077fa7.speaker: messenger
messenger/youre_alive_go_south_50077fa7.text: You're alive! Go south, follow the red banners!

narrator/a_hundred_winters_ago_27c450eb.speaker: narrator
narrator/a_hundred_winters_ago_27c450eb.text: A hundred winters ago, the lake had no name, and the north had one keeper.

narrator/a_hundred_winters_broken_6eff91.speaker: narrator
narrator/a_hundred_winters_broken_6eff91.text: A hundred winters, broken in one afternoon. The Wall begins to weep.

narrator/a_hundred_years_the_e560f172.speaker: narrator
narrator/a_hundred_years_the_e560f172.text: A hundred years the jailer stood over the door. Tonight Malrik's stone told it to open it.

narrator/a_quiet_field_something_49af4d7.speaker: narrator
narrator/a_quiet_field_something_49af4d7.text: A quiet field. Something is about to happen.
