narrator/across_the_river_the_5b1fd132.speaker: narrator
narrator/across_the_river_the_5b1fd132.text: Across the river, the Lark horns call the whole valley to arms.

narrator/and_for_the_first_887ec3c4.speaker: narrator
narrator/and_for_the_first_887ec3c4.text: And for the first time in twelve years, the Sunrise Road saw its sunrise.

narrator/and_found_the_last_d595ceab.speaker: narrator
narrator/and_found_the_last_d595ceab.text: and found the last green country: Evenmead.

narrator/and_the_ground_ran_1a9ad655.speaker: narrator
narrator/and_the_ground_ran_1a9ad655.text: And the ground ran one way. Down, into the Hollow.

narrator/and_then_one_grey_327ac79a.speaker: narrator
narrator/and_then_one_grey_327ac79a.text: And then, one grey morning, the snow began to turn to water.

narrator/at_dawn_the_war_5d1764bd.speaker: narrator
narrator/at_dawn_the_war_5d1764bd.text: At dawn, the war would come home to where it started.

narrator/at_dusk_the_south_3f40d6d0.speaker: narrator
narrator/at_dusk_the_south_3f40d6d0.text: At dusk the south watch rode home along a road of fire.

narrator/at_midnight_the_bell_5afa57f7.speaker: narrator
narrator/at_midnight_the_bell_5afa57f7.text: At midnight the bell of Wickmoor rang, and every window in the town lit.

narrator/cinderwatch_on_the_fire_2bba781.speaker: narrator
narrator/cinderwatch_on_the_fire_2bba781.text: Cinderwatch, on the Fire border. Every bed is taken, and one lantern is still lit.

narrator/crown_hollow_where_the_6aaed2b2.speaker: narrator
narrator/crown_hollow_where_the_6aaed2b2.text: Crown Hollow. Where the Master once sat, two armies wait for the sun.

narrator/dawn_came_to_emberfall_3a15cf81.speaker: narrator
narrator/dawn_came_to_emberfall_3a15cf81.text: Dawn came to Emberfall, and so did the Emberguard.

narrator/dawn_came_up_over_260ffe77.speaker: narrator
narrator/dawn_came_up_over_260ffe77.text: Dawn came up over Lark Hill, and the wagons rolled on.

narrator/duskbarrow_city_of_crypts_0629e.speaker: narrator
narrator/duskbarrow_city_of_crypts_0629e.text: Duskbarrow, city of crypts. Its bishop came home with a stone, and the dead got up to meet it.

narrator/duskbarrow_the_city_of_b9659384.speaker: narrator
narrator/duskbarrow_the_city_of_b9659384.text: Duskbarrow. The city of the dead, where Malrik learned to read by tombstone light.

narrator/evenmead_the_last_green_cabba6e.speaker: narrator
narrator/evenmead_the_last_green_cabba6e.text: Evenmead. The last green country. By sundown, someone will own the ford.

narrator/far_away_three_apprentices_c4c4.speaker: narrator
narrator/far_away_three_apprentices_c4c4.text: Far away, three apprentices feel the crown wake up, and begin to worry.

narrator/fire_and_thunder_took_330f899d.speaker: narrator
narrator/fire_and_thunder_took_330f899d.text: Fire and thunder took the ridge, and the Bishop's winter melted away.

narrator/fire_is_at_war_9101ffca.speaker: narrator
narrator/fire_is_at_war_9101ffca.text: Fire is at war with Shadow, while Ice and Nature watch. Under the world, something is counting.

narrator/first_light_on_lark_8660f9a5.speaker: narrator
narrator/first_light_on_lark_8660f9a5.text: First light. On Lark Hill, Vessa found her wagons. She did not wait.

narrator/five_glades_green_at_72196919.speaker: narrator
narrator/five_glades_green_at_72196919.text: Five glades, green at once. Deep under the ash, something old turns over.

narrator/five_years_later_below_309cfb16.speaker: narrator
narrator/five_years_later_below_309cfb16.text: Five years later, below the citadel. A friendly match. Supposedly.

narrator/for_the_first_time_95ef5652.speaker: narrator
narrator/for_the_first_time_95ef5652.text: For the first time in a hundred years, the green went out of its own border.

narrator/for_the_first_time_ed1db173.speaker: narrator
narrator/for_the_first_time_ed1db173.text: For the first time since the Master left, the four apprentices stood in one place.

narrator/forty_winters_ago_the_c09e0cf2.speaker: narrator
narrator/forty_winters_ago_the_c09e0cf2.text: Forty winters ago. The gate had stood for sixty years, and never once opened.

narrator/four_keyholes_four_colours_9a15.speaker: narrator
narrator/four_keyholes_four_colours_9a15.text: Four keyholes, four colours, one ring of light around the isle.

narrator/four_kingdoms_on_one_e95a1105.speaker: narrator
narrator/four_kingdoms_on_one_e95a1105.text: Four kingdoms on one field, and every banner pointed the same way. It had never happened.

narrator/four_wizards_four_fires_a9cb779.speaker: narrator
narrator/four_wizards_four_fires_a9cb779.text: Four wizards, four fires, one long winter. And each of them remembered how it began.

narrator/glasswater_mere_has_not_11b716c.speaker: narrator
narrator/glasswater_mere_has_not_11b716c.text: Glasswater Mere has not thawed in a hundred winters. Something at the bottom still shines.

narrator/green_in_the_sighing_01a084da.speaker: narrator
narrator/green_in_the_sighing_01a084da.text: Green, in the Sighing Wood. For the first time since the fire.

narrator/he_pinched_out_his_4c73a198.speaker: narrator
narrator/he_pinched_out_his_4c73a198.text: He pinched out his candle. In the dark, he was not afraid. He never had been.

narrator/he_told_himself_it_e1d104bf.speaker: narrator
narrator/he_told_himself_it_e1d104bf.text: He told himself it was only one ring. It was never only one.

narrator/he_went_down_that_97d4ba9b.speaker: narrator
narrator/he_went_down_that_97d4ba9b.text: He went down that same night, to hold the door from below. He never said for how long.

narrator/in_the_west_ysolde_9b7462a6.speaker: narrator
narrator/in_the_west_ysolde_9b7462a6.text: In the west, Ysolde remembered a different winter.

narrator/kettlewick_is_a_ruin_24b76f23.speaker: narrator
narrator/kettlewick_is_a_ruin_24b76f23.text: Kettlewick is a ruin. The gate stayed shut that winter. This column is what's left.

narrator/kettlewick_stands_it_remembe_e5.speaker: narrator
narrator/kettlewick_stands_it_remembe_e5.text: Kettlewick stands. It remembers who opened the gate once. Its shields come too.

narrator/long_before_the_war_3f040592.speaker: narrator
narrator/long_before_the_war_3f040592.text: Long before the war, a girl with soot on her hands came down into the Vale of Bells.

narrator/nature_had_no_kingdom_ffec5004.speaker: narrator
narrator/nature_had_no_kingdom_ffec5004.text: Nature had no kingdom left, only seed. Fire had a border, and a frost fort sitting on it.

narrator/night_fell_the_golden_6384f4b1.speaker: narrator
narrator/night_fell_the_golden_6384f4b1.text: Night fell. The golden tree still stood, and everyone who made it up the hill slept under it.

narrator/night_on_lark_hill_93cdfc64.speaker: narrator
narrator/night_on_lark_hill_93cdfc64.text: Night on Lark Hill. Two armies asleep in their armour, and one woman who never sleeps.

narrator/night_under_the_golden_a47c1e43.speaker: narrator
narrator/night_under_the_golden_a47c1e43.text: Night under the golden tree. Every family made it up the hill, and nobody can sleep.

narrator/old_mossjaw_wakes_in_0ace1275.speaker: narrator
narrator/old_mossjaw_wakes_in_0ace1275.text: Old Mossjaw wakes in the Hollowfen, and he is hungry.

narrator/on_the_far_road_84969558.speaker: narrator
narrator/on_the_far_road_84969558.text: On the far road, the south watch's scouts saw the fire and turned their horses home.

narrator/on_the_longest_night_01dd2188.speaker: narrator
narrator/on_the_longest_night_01dd2188.text: On the longest night, the pack's old leader came down from the ridge.

narrator/out_of_the_cracked_39245c00.speaker: narrator
narrator/out_of_the_cracked_39245c00.text: Out of the cracked north comes a long dark line: carts, old men, children, and the hunt behind.

narrator/rookhold_burned_until_mornin_4a.speaker: narrator
narrator/rookhold_burned_until_mornin_4a.text: Rookhold burned until morning. So, by accident, did the grain it had stolen.

narrator/shadow_from_the_east_be71340a.speaker: narrator
narrator/shadow_from_the_east_be71340a.text: Shadow from the east, frost from the north. The two new friends close the vice.

narrator/she_did_for_twenty_46abbae6.speaker: narrator
narrator/she_did_for_twenty_46abbae6.text: She did. For twenty years, until he was gone.

narrator/smoke_over_the_farms_8aa1a1f3.speaker: narrator
narrator/smoke_over_the_farms_8aa1a1f3.text: Smoke over the farms. Whoever was still there is not coming up the hill.

narrator/south_of_the_wall_8f72fb65.speaker: narrator
narrator/south_of_the_wall_8f72fb65.text: South of the wall, the lamps of Hearthwick went out one by one.

narrator/spring_after_the_coinwater_6a68.speaker: narrator
narrator/spring_after_the_coinwater_6a68.text: Spring, after the Coinwater. Every battle of this war had soaked into the ground.

narrator/spring_at_crown_hollow_b83e0d12.speaker: narrator
narrator/spring_at_crown_hollow_b83e0d12.text: Spring at Crown Hollow. Three keys are still on the road. One is already here, of course.

narrator/spring_came_late_to_e6342588.speaker: narrator
narrator/spring_came_late_to_e6342588.text: Spring came late to the lake, and stayed only a little while.

narrator/ten_families_under_the_c4460b27.speaker: narrator
narrator/ten_families_under_the_c4460b27.text: Ten families under the tree. The goats, mostly, made it too.

narrator/that_night_the_first_73bcc592.speaker: narrator
narrator/that_night_the_first_73bcc592.text: That night the first blizzard closed the passes. Both sides sat down to wait for spring.

narrator/the_bishop_walked_out_456919b1.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_bishop_walked_out_456919b1.text: The Bishop walked out of his city with the stone in his fist, and for once the fist stayed shut.

narrator/the_blizzard_closed_the_14609da.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_blizzard_closed_the_14609da.text: The blizzard closed the passes, and the war sat down to wait.

narrator/the_closed_road_for_c5842138.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_closed_road_for_c5842138.text: The Closed Road. For a hundred years nobody came in. For a hundred years she never went out.

narrator/the_door_held_the_a0cc4fc5.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_door_held_the_a0cc4fc5.text: The door held. The war went looking for open ground,

narrator/the_evening_horn_malriks_97200b.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_evening_horn_malriks_97200b.text: The evening horn. Malrik's whole host comes down to the water.

narrator/the_first_winter_came_92e4a024.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_first_winter_came_92e4a024.text: The first winter came down from the north, and it did not come alone.

narrator/the_ford_fell_at_464edfdf.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_ford_fell_at_464edfdf.text: The ford fell at dusk. The golden tree still stood. Both hills called it a victory.

narrator/the_hundredwinter_gate_someo_cc.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_hundredwinter_gate_someo_cc.text: The Hundredwinter Gate. Someone is knocking on it. Someone always was.

narrator/the_lake_froze_around_7b259b0b.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_lake_froze_around_7b259b0b.text: The lake froze around the Heartfrost that night. It did not thaw for a hundred winters.

narrator/the_last_of_them_b408dc22.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_last_of_them_b408dc22.text: The last of them leave Larkrest. Behind them, the green road goes quiet.

narrator/the_last_thing_obren_c3bdfaca.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_last_thing_obren_c3bdfaca.text: The last thing Obren ever built climbed out of the dark, and it was wearing his throne.

narrator/the_last_tide_climbs_29dceb4d.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_last_tide_climbs_29dceb4d.text: The last tide climbs out of the Hollow. On the hills behind it, three banners rise.

narrator/the_master_is_gone_e050d7b6.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_master_is_gone_e050d7b6.text: The Master is gone. His crown is not.

narrator/the_millers_boys_took_b81ec6f0.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_millers_boys_took_b81ec6f0.text: The miller's boys took down their bows from the wall. Nobody had asked them to.

narrator/the_morning_after_lark_66326315.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_morning_after_lark_66326315.text: The morning after Lark Hill. The wagons burned in the night. The people will have to walk.

narrator/the_ridge_fell_to_caa48395.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_ridge_fell_to_caa48395.text: The ridge fell to Shadow. Torvald had heard the stone say his name. He did not forget it.

narrator/the_salt_road_runs_e832db6b.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_salt_road_runs_e832db6b.text: The Salt Road runs from Emberfall to the sea. Everything on it has a price, even the road.

narrator/the_same_afternoon_from_6340b38.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_same_afternoon_from_6340b38.text: The same afternoon, from the other hill. Here nobody counts fords. They count people.

narrator/the_same_winter_far_1d3b6b43.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_same_winter_far_1d3b6b43.text: The same winter, far to the east, the other apprentice remembered too.

narrator/the_shadows_of_the_6774f179.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_shadows_of_the_6774f179.text: The shadows of the old graves stood up, and waited for him to speak.

narrator/the_sighing_wood_at_2fb893ea.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_sighing_wood_at_2fb893ea.text: The Sighing Wood, at the edge of winter. Burnt by Shadow, frozen by Ice, and not dead yet.

narrator/the_sighing_wood_has_86f071de.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_sighing_wood_has_86f071de.text: The Sighing Wood has kept out of every quarrel for a hundred years. Today two armies walked in.

narrator/the_sighing_wood_kept_058db674.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_sighing_wood_kept_058db674.text: The Sighing Wood kept out of every quarrel for a century. Now it is ash, and the ash is frozen.

narrator/the_snow_buried_his_1c3944c3.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_snow_buried_his_1c3944c3.text: The snow buried his signal fire. Torvald watched it go out.

narrator/the_sunrise_road_the_27a4fd73.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_sunrise_road_the_27a4fd73.text: The Sunrise Road. The Master cut it before the kingdoms had names. No one has walked it since.

narrator/the_third_winter_was_b7c3755e.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_third_winter_was_b7c3755e.text: The third winter was the longest. The Hollow sent everything it had left.

narrator/the_vigils_burned_again_c72c8aa.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_vigils_burned_again_c72c8aa.text: The vigils burned again in Duskbarrow. In the Bishop's pocket, the stone kept count.

narrator/the_war_itself_was_c73d3bf6.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_war_itself_was_c73d3bf6.text: The war itself was opening the door.

narrator/the_war_was_coming_a1185405.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_war_was_coming_a1185405.text: The war was coming to the Sighing Wood, invited or not.

narrator/the_wardens_are_rubble_22f02c05.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_wardens_are_rubble_22f02c05.text: The wardens are rubble. The Winterheart stands alone, and it is cracking.

narrator/the_westwatch_fire_rises_d7e80c.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_westwatch_fire_rises_d7e80c.text: The Westwatch fire rises. Riders who remember the old kingdom ride to meet it.

narrator/then_the_isle_split_8e8ee516.speaker: narrator
narrator/then_the_isle_split_8e8ee516.text: Then the isle split, and the amber came up through the stones.

narrator/thirty_two_winters_ago_e9ae37d4.speaker: narrator
narrator/thirty_two_winters_ago_e9ae37d4.text: Thirty-two winters ago, the frost came back to Evenmead. Nothing grew. Again.

narrator/three_days_later_malrik_fc11b25.speaker: narrator
narrator/three_days_later_malrik_fc11b25.text: Three days later. Malrik came back from Duskbarrow to a ridge that smelled of thunder.

narrator/three_flames_answer_the_69a7547.speaker: narrator
narrator/three_flames_answer_the_69a7547.text: Three flames answer. The seal cracks, and the old wardens wake up grumpy.

narrator/three_summers_on_the_275b65a7.speaker: narrator
narrator/three_summers_on_the_275b65a7.text: Three summers on, the reivers built a fort in the fens. Vessa was sent to knock.

narrator/three_years_later_he_97f06c85.speaker: narrator
narrator/three_years_later_he_97f06c85.text: Three years later he was gone, and the peace he gave them was the first thing they spent.

narrator/torvalds_frontier_a_week_27c59e.speaker: narrator
narrator/torvalds_frontier_a_week_27c59e.text: Torvald's frontier, a week before the snows. A wall older than any of the four.

narrator/twelve_years_ago_the_f792a063.speaker: narrator
narrator/twelve_years_ago_the_f792a063.text: Twelve years ago. The Master sent for two of his four. Only two.

narrator/two_barrows_sleep_the_beebc31e.speaker: narrator
narrator/two_barrows_sleep_the_beebc31e.text: Two barrows sleep. The stone does not like the quiet.

narrator/two_days_after_emberfall_c788eb.speaker: narrator
narrator/two_days_after_emberfall_c788eb.text: Two days after Emberfall, the Bishop of Shadow went north.

narrator/two_kingdoms_on_one_59a004bb.speaker: narrator
narrator/two_kingdoms_on_one_59a004bb.text: Two kingdoms on one bank, two across the water. Now it is a real war.

narrator/two_of_the_four_18dba4f1.speaker: narrator
narrator/two_of_the_four_18dba4f1.text: Two of the four knew where he had gone. For twelve years, they told no one.

narrator/two_relics_answer_to_e03dc527.speaker: narrator
narrator/two_relics_answer_to_e03dc527.text: Two relics answer to fire. In the north, Ice watches, and says nothing.

narrator/two_relics_one_enemy_8906edef.speaker: narrator
narrator/two_relics_one_enemy_8906edef.text: Two relics. One enemy. One very tired army.

narrator/under_the_frost_very_eeb2e314.speaker: narrator
narrator/under_the_frost_very_eeb2e314.text: Under the frost, very slowly, the Sighing Wood began to breathe again.

narrator/under_the_roots_of_d20b9974.speaker: narrator
narrator/under_the_roots_of_d20b9974.text: Under the roots of the world, a door. And on the other side of it, the one who made it.

narrator/when_the_sun_went_2c958d0c.speaker: narrator
narrator/when_the_sun_went_2c958d0c.text: When the sun went down, the frost bit through everything that was not covered.

narrator/wickmoor_buried_its_dead_841eca.speaker: narrator
narrator/wickmoor_buried_its_dead_841eca.text: Wickmoor buried its dead with their rings on. Lately, someone had been taking them back.

ossavar/and_now_the_old_0f23a619.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/and_now_the_old_0f23a619.text: And now the old price. Me. Whoever pays the most, I burn for.

ossavar/and_you_sheltered_the_e9ef9287.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/and_you_sheltered_the_e9ef9287.text: And you sheltered the Outwall when nobody paid. I remember debts.

ossavar/dawn_came_up_on_5098e143.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/dawn_came_up_on_5098e143.text: Dawn came up on a sea that did not move. The second time in my long life.

ossavar/diamonds_were_never_enough_d70f7.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/diamonds_were_never_enough_d70f7.text: Diamonds were never enough for her. Morrow, fly south.

ossavar/every_dragon_on_the_6066492a.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/every_dragon_on_the_6066492a.text: Every dragon on the Coinwater changes sides in one morning. I have seen this before.

ossavar/first_blood_and_no_453ba0a2.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/first_blood_and_no_453ba0a2.text: First blood, and no further. The cities forgot. Let us see if you remember.

ossavar/gold_for_fire_they_6be55af0.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/gold_for_fire_they_6be55af0.text: Gold for fire, they say. He paid in neither.

ossavar/gold_from_the_south_6743ce70.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/gold_from_the_south_6743ce70.text: Gold from the south. Kesh, burn the north.

ossavar/he_knew_the_truth_90b7dafd.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/he_knew_the_truth_90b7dafd.text: He knew the truth, and he waited anyway. He always did.

ossavar/he_walked_out_once_1d815ac0.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/he_walked_out_once_1d815ac0.text: He walked out once, and the sea went still. Your turn, Ice-king. Go to the light.

ossavar/i_have_heard_that_9a73700c.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/i_have_heard_that_9a73700c.text: I have heard that word once before. It sounded better from you.

ossavar/morrow_of_glass_my_5b2f3da9.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/morrow_of_glass_my_5b2f3da9.text: Morrow-of-Glass, my daughter. She remembers both your grandfathers' coin.

ossavar/night_in_adamarch_everyone_f0345.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/night_in_adamarch_everyone_f0345.text: Night in Adamarch. Everyone was counting coin. Torvald counted one gift.

ossavar/one_small_sale_before_2a2e9ab8.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/one_small_sale_before_2a2e9ab8.text: One small sale before the great one. Sunwake, Aurivane's pride. Who pays?

ossavar/paid_to_go_home_dfe21282.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/paid_to_go_home_dfe21282.text: Paid to go home. The one price he never tried.

ossavar/sunwake_keeps_her_old_f78715f1.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/sunwake_keeps_her_old_f78715f1.text: Sunwake keeps her old masters. For now.

ossavar/the_admiralty_that_night_3b12d5d.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/the_admiralty_that_night_3b12d5d.text: The Admiralty, that night. Malrik was in mourning. He had lit every lamp.

ossavar/the_first_of_my_eec5ca8b.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/the_first_of_my_eec5ca8b.text: The first of my brood. Kesh burns bright, and cheap. Who pays?

ossavar/the_hall_of_silence_c7750ec4.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/the_hall_of_silence_c7750ec4.text: The Hall of Silence, where they teach one word a day. Malrik brought more.

ossavar/the_last_tide_ice_3b34d4a9.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/the_last_tide_ice_3b34d4a9.text: The last tide, Ice-king. The cities always send the biggest boats just before morning.

ossavar/the_laurel_was_broken_24db5254.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/the_laurel_was_broken_24db5254.text: The Laurel was broken by knives. Gold cloaks. Violet smoke. Somebody lied on my rock.

ossavar/the_one_price_i_8d3f2e80.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/the_one_price_i_8d3f2e80.text: The one price I ever gave back.

ossavar/the_outwall_where_the_6f744ab5.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/the_outwall_where_the_6f744ab5.text: The Outwall. Where the coin is earned, and never spent.

ossavar/the_sky_has_chosen_5c079ced.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/the_sky_has_chosen_5c079ced.text: The sky has chosen its master, and it is not you.

ossavar/the_year_of_two_ce069fdf.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/the_year_of_two_ce069fdf.text: The Year of Two Skies comes round again. Every ship. Every dragon. One strait.

ossavar/tomorrow_ask_the_herald_3f19b1e0.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/tomorrow_ask_the_herald_3f19b1e0.text: Tomorrow, ask the herald where the knives came from.

ossavar/tomorrow_your_friend_buys_8434c5.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/tomorrow_your_friend_buys_8434c5.text: Tomorrow your friend buys the whole sky. Ask him what he means to burn.

ossavar/twice_each_i_said_19d36288.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/twice_each_i_said_19d36288.text: Twice each, I said. Let us make it three.

ossavar/two_cities_two_lies_eb7137d4.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/two_cities_two_lies_eb7137d4.text: Two cities, two lies, one rock. The rock, at least, is honest.

ossavar/two_harbours_one_rock_f9b4e237.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/two_harbours_one_rock_f9b4e237.text: Two harbours, one rock, a sky for sale. Bring gold. I take no promises.

ossavar/you_did_not_pay_f509b897.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/you_did_not_pay_f509b897.text: You did not pay for that, Ice-king. Nobody paid for that. I will remember.

ossavar/you_guarded_stones_everyone_79c1.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/you_guarded_stones_everyone_79c1.text: You guarded stones. Everyone guards stones.

ossavar/you_hold_my_rock_16a5a2af.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/you_hold_my_rock_16a5a2af.text: You hold my rock. Look under the cloths. The dead are poor liars.

ossavar/you_never_bought_me_a816e8d8.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/you_never_bought_me_a816e8d8.text: You never bought me, Ice-king. That is why I will fly with you.

ossavar/you_paid_me_once_3eb14b55.speaker: ossavar
ossavar/you_paid_me_once_3eb14b55.text: You paid me once, Ice-king, in clean coin. That bond still holds. I fly with you.

pell/a_bazaar_look_at_ecd96f30.speaker: pell
pell/a_bazaar_look_at_ecd96f30.text: A Bazaar! Look at it. Smell it. Now put wheels on something and send it somewhere far.

pell/a_war_terrible_wonderful_a6a5a036.speaker: pell
pell/a_war_terrible_wonderful_a6a5a036.text: A war! Terrible. Wonderful for business. Terrible.

pell/did_somebody_say_a_22f514a8.speaker: pell
pell/did_somebody_say_a_22f514a8.text: Did somebody say a trade road?

pell/free_at_last_buy_f2b6c6c4.speaker: pell
pell/free_at_last_buy_f2b6c6c4.text: Free at last! Buy something, would you? Shadow soldiers are terrible customers. They never pay, they just loom.

pell/genuine_relic_polish_for_9388c0ef.speaker: pell
pell/genuine_relic_polish_for_9388c0ef.text: Genuine relic polish! For your keys! Four keys, four customers, I can't lose.

pell/gold_your_first_gold_b6620284.speaker: pell
pell/gold_your_first_gold_b6620284.text: Gold! Your first gold. I'm not crying. It's the salt.

pell/last_stall_before_the_5537319d.speaker: pell
pell/last_stall_before_the_5537319d.text: Last stall before the end of the world! Again! I'm getting good at these.

pell/last_stall_before_the_7f02c05c.speaker: pell
pell/last_stall_before_the_7f02c05c.text: Last stall before the end of the world! Everything must go. Including me, quickly.

pell/robbing_malriks_wagons_youre_38f381.speaker: pell
pell/robbing_malriks_wagons_youre_38f381.text: Robbing Malrik's wagons! You're a natural. I've never been prouder.

pell/rocks_become_gold_at_797e0200.speaker: pell
pell/rocks_become_gold_at_797e0200.text: Rocks become gold at a post, my queen. Gold becomes everything else. Trust a professional.

pell/they_took_the_tribute_28a7156d.speaker: pell
pell/they_took_the_tribute_28a7156d.text: They took the tribute! Get it back! That gold has my fingerprints on it!

pell/you_again_my_wheels_6ee99e5f.speaker: pell
pell/you_again_my_wheels_6ee99e5f.text: You again! My wheels froze to the road, so I suppose I'm open. Take this, it's on the house. The house is frozen too.

pell/you_again_the_fire_a57ffab3.speaker: pell
pell/you_again_the_fire_a57ffab3.text: You again! The fire one. Last time you let me out of a cage. Today I let you into a market.

pell/you_again_you_left_159865ec.speaker: pell
pell/you_again_you_left_159865ec.text: You again! You left me in that cage, you know. I escaped. On my own. Thank you for asking.

reeve/clever_boy_clever_boys_4219b8af.speaker: reeve
reeve/clever_boy_clever_boys_4219b8af.text: Clever boy. Clever boys have accidents in graveyards.

reeve/every_lantern_in_wickmoor_fc132574.speaker: reeve
reeve/every_lantern_in_wickmoor_fc132574.text: Every lantern in Wickmoor, up! Find me that boy!

reeve/lanterns_up_lads_if_e64b7473.speaker: reeve
reeve/lanterns_up_lads_if_e64b7473.text: Lanterns up, lads! If the gravedigger's brat comes sniffing, bring him to me.

reeve/there_something_in_the_e944d55d.speaker: reeve
reeve/there_something_in_the_e944d55d.text: There! Something in the yews! Hoy! Hoy!

reveler/to_vessa_to_the_79ccdcb8.speaker: reveler
reveler/to_vessa_to_the_79ccdcb8.text: To Vessa! To the Ember Queen!

rider/hearthwick_will_remember_thi_82c76.speaker: rider
rider/hearthwick_will_remember_thi_82c76.text: Hearthwick will remember this gate, my lord.

rider/lord_torvald_open_the_4bb78f73.speaker: rider
rider/lord_torvald_open_the_4bb78f73.text: Lord Torvald! Open the gate! The stone-men are in Hearthwick!

rider/thank_you_my_lord_d6f7bebd.speaker: rider
rider/thank_you_my_lord_d6f7bebd.text: Thank you, my lord! I'll bring them home!

rider/theyre_burning_the_houses_e800f63b.speaker: rider
rider/theyre_burning_the_houses_e800f63b.text: They're burning the houses. Two hundred people, my lord. Children.

rider/theyre_through_keep_it_00f0fc46.speaker: rider
rider/theyre_through_keep_it_00f0fc46.text: They're through! Keep it open, the last ones are coming!

rider/you_can_see_the_0616e42f.speaker: rider
rider/you_can_see_the_0616e42f.text: You can see the smoke from up there! You can SEE it!

seraphine/a_truce_sunblade_no_d5a96895.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/a_truce_sunblade_no_d5a96895.text: A truce, Sunblade. No bets. No knives. Just us.

seraphine/adamarch_will_remember_who_0a1.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/adamarch_will_remember_who_0a1.text: Adamarch will remember who stood on the quay with her. Even if the Archon will not.

seraphine/behind_you_dacian_the_93b526e8.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/behind_you_dacian_the_93b526e8.text: Behind you, Dacian! The knives again!

seraphine/gold_cloaks_behind_me_7d1ded5d.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/gold_cloaks_behind_me_7d1ded5d.text: Gold cloaks, behind me. So this is how Aurivane wins now.

seraphine/the_archon_forbade_this_077188.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/the_archon_forbade_this_077188.text: The Archon forbade this. The Hall of Silence can fine me. These are Adamarch's people too.

seraphine/the_barricade_is_down_916f583a.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/the_barricade_is_down_916f583a.text: The barricade is down. Walls should know when to fall. Ours never did.

seraphine/the_east_is_frozen_91b856e7.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/the_east_is_frozen_91b856e7.text: The east is frozen! Dacian, back to back!

seraphine/the_harbour_then_i_648d3d36.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/the_harbour_then_i_648d3d36.text: The harbour, then. I will hold it. It is the one thing today that hasn't lied to me.

seraphine/the_rock_is_adamarchs_9b69cd78.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/the_rock_is_adamarchs_9b69cd78.text: The rock is Adamarch's! The Archon is watching from the spire, Ice-king. So is everyone.

seraphine/the_sunblade_is_down_149dce09.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/the_sunblade_is_down_149dce09.text: The Sunblade is down. Every bell in both cities will ring for war now.

seraphine/then_let_us_disappoint_56e81f9.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/then_let_us_disappoint_56e81f9.text: Then let us disappoint the money.

seraphine/then_your_ally_broke_6ed047c0.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/then_your_ally_broke_6ed047c0.text: Then your ally broke a truce that held for a hundred and thirty years. For what?

seraphine/they_say_adamarch_staged_e03a0.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/they_say_adamarch_staged_e03a0.text: They say Adamarch staged it. I bled on that sand, Ice-king. I would like to know for whom.

seraphine/walls_dont_run_ice_9b12d33b.speaker: seraphine
seraphine/walls_dont_run_ice_9b12d33b.text: Walls don't run, Ice-king. But they can walk, if you walk beside them.

shade/bishop_the_barrows_are_629fbcc7.speaker: shade
shade/bishop_the_barrows_are_629fbcc7.text: Bishop. The barrows are stirring. The living are in the Great Crypt. All of them.

shade/bishop_the_old_ossuary_10cdd70e.speaker: shade
shade/bishop_the_old_ossuary_10cdd70e.text: Bishop, the Old Ossuary is open. The dead are wearing amber.

shade/duskbarrow_bishop_the_barrow_e07a6.speaker: shade
shade/duskbarrow_bishop_the_barrow_e07a6.text: Duskbarrow, Bishop. The barrow candles have gone out. The dead are walking.

shade/the_bishop_sends_his_4a537572.speaker: shade
shade/the_bishop_sends_his_4a537572.text: The Bishop sends his tithe, Lord Torvald. He asks for nothing in return. Yet.

shade/the_crypt_doors_are_298b8a15.speaker: shade
shade/the_crypt_doors_are_298b8a15.text: The crypt doors are cracking! The families are inside!

shade/the_crypt_is_open_2f2d0565.speaker: shade
shade/the_crypt_is_open_2f2d0565.text: The crypt is open... the dead are among the living!

shade/the_keep_sleeps_so_dac3a4b3.speaker: shade
shade/the_keep_sleeps_so_dac3a4b3.text: The keep sleeps. So should you.

shade/the_paupers_field_and_bd671f67.speaker: shade
shade/the_paupers_field_and_bd671f67.text: The Pauper's Field and the Bishops' Rest are open! Everything is walking!

shade/the_second_tithe_lord_93c43a63.speaker: shade
shade/the_second_tithe_lord_93c43a63.text: The second tithe, Lord Torvald. The Bishop says: no more excuses.

shade/they_will_not_see_3a1ecd2d.speaker: shade
shade/they_will_not_see_3a1ecd2d.text: They will not see me coming.

torvald/a_hundred_winters_i_4a3e5778.speaker: torvald
torvald/a_hundred_winters_i_4a3e5778.text: A hundred winters I kept it for him.

torvald/a_man_who_bets_76a0de0d.speaker: torvald
torvald/a_man_who_bets_76a0de0d.text: A man who bets on the war, not the winner. I know only one with that much patience.

torvald/a_peace_that_never_9482da9d.speaker: torvald
torvald/a_peace_that_never_9482da9d.text: A peace that never melts. Never breaks.

torvald/a_talking_stone_wonderful_4a7cce.speaker: torvald
torvald/a_talking_stone_wonderful_4a7cce.text: A talking stone. Wonderful. I was hoping for a quiet century.

torvald/a_white_mask_then_4be4e48d.speaker: torvald
torvald/a_white_mask_then_4be4e48d.text: A white mask. Then I know the knife, and I know the hand that throws it.

torvald/aldra_let_her_plant_ede06f02.speaker: torvald
torvald/aldra_let_her_plant_ede06f02.text: Aldra. Let her plant. We will see what the frost thinks of it.

torvald/aldra_look_a_shoot_ad19f66f.speaker: torvald
torvald/aldra_look_a_shoot_ad19f66f.text: Aldra. Look. A shoot, in the ash. After all of that.

torvald/and_hear_me_some_bce996e4.speaker: torvald
torvald/and_hear_me_some_bce996e4.text: And hear me: some doors under Crown Hollow are closed for a reason.

torvald/aurivanes_cloaks_on_knives_c93ee.speaker: torvald
torvald/aurivanes_cloaks_on_knives_c93ee.text: Aurivane's cloaks, on knives forged in the dark. The edges drink the light. Shadow steel.

torvald/because_a_hundred_winters_55280b.speaker: torvald
torvald/because_a_hundred_winters_55280b.text: Because a hundred winters is long enough. Go home, Ysolde. Spring will keep.

torvald/because_i_finally_saw_e8754eaa.speaker: torvald
torvald/because_i_finally_saw_e8754eaa.text: Because I finally saw what you were buying.

torvald/bigger_ones_of_course_fd184e97.speaker: torvald
torvald/bigger_ones_of_course_fd184e97.text: Bigger ones. Of course there are bigger ones.

torvald/close_it_now_gently_926bcfeb.speaker: torvald
torvald/close_it_now_gently_926bcfeb.text: Close it now. Gently. Everyone is home.

torvald/come_in_get_warm_8c3a893d.speaker: torvald
torvald/come_in_get_warm_8c3a893d.text: Come in. Get warm. There is soup, I'm told. I've never been told that before.

torvald/crown_hollow_then_vessa_b49e6086.speaker: torvald
torvald/crown_hollow_then_vessa_b49e6086.text: Crown Hollow, then. Vessa waited. I can hurry. Watch me.

torvald/did_anyone_see_him_64050081.speaker: torvald
torvald/did_anyone_see_him_64050081.text: Did anyone see him move? No. Nobody ever does.

torvald/easy_who_stepped_out_b42dffa8.speaker: torvald
torvald/easy_who_stepped_out_b42dffa8.text: Easy. Who stepped out of it?

torvald/every_dusk_the_old_c9948c31.speaker: torvald
torvald/every_dusk_the_old_c9948c31.text: Every dusk the old man walks down to the river and looks at us. Then he walks away.

torvald/fly_with_us_then_243cbddd.speaker: torvald
torvald/fly_with_us_then_243cbddd.text: Fly with us, then. And try not to enjoy it.

torvald/for_a_war_that_f990bd9e.speaker: torvald
torvald/for_a_war_that_f990bd9e.text: For a war that does not end. Wars are good for business, and better for that stone.

torvald/for_now_i_sail_c94e8d7f.speaker: torvald
torvald/for_now_i_sail_c94e8d7f.text: For now, I sail with you.

torvald/glass_and_frost_at_3f9e05e7.speaker: torvald
torvald/glass_and_frost_at_3f9e05e7.text: Glass and frost. At least one of us will match the banners.

torvald/go_home_girl_winter_b28eac14.speaker: torvald
torvald/go_home_girl_winter_b28eac14.text: Go home, girl. Winter is coming, and it is bringing guests.

torvald/go_i_will_keep_2ee86eee.speaker: torvald
torvald/go_i_will_keep_2ee86eee.text: Go. I will keep your ridge cold.

torvald/go_south_dont_look_80d1e968.speaker: torvald
torvald/go_south_dont_look_80d1e968.text: Go south. Don't look back. There's nothing back there worth the look.

torvald/good_holding_back_has_4caafb11.speaker: torvald
torvald/good_holding_back_has_4caafb11.text: Good. Holding back has always been my fault, not yours.

torvald/he_called_me_his_4f5bf58f.speaker: torvald
torvald/he_called_me_his_4f5bf58f.text: He called me his patience. Twelve years now, I have waited for him to come back.

torvald/he_gave_me_the_dc9f7ad1.speaker: torvald
torvald/he_gave_me_the_dc9f7ad1.text: He gave me the north. One winter, he gave me a block of ice with a light inside it.

torvald/he_is_held_strike_eb3e1756.speaker: torvald
torvald/he_is_held_strike_eb3e1756.text: He is held. Strike, all of you.

torvald/he_said_i_wait_56554d7f.speaker: torvald
torvald/he_said_i_wait_56554d7f.text: He said I wait too long.

torvald/hearthwick_still_sends_me_3803ac.speaker: torvald
torvald/hearthwick_still_sends_me_3803ac.text: Hearthwick still sends me bread every midwinter. Burnt, usually.

torvald/hold_the_line_ice_d0fbd6bf.speaker: torvald
torvald/hold_the_line_ice_d0fbd6bf.text: Hold the line. Ice knows how. The rest of you, copy me.

torvald/i_always_waited_until_b5388a57.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_always_waited_until_b5388a57.text: I always waited until I saw. Then there was nothing left to see.

torvald/i_am_done_waiting_9b431c0f.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_am_done_waiting_9b431c0f.text: I am done waiting, Malrik. Aldra. Everyone. To the rock.

torvald/i_built_this_wall_874ff8db.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_built_this_wall_874ff8db.text: I built this wall so nobody would ever have to choose. You are making me choose.

torvald/i_came_for_a_3c01c1f3.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_came_for_a_3c01c1f3.text: I came for a ford, Bishop. Not for his tree. My host stops here.

torvald/i_came_to_keep_764e3623.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_came_to_keep_764e3623.text: I came to keep the Coinwater's peace, Malrik. Not to buy a dragon like a cart-horse.

torvald/i_gave_the_wood_952c4f0b.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_gave_the_wood_952c4f0b.text: I gave the wood one winter. I can give it another.

torvald/i_have_never_owned_a052ca89.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_have_never_owned_a052ca89.text: I have never owned anything this old. Except my regrets.

torvald/i_heard_it_ask_1c2809dd.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_heard_it_ask_1c2809dd.text: I heard it ask. I did not hear him say no.

torvald/i_think_i_already_d5837050.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_think_i_already_d5837050.text: I think I already know, old one.

torvald/i_told_malrik_no_ce3f4de1.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_told_malrik_no_ce3f4de1.text: I told Malrik no, once. Then I watched you carry three keys toward the Hollow.

torvald/i_waited_too_long_791e5a29.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_waited_too_long_791e5a29.text: I waited too long again. The lanes are quiet. Too quiet, for a morning.

torvald/i_was_a_boy_4ecd5cb2.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_was_a_boy_4ecd5cb2.text: I was a boy on a mountain pass, keeping a beacon for soldiers who had gone down the road.

torvald/i_will_hold_the_1a672c55.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_will_hold_the_1a672c55.text: I will hold the north stair, Bishop. Do what you came to do, and quickly.

torvald/ice_does_not_march_7aa0021f.speaker: torvald
torvald/ice_does_not_march_7aa0021f.text: Ice does not march for your mistakes, Bishop.

torvald/ice_holds_its_bank_a92a0832.speaker: torvald
torvald/ice_holds_its_bank_a92a0832.text: Ice holds its bank. Malrik, if that stone so much as hums, I'm freezing your pocket.

torvald/ice_is_moving_i_9afa6a52.speaker: torvald
torvald/ice_is_moving_i_9afa6a52.text: Ice is moving. I know. Write it down somewhere.

torvald/ice_is_set_that_18bc0da7.speaker: torvald
torvald/ice_is_set_that_18bc0da7.text: Ice is set. That was quick, for me.

torvald/ice_on_the_north_4d67898f.speaker: torvald
torvald/ice_on_the_north_4d67898f.text: Ice, on the north road. You waited for us, child? Truly?

torvald/ice_stays_out_of_ab8d32c9.speaker: torvald
torvald/ice_stays_out_of_ab8d32c9.text: Ice stays out of this war.

torvald/it_has_been_looking_d3673a8c.speaker: torvald
torvald/it_has_been_looking_d3673a8c.text: It has been looking after itself for a thousand years, Your Radiance. Look where it got them.

torvald/it_was_only_ever_4bcfb212.speaker: torvald
torvald/it_was_only_ever_4bcfb212.text: It was only ever ice. Let her up.

torvald/kettlewick_twice_now_perhaps_5f6.speaker: torvald
torvald/kettlewick_twice_now_perhaps_5f6.text: Kettlewick. Twice now. Perhaps it's a habit.

torvald/malrik_that_light_in_7381eb71.speaker: torvald
torvald/malrik_that_light_in_7381eb71.text: Malrik. That light in your hand. It moved before you did.

torvald/malrik_your_hand_is_e854d9e4.speaker: torvald
torvald/malrik_your_hand_is_e854d9e4.text: Malrik. Your hand is shaking. Is that you, or the stone?

torvald/mother_hush_i_have_bea3ce02.speaker: torvald
torvald/mother_hush_i_have_bea3ce02.text: Mother Hush. I have stood beside this mask in Malrik's camp. They were my ally's knives.

torvald/my_line_is_bending_7fe0592f.speaker: torvald
torvald/my_line_is_bending_7fe0592f.text: My line is bending. Help me hold it. I'm asking. Note that.

torvald/my_ward_is_failing_d4099fb8.speaker: torvald
torvald/my_ward_is_failing_d4099fb8.text: My ward is failing. Help me hold it.

torvald/no_i_dont_think_a562d51a.speaker: torvald
torvald/no_i_dont_think_a562d51a.text: No. I don't think you can.

torvald/no_it_is_the_90d0f9b4.speaker: torvald
torvald/no_it_is_the_90d0f9b4.text: No. It is the one thing I am good at.

torvald/no_my_lake_stays_b15d0433.speaker: torvald
torvald/no_my_lake_stays_b15d0433.text: No. My lake stays out of your war.

torvald/no_not_for_now_4c3fcdfa.speaker: torvald
torvald/no_not_for_now_4c3fcdfa.text: No. Not for now. Not ever.

torvald/not_here_not_in_b7fe9c0b.speaker: torvald
torvald/not_here_not_in_b7fe9c0b.text: Not here... not in front of them...

torvald/not_this_year_open_e536b1ad.speaker: torvald
torvald/not_this_year_open_e536b1ad.text: Not this year. Open the gate, Aldra. Or no. I will. My hands, this time.

torvald/not_yet_i_think_c4a69176.speaker: torvald
torvald/not_yet_i_think_c4a69176.text: Not yet. I think he was waiting for you. He is polite like that.

torvald/nothing_is_what_malrik_55087ec7.speaker: torvald
torvald/nothing_is_what_malrik_55087ec7.text: Nothing is what Malrik always asks for. At first.

torvald/now_bishop_before_her_572d46a7.speaker: torvald
torvald/now_bishop_before_her_572d46a7.text: Now, Bishop. Before her roots take hold.

torvald/now_bishop_before_the_eb24f578.speaker: torvald
torvald/now_bishop_before_the_eb24f578.text: Now, Bishop. Before the spring remembers itself.

torvald/once_a_rider_hammered_8e2518ad.speaker: torvald
torvald/once_a_rider_hammered_8e2518ad.text: Once a rider hammered at my gate, and I stood there counting.

torvald/one_fewer_door_keep_2206088c.speaker: torvald
torvald/one_fewer_door_keep_2206088c.text: One fewer door. Keep yours shut, Ysolde.

torvald/open_the_gate_all_b397c2fb.speaker: torvald
torvald/open_the_gate_all_b397c2fb.text: Open the gate. All of it.

torvald/pits_to_the_east_2ac598b6.speaker: torvald
torvald/pits_to_the_east_2ac598b6.text: Pits to the east, fishers to the south. Aldra, I cannot stand in two places.

torvald/quickly_then_before_that_5a5af6a.speaker: torvald
torvald/quickly_then_before_that_5a5af6a.text: Quickly, then. Before that stone in your pocket finishes its sentence.

torvald/remember_who_paid_for_87dc7108.speaker: torvald
torvald/remember_who_paid_for_87dc7108.text: Remember who paid for it, Seraphine. I would like to know myself.

torvald/run_little_ember_every_4483f6f4.speaker: torvald
torvald/run_little_ember_every_4483f6f4.text: Run, little ember. Every relic you carry makes the Hollow hungrier. You will see.

torvald/she_did_i_have_df573c4d.speaker: torvald
torvald/she_did_i_have_df573c4d.text: She did. I have worse things to remember.

torvald/she_is_not_lying_8f65fa5b.speaker: torvald
torvald/she_is_not_lying_8f65fa5b.text: She is not lying, Bishop. I have felt it under the ice. Something counting.

torvald/she_left_this_on_c06245fe.speaker: torvald
torvald/she_left_this_on_c06245fe.text: She left this on the sand.

torvald/shell_take_the_field_56cee941.speaker: torvald
torvald/shell_take_the_field_56cee941.text: She'll take the field in five minutes. He'll take it in the last one.

torvald/sixty_winters_i_have_006dae9e.speaker: torvald
torvald/sixty_winters_i_have_006dae9e.text: Sixty winters I have kept this gate. I can keep it one more.

torvald/so_be_it_my_eab50021.speaker: torvald
torvald/so_be_it_my_eab50021.text: So be it. My lake will see you out. Slowly.

torvald/so_does_malrik_he_39fff724.speaker: torvald
torvald/so_does_malrik_he_39fff724.text: So does Malrik. He has simply never minded.

torvald/so_the_little_ember_6f0f8efc.speaker: torvald
torvald/so_the_little_ember_6f0f8efc.text: So the little ember comes to warm the wood. You are late, child. Winter got here first.

torvald/so_would_i_malrik_ef669629.speaker: torvald
torvald/so_would_i_malrik_ef669629.text: So would I. Malrik sailed home before the blood was dry. That is not mourning.

torvald/some_nights_i_still_418b9530.speaker: torvald
torvald/some_nights_i_still_418b9530.text: Some nights I still see the smoke.

torvald/some_things_should_break_6a2d75a.speaker: torvald
torvald/some_things_should_break_6a2d75a.text: Some things should break. Once. Properly.

torvald/someone_had_to_keep_ca7041ee.speaker: torvald
torvald/someone_had_to_keep_ca7041ee.text: Someone had to keep the light, I said.

torvald/something_came_for_it_73563eb8.speaker: torvald
torvald/something_came_for_it_73563eb8.text: Something came for it every winter, for a hundred winters. Nothing got past me.

torvald/something_under_the_isle_0774e12.speaker: torvald
torvald/something_under_the_isle_0774e12.text: Something under the isle is counting. Every one that falls, it counts.

torvald/spring_is_stubborn_so_8bfa6d1b.speaker: torvald
torvald/spring_is_stubborn_so_8bfa6d1b.text: Spring is stubborn. So is winter. This is not over, child.

torvald/stone_is_patient_ice_4ca1b228.speaker: torvald
torvald/stone_is_patient_ice_4ca1b228.text: Stone is patient. Ice is older.

torvald/sunwake_flies_with_us_c998cac1.speaker: torvald
torvald/sunwake_flies_with_us_c998cac1.text: Sunwake flies with us. For the morning, at least.

torvald/tell_them_i_was_ca02574a.speaker: torvald
torvald/tell_them_i_was_ca02574a.text: Tell them I was looking at a weed.

torvald/that_ice_has_kept_b5c388c1.speaker: torvald
torvald/that_ice_has_kept_b5c388c1.text: That ice has kept a secret for a hundred winters, ember. Think before you melt it.

torvald/that_smoke_is_violet_4dbb40c0.speaker: torvald
torvald/that_smoke_is_violet_4dbb40c0.text: That smoke is violet. Gold cloaks do not bleed violet.

torvald/thats_the_last_of_38e74272.speaker: torvald
torvald/thats_the_last_of_38e74272.text: That's the last of them. Close it behind them. Gates are for closing too.

torvald/the_boat_my_rune_76292d1f.speaker: torvald
torvald/the_boat_my_rune_76292d1f.text: The boat my rune saw left violet smoke. Gold cloaks do not row from the north.

torvald/the_citadel_stands_aldra_f49a129.speaker: torvald
torvald/the_citadel_stands_aldra_f49a129.text: The Citadel stands. Aldra. I would rather not do this one alone.

torvald/the_ice_holds_for_c8e60a24.speaker: torvald
torvald/the_ice_holds_for_c8e60a24.text: The ice holds for us, and not for them. Remember that, girl.

torvald/the_lake_is_safe_95df75ae.speaker: torvald
torvald/the_lake_is_safe_95df75ae.text: The lake is safe. The lake is always safe.

torvald/the_orb_is_turned_2bb2fbde.speaker: torvald
torvald/the_orb_is_turned_2bb2fbde.text: The orb is turned. Quickly. For me. Who's next?

torvald/the_sea_was_never_e65e1efe.speaker: torvald
torvald/the_sea_was_never_e65e1efe.text: The sea... was never mine to hold.

torvald/their_door_is_broken_5767f2a7.speaker: torvald
torvald/their_door_is_broken_5767f2a7.text: Their door is broken. Go home, stones.

torvald/then_i_am_on_b030f71b.speaker: torvald
torvald/then_i_am_on_b030f71b.text: Then I am on your side. Hold.

torvald/then_i_will_answer_dc42fa40.speaker: torvald
torvald/then_i_will_answer_dc42fa40.text: Then I will answer for them. They will answer to nobody.

torvald/then_i_will_spend_9a010d26.speaker: torvald
torvald/then_i_will_spend_9a010d26.text: Then I will spend it awake.

torvald/then_i_will_stand_20469b3f.speaker: torvald
torvald/then_i_will_stand_20469b3f.text: Then I will stand down here. Ring your bells when I tell you, and bring your people to me.

torvald/then_it_cracks_ice_1132d9ea.speaker: torvald
torvald/then_it_cracks_ice_1132d9ea.text: Then it cracks. Ice was never the point. The line was.

torvald/then_it_will_be_bf0e2194.speaker: torvald
torvald/then_it_will_be_bf0e2194.text: Then it will be raised. I gave my word.

torvald/then_let_him_come_b61f0dae.speaker: torvald
torvald/then_let_him_come_b61f0dae.text: Then let him come. We are four. We hold.

torvald/then_the_gate_stays_4cd4e9e7.speaker: torvald
torvald/then_the_gate_stays_4cd4e9e7.text: Then the gate stays shut, and the lake stays quiet.

torvald/there_is_nothing_under_31574d9f.speaker: torvald
torvald/there_is_nothing_under_31574d9f.text: There is nothing under it left to sing about.

torvald/they_have_a_watch_517c05e2.speaker: torvald
torvald/they_have_a_watch_517c05e2.text: They have a watch. Take it back, or the ridge goes with it.

torvald/they_never_came_back_4934d88d.speaker: torvald
torvald/they_never_came_back_4934d88d.text: They never came back. I kept it lit all winter anyway.

torvald/they_rest_here_four_52322add.speaker: torvald
torvald/they_rest_here_four_52322add.text: They rest here. Four minutes. They walked for three days. We hold for four minutes.

torvald/this_bank_is_mine_e541fbea.speaker: torvald
torvald/this_bank_is_mine_e541fbea.text: This bank is mine until the thaw, child. The thaw is a long way off.

torvald/this_coin_carries_the_98621737.speaker: torvald
torvald/this_coin_carries_the_98621737.text: This coin carries the Outwall's stamp, Malrik. Dockers' wages. Where did you find it?

torvald/this_is_not_what_4e569918.speaker: torvald
torvald/this_is_not_what_4e569918.text: This is not what you promised, Bishop. You said a door. Not a jailer.

torvald/too_late_i_always_2b46a04e.speaker: torvald
torvald/too_late_i_always_2b46a04e.text: Too late. I always arrive... too late.

torvald/too_slow_again_the_3aeb1458.speaker: torvald
torvald/too_slow_again_the_3aeb1458.text: Too slow. Again... the ice gives way.

torvald/too_slow_forgive_me_220f3f65.speaker: torvald
torvald/too_slow_forgive_me_220f3f65.text: Too slow... forgive me. Too slow.

torvald/twenty_thats_enough_to_dddd4f0b.speaker: torvald
torvald/twenty_thats_enough_to_dddd4f0b.text: Twenty. That's enough to be a town. Keep them coming.

torvald/two_banners_on_one_acfda80e.speaker: torvald
torvald/two_banners_on_one_acfda80e.text: Two banners on one bank. Malrik, I begin to see why you feared her.

torvald/two_children_fighting_on_724fb69.speaker: torvald
torvald/two_children_fighting_on_724fb69.text: Two children, fighting on my lake. Finish it quickly, and leave my ice alone.

torvald/two_hundred_dockers_wages_bc0e61.speaker: torvald
torvald/two_hundred_dockers_wages_bc0e61.text: Two hundred dockers' wages, given as a gift.

torvald/vessa_still_never_waiting_be7306.speaker: torvald
torvald/vessa_still_never_waiting_be7306.text: Vessa. Still never waiting. One day, child, the road will be longer than you are.

torvald/violet_and_a_candle_7d062b15.speaker: torvald
torvald/violet_and_a_candle_7d062b15.text: Violet. And a candle sigil. Malrik, you are taking rowers from the gutter now.

torvald/we_came_as_fast_0219ed3b.speaker: torvald
torvald/we_came_as_fast_0219ed3b.text: We came as fast as ice comes.

torvald/we_were_all_weeds_0b0b7c80.speaker: torvald
torvald/we_were_all_weeds_0b0b7c80.text: We were all weeds once. Pull back.

torvald/what_did_it_cost_62e071ef.speaker: torvald
torvald/what_did_it_cost_62e071ef.text: What did it cost you, Malrik? In Duskbarrow.

torvald/you_are_told_many_3b877e12.speaker: torvald
torvald/you_are_told_many_3b877e12.text: You are told many things, Vessa. Most of them by people standing behind you.

torvald/you_broke_a_truce_265c1588.speaker: torvald
torvald/you_broke_a_truce_265c1588.text: You broke a truce older than both of us.

torvald/you_came_quickly_ill_47548c44.speaker: torvald
torvald/you_came_quickly_ill_47548c44.text: You came quickly. I'll try to learn how that's done.

torvald/you_carved_a_giant_1ce06c80.speaker: torvald
torvald/you_carved_a_giant_1ce06c80.text: You carved a giant out of my lake.

torvald/you_handled_the_laurel_dc7ca439.speaker: torvald
torvald/you_handled_the_laurel_dc7ca439.text: You handled the Laurel too, Malrik. I have not forgotten whose knives they were.

torvald/you_send_a_knife_bdde2636.speaker: torvald
torvald/you_send_a_knife_bdde2636.text: You send a knife at farmers' carts, Malrik.

torvald/you_sent_knives_after_0870ad4c.speaker: torvald
torvald/you_sent_knives_after_0870ad4c.text: You sent knives after her in the night, and missed. You call that a visit?

torvald/your_shadows_are_thorough_57f487.speaker: torvald
torvald/your_shadows_are_thorough_57f487.text: Your shadows are thorough, Malrik. I am not certain that is a compliment.

torvald/ysolde_go_home_i_9c78c428.speaker: torvald
torvald/ysolde_go_home_i_9c78c428.text: Ysolde. Go home. I have no quarrel with your farms.

torvald/ysolde_i_warned_you_64dad45e.speaker: torvald
torvald/ysolde_i_warned_you_64dad45e.text: Ysolde. I warned you about the cold. Turn back while the passes are open.

torvald/ysolde_once_asked_me_c8578b3d.speaker: torvald
torvald/ysolde_once_asked_me_c8578b3d.text: Ysolde once asked me what I remember of being young. I told her: snow.

torvald/ysolde_you_were_always_a74aba07.speaker: torvald
torvald/ysolde_you_were_always_a74aba07.text: Ysolde. You were always the patient one. Why can you not wait for spring?

unit_bleakbow/whisper_i_see_them_b37c818.speaker: unit_bleakbow
unit_bleakbow/whisper_i_see_them_b37c818.text: [whisper] I see them. They don't see me.

unit_bloomtender/i_would_rather_heal_192.speaker: unit_bloomtender
unit_bloomtender/i_would_rather_heal_192.text: I would rather heal, but fine.

unit_cinder_arbalest/line_them_up_one_d6.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
unit_cinder_arbalest/line_them_up_one_d6.text: Line them up. One bolt, two holes.

unit_flame_guard/eccomi_il_pi_forte_a295.speaker: unit_flame_guard
unit_flame_guard/eccomi_il_pi_forte_a295.text: Eccomi. Il più forte è arrivato.

unit_flame_guard/venite_qui_se_avete_73c.speaker: unit_flame_guard
unit_flame_guard/venite_qui_se_avete_73c.text: Venite qui, se avete il coraggio!

unit_hoarlight_magebow/a_needle_of_frost.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
unit_hoarlight_magebow/a_needle_of_frost.text: A needle of frost for you.

unit_nightblood_reaver/line_83b34597.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
unit_nightblood_reaver/line_83b34597.text: 您过奖了，我只是个小兵。

unit_nightbolt/a_bolt_of_night_909f5ca8.speaker: unit_nightbolt
unit_nightbolt/a_bolt_of_night_909f5ca8.text: A bolt of night, at your word.

unit_rimeshield/all_voy_con_la_049f00e8.speaker: unit_rimeshield
unit_rimeshield/all_voy_con_la_049f00e8.text: Allá voy, con la frente en alto.

unit_rimeshield/mi_escudo_jam_s_da99281c.speaker: unit_rimeshield
unit_rimeshield/mi_escudo_jam_s_da99281c.text: Mi escudo jamás se ha rendido.

unit_rimeshield/s_el_escudo_m_e192d010.speaker: unit_rimeshield
unit_rimeshield/s_el_escudo_m_e192d010.text: ¿Sí? El escudo más noble del norte.

unit_shadow_knight/my_blade_is_sworn_052.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
unit_shadow_knight/my_blade_is_sworn_052.text: My blade is sworn to Malrik.

unit_shardguard/where_i_walk_the_b31beda.speaker: unit_shardguard
unit_shardguard/where_i_walk_the_b31beda.text: Where I walk, the ice holds.

unit_stormbottle_genie/out_of_the_bottle.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
unit_stormbottle_genie/out_of_the_bottle.text: Out of the bottle at last!

unit_thornling/fine_there_better_be_5766.speaker: unit_thornling
unit_thornling/fine_there_better_be_5766.text: Fine. There better be a fight there.

unit_thornling/you_looking_at_me_14898f1.speaker: unit_thornling
unit_thornling/you_looking_at_me_14898f1.text: You looking at me? Let's go, then.

vessa/a_dragon_an_actual_a6bba5a9.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_dragon_an_actual_a6bba5a9.text: A dragon! An actual dragon! Vey, I have a DRAGON.

vessa/a_forge_he_built_2c3528a5.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_forge_he_built_2c3528a5.text: A forge. He built forges down here? What was he making?

vessa/a_gates_down_your_defa2930.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_gates_down_your_defa2930.text: A gate's down! Your trees punch harder than my fire, Ysolde. I hate it. Keep going.

vessa/a_heart_made_of_7feaee8e.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_heart_made_of_7feaee8e.text: A heart made of roots, pumping green. Only Ysolde would grow a thing like that.

vessa/a_hundred_winters_of_5f881f3c.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_hundred_winters_of_5f881f3c.text: A hundred winters of ice, and it took me one afternoon. Somebody write that down.

vessa/a_tollbooth_you_built_1747d5af.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_tollbooth_you_built_1747d5af.text: A tollbooth. You built a tollbooth. That is the most Malrik thing you've ever done.

vessa/a_tree_im_opening_9b332d04.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_tree_im_opening_9b332d04.text: A tree. I'm opening a tree. Before HE does.

vessa/all_three_of_them_d1fcc2e5.speaker: vessa
vessa/all_three_of_them_d1fcc2e5.text: All three of them, pointing at the floor.

vessa/an_ember_crown_in_b9772779.speaker: vessa
vessa/an_ember_crown_in_b9772779.text: An Ember Crown, in a place called Emberfall. Nobody said it was left for me. Nobody said it wasn't.

vessa/and_the_lightning_no_08fd5787.speaker: vessa
vessa/and_the_lightning_no_08fd5787.text: And the lightning? No kingdom throws lightning.

vessa/and_when_were_you_ec6fc968.speaker: vessa
vessa/and_when_were_you_ec6fc968.text: And when were you going to tell me?

vessa/ashby_says_the_seal_7c46b03d.speaker: vessa
vessa/ashby_says_the_seal_7c46b03d.text: Ashby says the seal was older than the keep.

vessa/ashby_that_was_the_2dae09a2.speaker: vessa
vessa/ashby_that_was_the_2dae09a2.text: Ashby. That was the grain. That was the grain we came here to take back.

vessa/back_again_torvald_youre_8d5a9115.speaker: vessa
vessa/back_again_torvald_youre_8d5a9115.text: Back again, Torvald? You're the slowest man I know, and you're still everywhere.

vessa/bettany_i_thought_your_87aa3e78.speaker: vessa
vessa/bettany_i_thought_your_87aa3e78.text: Bettany? I thought your tavern burned down.

vessa/both_fords_vey_we_93963db8.speaker: vessa
vessa/both_fords_vey_we_93963db8.text: Both fords, Vey! We pinch him!

vessa/both_halls_torvalds_soldiers_eb33b.speaker: vessa
vessa/both_halls_torvalds_soldiers_eb33b.text: Both halls! Torvald's soldiers will have to train in the snow. Good.

vessa/bring_your_army_ill_3dbf82db.speaker: vessa
vessa/bring_your_army_ill_3dbf82db.text: Bring your army. I'll bring mine.

vessa/but_her_people_have_6f60fcc0.speaker: vessa
vessa/but_her_people_have_6f60fcc0.text: But her people have no one else. I need you. All of you.

vessa/but_that_wasnt_the_ef0467ad.speaker: vessa
vessa/but_that_wasnt_the_ef0467ad.text: But that wasn't the start. The start was a barn.

vessa/come_and_take_them_b14d71f4.speaker: vessa
vessa/come_and_take_them_b14d71f4.text: Come and take them, Bishop. You owe me for Emberfall. And for Vey.

vessa/come_on_then_ive_74445108.speaker: vessa
vessa/come_on_then_ive_74445108.text: Come on, then! I've got five fires and a really bad temper.

vessa/crown_orb_signet_lets_09e0dc3a.speaker: vessa
vessa/crown_orb_signet_lets_09e0dc3a.text: Crown, orb, signet. Let's see what you do together.

vessa/deal_and_next_time_1de98e38.speaker: vessa
vessa/deal_and_next_time_1de98e38.text: Deal. And next time, I'll leave your trees alone.

vessa/define_hurt_kidding_malrik_14c2ad2.speaker: vessa
vessa/define_hurt_kidding_malrik_14c2ad2.text: Define hurt. ...Kidding! Malrik, you take the shady side. You like it there.

vessa/dogs_why_is_it_27fe2d74.speaker: vessa
vessa/dogs_why_is_it_27fe2d74.text: Dogs! Why is it always dogs?

vessa/emberguard_on_your_feet_70d3aa58.speaker: vessa
vessa/emberguard_on_your_feet_70d3aa58.text: Emberguard, on your feet! Stamp your boots until you can feel your toes.

vessa/every_stone_lit_ill_385d4cee.speaker: vessa
vessa/every_stone_lit_ill_385d4cee.text: Every stone lit. I'll admit it, the Master had good taste in caves.

vessa/everyone_always_said_wait_c3d7643c.speaker: vessa
vessa/everyone_always_said_wait_c3d7643c.text: Everyone always said wait. Nobody ever told me what for.

vessa/everyone_back_to_the_ec47ce27.speaker: vessa
vessa/everyone_back_to_the_ec47ce27.text: Everyone, back to the keep! BACK!

vessa/everyone_on_the_door_cfef952b.speaker: vessa
vessa/everyone_on_the_door_cfef952b.text: Everyone on the door! Nobody touches it but us!

vessa/everyone_says_that_about_34c37e51.speaker: vessa
vessa/everyone_says_that_about_34c37e51.text: Everyone says that about the things I want. And if I leave it, Malrik takes it.

vessa/everything_we_have_ysolde_777e9904.speaker: vessa
vessa/everything_we_have_ysolde_777e9904.text: Everything we have, Ysolde! Take that harbour while the sky is still for sale!

vessa/fire_and_frost_they_27662a3f.speaker: vessa
vessa/fire_and_frost_they_27662a3f.text: Fire AND frost. They didn't just burn it. They made sure it stayed dead.

vessa/fire_takes_its_bank_ffd4dd0f.speaker: vessa
vessa/fire_takes_its_bank_ffd4dd0f.text: Fire takes its bank. Or wherever I'm standing. I'm flexible.

vessa/fires_key_is_in_b44c22a3.speaker: vessa
vessa/fires_key_is_in_b44c22a3.text: Fire's key is in! Don't make me wait. I'm terrible at it.

vessa/five_i_could_light_ea61cd76.speaker: vessa
vessa/five_i_could_light_ea61cd76.text: Five? I could light fifty. Can I light the bridge too? It looks very flammable.

vessa/five_seconds_i_can_399fb215.speaker: vessa
vessa/five_seconds_i_can_399fb215.text: Five seconds. I can hold anything for five seconds.

vessa/four_keys_one_hole_1d2aa590.speaker: vessa
vessa/four_keys_one_hole_1d2aa590.text: Four keys. One hole in the ground. Let's go and knock.

vessa/get_the_army_up_757c6437.speaker: vessa
vessa/get_the_army_up_757c6437.text: Get the army up. We take the crown today.

vessa/gold_we_have_crystals_0acf36c0.speaker: vessa
vessa/gold_we_have_crystals_0acf36c0.text: Gold? We have crystals. Lots of crystals.

vessa/ha_one_did_you_c6e2ded4.speaker: vessa
vessa/ha_one_did_you_c6e2ded4.text: Ha! One! Did you see? Tell me you saw that.

vessa/he_bought_the_whole_feae7474.speaker: vessa
vessa/he_bought_the_whole_feae7474.text: He bought the whole SKY? Ysolde, pull back! Everyone, back to the ships!

vessa/he_laughed_when_i_e7711d85.speaker: vessa
vessa/he_laughed_when_i_e7711d85.text: He laughed when I laughed. Nobody else ever did that.

vessa/hell_call_it_a_463e24c1.speaker: vessa
vessa/hell_call_it_a_463e24c1.text: He'll call it a victory, you know.

vessa/here_ashby_packs_bread_f10bfefb.speaker: vessa
vessa/here_ashby_packs_bread_f10bfefb.text: Here. Ashby packs bread like he expects a siege.

vessa/hes_not_dead_hes_6c6b7931.speaker: vessa
vessa/hes_not_dead_hes_6c6b7931.text: He's not dead, he's LATE. There's a difference!

vessa/hes_on_our_hill_97303674.speaker: vessa
vessa/hes_on_our_hill_97303674.text: He's on our hill. I'm not waiting for him to plant a flag.

vessa/hes_raising_the_wall_fc7554c8.speaker: vessa
vessa/hes_raising_the_wall_fc7554c8.text: He's raising the Wall of a Hundred Winters. Every pass on his frontier.

vessa/hey_thats_my_banner_1fa838d2.speaker: vessa
vessa/hey_thats_my_banner_1fa838d2.text: Hey! That's MY banner! You can't just take it!

vessa/his_scouts_are_already_3bea20ba.speaker: vessa
vessa/his_scouts_are_already_3bea20ba.text: His scouts are already in Ysolde's wood. The third relic sleeps there.

vessa/his_thralls_are_draining_202d9662.speaker: vessa
vessa/his_thralls_are_draining_202d9662.text: His Thralls are draining the hearts. If he opens that tree first, I lose it.

vessa/hold_on_ysolde_fire_413040f1.speaker: vessa
vessa/hold_on_ysolde_fire_413040f1.text: Hold on, Ysolde. Fire is coming.

vessa/hold_the_ford_for_91efc285.speaker: vessa
vessa/hold_the_ford_for_91efc285.text: Hold the ford for them. They run to us. We do NOT run to them.

vessa/how_many_knives_does_e3d39bcd.speaker: vessa
vessa/how_many_knives_does_e3d39bcd.text: How many knives does one Bishop OWN?

vessa/huh_you_grow_a_4abd93de.speaker: vessa
vessa/huh_you_grow_a_4abd93de.text: Huh. You grow a castle out of a seed. I have to build mine out of rocks.

vessa/hush_i_know_that_22dfa6e3.speaker: vessa
vessa/hush_i_know_that_22dfa6e3.text: Hush! I know that smoke. Come out and finish what you started!

vessa/i_am_the_thaw_7ae66e54.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_am_the_thaw_7ae66e54.text: I AM the thaw, Torvald. I've been told I'm very warm.

vessa/i_could_stop_every_53696bea.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_could_stop_every_53696bea.text: I could stop every war. Keep everyone safe.

vessa/i_go_before_he_c9e68288.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_go_before_he_c9e68288.text: I go before he gets it.

vessa/i_had_ten_minutes_1ac055e8.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_had_ten_minutes_1ac055e8.text: I had ten minutes to practise running. Those pillars feed it. Break them all!

vessa/i_know_those_knives_e8a9c35c.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_know_those_knives_e8a9c35c.text: I know those knives. I've had them at my throat. Hush! I owe you a night!

vessa/i_know_youre_tired_54835bf6.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_know_youre_tired_54835bf6.text: I know you're tired. I know we just won.

vessa/i_never_listen_i_640cee6b.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_never_listen_i_640cee6b.text: I never listen. I just show up.

vessa/i_never_met_a_b3d1233c.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_never_met_a_b3d1233c.text: I never met a wall I couldn't turn into a door.

vessa/i_really_do_im_d5b09d11.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_really_do_im_d5b09d11.text: I really do. I'm not going to. Somebody write that down.

vessa/i_think_the_wood_edb887c0.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_think_the_wood_edb887c0.text: I think the wood can now. V.

vessa/i_was_six_it_465e710b.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_was_six_it_465e710b.text: I was six. It was our barn. Nobody clapped.

vessa/ill_bring_the_fire_8122e724.speaker: vessa
vessa/ill_bring_the_fire_8122e724.text: I'll bring the fire. You bring the patience.

vessa/ill_take_the_east_d73eae91.speaker: vessa
vessa/ill_take_the_east_d73eae91.text: I'll take the east slope. If Torvald crosses, he can explain himself to a fire.

vessa/im_here_for_the_10aceb62.speaker: vessa
vessa/im_here_for_the_10aceb62.text: I'm here for the crown, not a lecture. Fine. Both.

vessa/im_not_the_one_50cdda91.speaker: vessa
vessa/im_not_the_one_50cdda91.text: I'm not the one who's hurt, Captain.

vessa/im_taking_the_east_80916301.speaker: vessa
vessa/im_taking_the_east_80916301.text: I'm taking the east gate. Don't wait for me. I definitely won't wait for you.

vessa/it_answered_the_door_6900defa.speaker: vessa
vessa/it_answered_the_door_6900defa.text: It answered! The Door hit it! He's helping us!

vessa/its_so_dark_good_1ba97a95.speaker: vessa
vessa/its_so_dark_good_1ba97a95.text: It's so dark. Good thing I'm the brightest person I know.

vessa/its_warm_vey_the_239e20da.speaker: vessa
vessa/its_warm_vey_the_239e20da.text: It's warm. Vey, the door is WARM. Something's on the other side.

vessa/ive_been_stabbed_one_607cfa86.speaker: vessa
vessa/ive_been_stabbed_one_607cfa86.text: I've been stabbed ONE time and I already hate it.

vessa/last_chance_to_pick_bad1abf7.speaker: vessa
vessa/last_chance_to_pick_bad1abf7.text: Last chance to pick the right side, Torvald! I'm told I'm very forgiving!

vessa/look_at_it_melt_1df723e8.speaker: vessa
vessa/look_at_it_melt_1df723e8.text: Look at it melt! Fire always wins in the end.

vessa/malrik_you_brought_a_fe9dd213.speaker: vessa
vessa/malrik_you_brought_a_fe9dd213.text: Malrik! You brought a whole winter to a picnic.

vessa/malrik_you_sent_the_76c312b3.speaker: vessa
vessa/malrik_you_sent_the_76c312b3.text: MALRIK! You sent the knife-woman into my camp AGAIN?

vessa/malriks_already_here_of_8b72df0b.speaker: vessa
vessa/malriks_already_here_of_8b72df0b.text: Malrik's already here. Of course he is. Then I'll borrow a forest.

vessa/malriks_diggers_on_torvalds_551beb.speaker: vessa
vessa/malriks_diggers_on_torvalds_551beb.text: Malrik's diggers on Torvald's lake. Torvald must be thrilled.

vessa/marching_now_fire_on_5df3d3a3.speaker: vessa
vessa/marching_now_fire_on_5df3d3a3.text: Marching now! Fire on the bridge. Somebody watch my back, I won't.

vessa/master_master_im_here_f3abe572.speaker: vessa
vessa/master_master_im_here_f3abe572.text: Master?! Master, I'm here! I'm right here!

vessa/master_thats_thats_him_366b5b40.speaker: vessa
vessa/master_thats_thats_him_366b5b40.text: Master?! That's... that's him! Turn them!

vessa/millrace_is_lit_and_e8955784.speaker: vessa
vessa/millrace_is_lit_and_e8955784.text: Millrace is lit! And the mill is... mostly not on fire. Mostly.

vessa/mother_hush_last_time_1e75e80d.speaker: vessa
vessa/mother_hush_last_time_1e75e80d.text: Mother Hush. Last time you ran. Want to try running a second time?

vessa/mother_hush_you_missed_55328f83.speaker: vessa
vessa/mother_hush_you_missed_55328f83.text: Mother Hush. You missed me once. I'd hate for you to get out of practice.

vessa/my_keyholes_cracking_no_33ba0f2c.speaker: vessa
vessa/my_keyholes_cracking_no_33ba0f2c.text: My keyhole's cracking! No surge till you help!

vessa/my_keys_in_i_f3a46cce.speaker: vessa
vessa/my_keys_in_i_f3a46cce.text: My key's in. I waited for it, too. Who's next?

vessa/no_no_no_that_a823b85e.speaker: vessa
vessa/no_no_no_that_a823b85e.text: No, no, no! That was somebody's house!

vessa/nobody_had_ever_said_23f65b56.speaker: vessa
vessa/nobody_had_ever_said_23f65b56.text: Nobody had ever said "next time" to me before.

vessa/nobody_stays_faded_around_83860285.speaker: vessa
vessa/nobody_stays_faded_around_83860285.text: Nobody stays faded around here. Ask Vey.

vessa/not_alone_early_theres_87eb481c.speaker: vessa
vessa/not_alone_early_theres_87eb481c.text: Not alone. Early. There's a difference. I'm told.

vessa/not_now_not_when_40ddf8dc.speaker: vessa
vessa/not_now_not_when_40ddf8dc.text: Not now... not when we're finally together...

vessa/not_the_keep_i_dfa556d1.speaker: vessa
vessa/not_the_keep_i_dfa556d1.text: Not the keep! I JUST had it redecorated!

vessa/now_hit_him_while_5d6dc575.speaker: vessa
vessa/now_hit_him_while_5d6dc575.text: NOW! Hit him while he's tied!

vessa/now_you_want_to_9878e199.speaker: vessa
vessa/now_you_want_to_9878e199.text: NOW you want to talk? Your wood tried to eat me.

vessa/of_course_master_no_b4998e32.speaker: vessa
vessa/of_course_master_no_b4998e32.text: Of course, Master! No problem at all!

vessa/okay_okay_bad_idea_382eb551.speaker: vessa
vessa/okay_okay_bad_idea_382eb551.text: Okay. OKAY. Bad idea. Very bad idea!

vessa/one_dance_then_im_faec23ce.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_dance_then_im_faec23ce.text: One dance. Then I'm eating everything.

vessa/one_gate_down_stone_e771f8b3.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_gate_down_stone_e771f8b3.text: One gate down. Stone breaks. Good to know.

vessa/one_lit_malrik_you_c51368de.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_lit_malrik_you_c51368de.text: One lit. Malrik, you still dress like a funeral that got lost on the way.

vessa/one_seal_see_vey_b0114f79.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_seal_see_vey_b0114f79.text: One seal! See, Vey? I can be patient. For four seconds at a time.

vessa/one_time_i_set_ba75a181.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_time_i_set_ba75a181.text: One time. I set ONE tree on fire, one time.

vessa/one_tower_down_ashby_b7265100.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_tower_down_ashby_b7265100.text: One tower down! Ashby, did you see? Write it down somewhere!

vessa/oops_tents_are_very_6a187542.speaker: vessa
vessa/oops_tents_are_very_6a187542.text: Oops. Tents are very flammable. Who knew? ...Everyone. Everyone knew.

vessa/ow_fine_back_in_2928674b.speaker: vessa
vessa/ow_fine_back_in_2928674b.text: Ow! Fine! Back in a minute!

vessa/ow_fine_i_yield_38e995dd.speaker: vessa
vessa/ow_fine_i_yield_38e995dd.text: Ow! Fine! I yield! This counts as a tie!

vessa/pell_keep_the_bazaar_165f393f.speaker: vessa
vessa/pell_keep_the_bazaar_165f393f.text: Pell, keep the Bazaar running. Fire just learned what gold is for.

vessa/pells_cart_and_no_cf72e0e9.speaker: vessa
vessa/pells_cart_and_no_cf72e0e9.text: Pell's cart, and no Pell. Maybe I should have opened that cage. Well. Finders keepers.

vessa/rematch_now_best_of_df5f3839.speaker: vessa
vessa/rematch_now_best_of_df5f3839.text: Rematch. Now. Best of three. Best of five!

vessa/rimeholds_down_torvald_you_d0b8e09.speaker: vessa
vessa/rimeholds_down_torvald_you_d0b8e09.text: Rimehold's down. Torvald, you left your fort on my bank. I put it back.

vessa/see_a_door_i_d0461c9e.speaker: vessa
vessa/see_a_door_i_d0461c9e.text: See? A door! I said there'd be a door!

vessa/sellswords_who_wont_take_b3c0d8bb.speaker: vessa
vessa/sellswords_who_wont_take_b3c0d8bb.text: Sellswords who won't take orders. Perfect. I'll pay them to want what I want.

vessa/shades_in_the_ashes_aa11432f.speaker: vessa
vessa/shades_in_the_ashes_aa11432f.text: Shades in the ashes. Malrik never could resist a funeral.

vessa/shades_in_the_dark_b70f5c56.speaker: vessa
vessa/shades_in_the_dark_b70f5c56.text: Shades, in the dark. Of course. They never pick a nice, sunny cave.

vessa/shades_in_the_dark_c3fe4357.speaker: vessa
vessa/shades_in_the_dark_c3fe4357.text: Shades in the dark. I know that smoke. She ran from me once.

vessa/shadow_at_my_hearths_30444078.speaker: vessa
vessa/shadow_at_my_hearths_30444078.text: Shadow at my hearths, Ysolde! If your trees can walk, now's the time.

vessa/six_wagons_of_gold_39588153.speaker: vessa
vessa/six_wagons_of_gold_39588153.text: Six wagons of gold. I don't own one wagon of gold. I own a lot of rocks. Shiny ones.

vessa/so_i_just_stand_ae4ac09b.speaker: vessa
vessa/so_i_just_stand_ae4ac09b.text: So I just... stand here. For fourteen minutes.

vessa/so_we_break_it_a76f2087.speaker: vessa
vessa/so_we_break_it_a76f2087.text: So we break it before the first blizzard. A week, Ashby says. Maybe less.

vessa/so_we_hit_him_36e5db58.speaker: vessa
vessa/so_we_hit_him_36e5db58.text: So we hit him when the chains pull. And we don't let go. I can do that. Probably.

vessa/so_we_knock_it_63009f84.speaker: vessa
vessa/so_we_knock_it_63009f84.text: So we knock it down. I brought fire. You brought... a tree?

vessa/so_you_picked_the_820c0495.speaker: vessa
vessa/so_you_picked_the_820c0495.text: So you picked the man who sends knives at night. Great judgement, Torvald.

vessa/somebody_tell_the_sellswords_1fc73.speaker: vessa
vessa/somebody_tell_the_sellswords_1fc73.text: Somebody tell the sellswords their bounty's ready. And tell the bear I'm sorry.

vessa/someone_is_under_crown_2ebe76a1.speaker: vessa
vessa/someone_is_under_crown_2ebe76a1.text: Someone is under Crown Hollow, and he's been whispering to me since Emberfall.

vessa/stables_javelins_on_horsebac_1defe.speaker: vessa
vessa/stables_javelins_on_horsebac_1defe.text: Stables! Javelins on horseback. Sir Crackle will have to wait for a saddle.

vessa/tell_him_we_need_1e28f023.speaker: vessa
vessa/tell_him_we_need_1e28f023.text: Tell him: we need all four of you.

vessa/tell_malrik_he_still_28e49ca8.speaker: vessa
vessa/tell_malrik_he_still_28e49ca8.text: Tell Malrik... he still dresses like a funeral.

vessa/tell_the_others_i_62fd53ca.speaker: vessa
vessa/tell_the_others_i_62fd53ca.text: Tell the others... I was winning.

vessa/that_voice_again_id_d898ed30.speaker: vessa
vessa/that_voice_again_id_d898ed30.text: That voice again. I'd hoped we buried you.

vessa/thats_it_thats_the_0a1adf3f.speaker: vessa
vessa/thats_it_thats_the_0a1adf3f.text: That's it. That's the door. Vey, he's right there. Under my feet.

vessa/thats_one_hall_torvald_68528ecf.speaker: vessa
vessa/thats_one_hall_torvald_68528ecf.text: That's one hall Torvald won't need to keep cold any more.

vessa/thats_what_friends_are_214fc956.speaker: vessa
vessa/thats_what_friends_are_214fc956.text: That's what friends are for. Apparently. Don't tell Malrik.

vessa/the_beacons_lit_vey_b53dba26.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_beacons_lit_vey_b53dba26.text: The beacon's lit. Vey! You said call. I'm calling!

vessa/the_citadels_up_vey_05049ab8.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_citadels_up_vey_05049ab8.text: The Citadel's up. Vey, the storm can come any time now. Now would be good.

vessa/the_ford_held_till_060c0f2f.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_ford_held_till_060c0f2f.text: The ford held till the horn! Ysolde, that was almost reckless. I'm proud of you.

vessa/the_ground_is_breathing_da7bc5fe.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_ground_is_breathing_da7bc5fe.text: The ground is breathing. That can't be good.

vessa/the_hearths_lit_ashby_fdfe23ff.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_hearths_lit_ashby_fdfe23ff.text: The hearth's lit. Ashby, it's yours. Make me things that hit harder.

vessa/the_master_had_a_cb891110.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_master_had_a_cb891110.text: The Master had a saying about fire that won't wait. He said it a lot. Mostly at me.

vessa/the_masters_going_to_206de570.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_masters_going_to_206de570.text: The Master's going to say it. I know he is. "Fire that will not wait..."

vessa/the_orb_goes_north_dd2e5028.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_orb_goes_north_dd2e5028.text: The Orb goes north to Torvald. It lay in his lake. It's his to carry.

vessa/the_relics_arent_a_50ae4017.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_relics_arent_a_50ae4017.text: The relics aren't a prize. They're a lock.

vessa/the_signet_slept_in_acb23ee5.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_signet_slept_in_acb23ee5.text: The Signet slept in Ysolde's tree. Take it home to her, Wren.

vessa/the_watch_fires_are_67de4a2b.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_watch_fires_are_67de4a2b.text: The watch fires are out. All of them.

vessa/then_dont_stand_here_6582116e.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_dont_stand_here_6582116e.text: Then don't stand here alone. Come with us.

vessa/then_he_wont_be_c14ea729.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_he_wont_be_c14ea729.text: Then he won't be. Ashby! Your fastest messenger.

vessa/then_help_me_stop_72fbf18f.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_help_me_stop_72fbf18f.text: Then help me stop it. Please.

vessa/then_ill_be_standing_94087c96.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_ill_be_standing_94087c96.text: Then I'll be standing right where it happens.

vessa/then_ill_tell_ashby_dae061f7.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_ill_tell_ashby_dae061f7.text: Then I'll tell Ashby to leave the gate open.

vessa/then_its_in_the_02a82f6a.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_its_in_the_02a82f6a.text: Then it's in the right hands. I throw fire at ALL my problems.

vessa/then_lets_give_him_bbd6c834.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_lets_give_him_bbd6c834.text: Then let's give him something to push with. Door! Light! NOW!

vessa/then_she_wont_mind_7829c732.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_she_wont_mind_7829c732.text: Then she won't mind. I'll ask nicely.

vessa/then_we_dont_keep_11ebfc58.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_we_dont_keep_11ebfc58.text: Then we don't keep them waiting.

vessa/then_we_go_faster_c1e4b702.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_we_go_faster_c1e4b702.text: Then we go faster. Wardens, with me. We're going to fetch the Master.

vessa/theres_a_warden_in_038e717a.speaker: vessa
vessa/theres_a_warden_in_038e717a.text: There's a Warden in the wall. Asleep. Vey, the last ones I met tried to crush me.

vessa/theyre_all_over_my_7c41c073.speaker: vessa
vessa/theyre_all_over_my_7c41c073.text: They're all over my keyhole! I could use a hand. Or ten.

vessa/thin_ice_ha_i_9764e3a3.speaker: vessa
vessa/thin_ice_ha_i_9764e3a3.text: Thin ice! Ha! I am absolutely doing that again.

vessa/thirty_fair_and_square_a9624198.speaker: vessa
vessa/thirty_fair_and_square_a9624198.text: Thirty! Fair and square! Malrik, you can keep the shade!

vessa/three_braziers_one_seal_f3a00131.speaker: vessa
