vessa/three_braziers_one_seal_f3a00131.text: Three braziers, one seal. I've been lighting things since before I could talk.

vessa/three_keys_the_fourth_d371d860.speaker: vessa
vessa/three_keys_the_fourth_d371d860.text: Three keys. The fourth is in Malrik's pocket.

vessa/three_ring_it_vey_28ffdbbb.speaker: vessa
vessa/three_ring_it_vey_28ffdbbb.text: Three! Ring it, Vey! Ring it, ring it, ring it!

vessa/three_trees_i_can_c9a739b2.speaker: vessa
vessa/three_trees_i_can_c9a739b2.text: Three trees? I can do three trees. Torvald brought a whole fort. That one's mine.

vessa/through_malriks_hunters_with_71bdc.speaker: vessa
vessa/through_malriks_hunters_with_71bdc.text: Through Malrik's hunters? With grandmothers and goats?

vessa/tolls_paid_in_fire_a6752191.speaker: vessa
vessa/tolls_paid_in_fire_a6752191.text: Toll's paid. In fire. Keep the change.

vessa/too_cold_should_have_57dc9c09.speaker: vessa
vessa/too_cold_should_have_57dc9c09.text: Too... cold... should have... brought a coat...

vessa/torvald_you_came_south_efa46923.speaker: vessa
vessa/torvald_you_came_south_efa46923.text: Torvald! You came south for the sunshine? I'll show you sunshine.

vessa/torvald_youre_fighting_him_058d4f9.speaker: vessa
vessa/torvald_youre_fighting_him_058d4f9.text: Torvald? You're fighting HIM? ...Fine. Aurivane stands down. Don't make me regret it.

vessa/twelve_years_late_then_38462db8.speaker: vessa
vessa/twelve_years_late_then_38462db8.text: Twelve years late, then twelve hours. You're improving.

vessa/two_days_early_im_df85b485.speaker: vessa
vessa/two_days_early_im_df85b485.text: Two days early. I'm always early. That's the problem, isn't it?

vessa/two_days_on_this_bcadeb05.speaker: vessa
vessa/two_days_on_this_bcadeb05.text: Two days on this rock. I've counted every pebble. Twice.

vessa/two_down_keep_hitting_5bc0db1c.speaker: vessa
vessa/two_down_keep_hitting_5bc0db1c.text: Two down. Keep hitting the glowing parts. It's always the glowing parts.

vessa/two_of_you_one_79a9ed64.speaker: vessa
vessa/two_of_you_one_79a9ed64.text: Two of you, one of me. Sounds fair. For me.

vessa/vey_get_up_were_b41efc64.speaker: vessa
vessa/vey_get_up_were_b41efc64.text: Vey! Get up! We're not done!

vessa/vey_i_called_and_fc1c181d.speaker: vessa
vessa/vey_i_called_and_fc1c181d.text: Vey! I called. And look: still on my side of the river.

vessa/vey_said_fire_was_6a0108cd.speaker: vessa
vessa/vey_said_fire_was_6a0108cd.text: Vey said fire was the easy part. I was very good at the easy part.

vessa/vey_the_citadels_lit_9f2ff849.speaker: vessa
vessa/vey_the_citadels_lit_9f2ff849.text: Vey, the Citadel's lit. The stair can wait. I've got thieves.

vessa/vey_the_light_its_9dc387bd.speaker: vessa
vessa/vey_the_light_its_9dc387bd.text: Vey... the light... it's going out...

vessa/vey_worries_ive_been_6bc9bf5f.speaker: vessa
vessa/vey_worries_ive_been_6bc9bf5f.text: Vey worries. I've been practising. Give me a wall and I'll burn a door through it.

vessa/veys_he_cut_it_9357606c.speaker: vessa
vessa/veys_he_cut_it_9357606c.text: Vey's. He cut it off his own sword the day I lit five beacons.

vessa/what_do_they_even_f2911967.speaker: vessa
vessa/what_do_they_even_f2911967.text: What do they even want all this gold for?

vessa/what_storm_i_dont_bfa7fb9a.speaker: vessa
vessa/what_storm_i_dont_bfa7fb9a.text: What storm? I don't have a storm. Do YOU have a storm?

vessa/who_walks_the_wall_45dd4c19.speaker: vessa
vessa/who_walks_the_wall_45dd4c19.text: Who walks the wall at this hour?

vessa/whos_there_great_now_9bd7da57.speaker: vessa
vessa/whos_there_great_now_9bd7da57.text: Who's there? ...Great. Now the jewellery talks. Vey would have laughed at me.

vessa/you_always_said_fire_704521b4.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_always_said_fire_704521b4.text: You always said fire was the problem, Ysolde. Today it's the answer.

vessa/you_are_a_long_e1ae8fe0.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_are_a_long_e1ae8fe0.text: You are a long way from the dark, shade.

vessa/you_just_got_back_99eb210d.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_just_got_back_99eb210d.text: You just got back, and you're leaving again? You're lucky I'm busy.

vessa/you_rebuilt_it_you_97221396.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_rebuilt_it_you_97221396.text: You rebuilt it?! You rebuilt the tollbooth?

vessa/you_sent_knives_in_228bd3de.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_sent_knives_in_228bd3de.text: You sent knives in the night. You took Vey from me. You'll have to go through me.

vessa/you_still_owe_me_df52e267.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_still_owe_me_df52e267.text: You still owe me a story, old man.

vessa/you_talk_about_the_4ca6e30e.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_talk_about_the_4ca6e30e.text: You talk about the Master like you knew him before we did.

vessa/you_want_me_come_5ba1f2f4.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_want_me_come_5ba1f2f4.text: You want me? Come and get me. ALL of you.

vessa/youd_have_let_him_102821f3.speaker: vessa
vessa/youd_have_let_him_102821f3.text: You'd have let him have the ford all along.

vessa/youre_going_to_explain_b65d26f7.speaker: vessa
vessa/youre_going_to_explain_b65d26f7.text: You're going to explain the lightning.

vessa/ysolde_i_came_i_540a231c.speaker: vessa
vessa/ysolde_i_came_i_540a231c.text: Ysolde... I came. I really came...

vessa/ysolde_torvald_brought_morta_8d77f.speaker: vessa
vessa/ysolde_torvald_brought_morta_8d77f.text: Ysolde! Torvald brought mortars to my well. I could use some thorns over here!

vey/a_keyholes_below_half_895e2914.speaker: vey
vey/a_keyholes_below_half_895e2914.text: A keyhole's below half! The chains won't pull until it's healed!

vey/and_you_still_miss_b87c5062.speaker: vey
vey/and_you_still_miss_b87c5062.text: And you still miss, knife-woman. Every single time.

vey/before_the_four_of_c84cffb8.speaker: vey
vey/before_the_four_of_c84cffb8.text: Before the four of you, there was a sword. I was the sword.

vey/bishop_not_one_alarm_2e401aa6.speaker: vey
vey/bishop_not_one_alarm_2e401aa6.text: Bishop! Not one alarm, that night. Your knife is getting better. So am I.

vey/bishop_you_sent_your_3da4100f.speaker: vey
vey/bishop_you_sent_your_3da4100f.text: Bishop! You sent your knife into my girl's camp twice now. I've come to return the favour.

vey/chains_on_every_limb_6a960cec.speaker: vey
vey/chains_on_every_limb_6a960cec.text: Chains on every limb. The keys are holding him. Keep the keys standing, and he stays bound.

vey/eight_of_his_wardens_c5861d21.speaker: vey
vey/eight_of_his_wardens_c5861d21.text: Eight of his Wardens, awake for you. He'd have liked that.

vey/especially_malrik_he_always_2e2ac84d.speaker: vey
vey/especially_malrik_he_always_2e2ac84d.text: Especially Malrik. He always said that.

vey/feel_that_hes_pushing_8daca2f9.speaker: vey
vey/feel_that_hes_pushing_8daca2f9.text: Feel that? He's pushing back from below. The spark first, Vessa. Then the storm.

vey/first_time_youve_called_d344ca7e.speaker: vey
vey/first_time_youve_called_d344ca7e.text: First time you've called me in twelve years, girl. I came running.

vey/five_beacons_vessa_light_0798ada2.speaker: vey
vey/five_beacons_vessa_light_0798ada2.text: Five beacons, Vessa. Light them all and the south watch comes home. That is the trial.

vey/four_keys_four_keyholes_a93a3fb3.speaker: vey
vey/four_keys_four_keyholes_a93a3fb3.text: Four keys, four keyholes. Each to your own. Together.

vey/four_seals_wake_them_904df50c.speaker: vey
vey/four_seals_wake_them_904df50c.text: Four seals. Wake them with the relics and the door stands. Let Malrik break them and it falls.

vey/gates_on_every_road_e6bb8fae.speaker: vey
vey/gates_on_every_road_e6bb8fae.text: Gates on every road. He's been building while we argued. Mason to the end.

vey/girl_the_water_is_09c858cc.speaker: vey
vey/girl_the_water_is_09c858cc.text: Girl! The water is the line. Every step past it, it eats.

vey/gold_six_wagons_of_473fd2af.speaker: vey
vey/gold_six_wagons_of_473fd2af.text: Gold. Six wagons of it, delivered to their door, past the Magpies and Malrik's knives.

vey/good_light_pushes_back_e5c39d8b.speaker: vey
vey/good_light_pushes_back_e5c39d8b.text: Good. Light pushes back the dark. Always has.

vey/ha_go_and_wash_9860a2c2.speaker: vey
vey/ha_go_and_wash_9860a2c2.text: Ha. Go and wash your face. You look like a chimney.

vey/halfway_your_soldiers_are_9fc7c005.speaker: vey
vey/halfway_your_soldiers_are_9fc7c005.text: Halfway. Your soldiers are tired, Vessa. Let them catch up.

vey/he_asked_for_all_fbaaac07.speaker: vey
vey/he_asked_for_all_fbaaac07.text: He asked for all four of you. Especially Malrik.

vey/he_cant_hold_it_67f3dd5c.speaker: vey
vey/he_cant_hold_it_67f3dd5c.text: He can't hold it. Not alone. Not any more.

vey/here_hand_on_the_13ad5858.speaker: vey
vey/here_hand_on_the_13ad5858.text: Here. Hand on the sun, girl. I'll give it the storm. Hold it with me.

vey/hes_coming_for_your_0ec8259d.speaker: vey
vey/hes_coming_for_your_0ec8259d.text: He's coming for YOUR keep! Pull back and meet him at the walls!

vey/hes_down_there_i_20c63292.speaker: vey
vey/hes_down_there_i_20c63292.text: He's down there. I can feel him. And he's tired, girl. So very tired.

vey/hes_holding_it_up_21f44ae3.speaker: vey
vey/hes_holding_it_up_21f44ae3.text: He's holding it up with the shard! Cut the line, girl! Get to Malrik!

vey/hes_not_afraid_of_523ee18b.speaker: vey
vey/hes_not_afraid_of_523ee18b.text: He's not afraid of it. Most grown men are.

vey/hes_out_dont_feed_fa585486.speaker: vey
vey/hes_out_dont_feed_fa585486.text: He's out! Don't feed him: whatever dies near him, he eats. Fight from range!

vey/his_lent_to_me_d88f7ea0.speaker: vey
vey/his_lent_to_me_d88f7ea0.text: His. Lent to me to keep you four alive. Now it goes home.

vey/i_felled_a_mountain_227f8c5f.speaker: vey
vey/i_felled_a_mountain_227f8c5f.text: I felled a mountain yesterday, girl. I'll clap.

vey/i_know_those_knives_db6b10ba.speaker: vey
vey/i_know_those_knives_db6b10ba.text: I know those knives. Not in my girl's camp. Not twice.

vey/i_saw_now_build_468ce4c9.speaker: vey
vey/i_saw_now_build_468ce4c9.text: I saw. Now build something to guard it. A beacon on its own is just a target.

vey/i_see_it_first_799aba4f.speaker: vey
vey/i_see_it_first_799aba4f.text: I see it. First time in twenty years. Don't spoil it.

vey/i_stood_behind_his_ee1b3480.speaker: vey
vey/i_stood_behind_his_ee1b3480.text: I stood behind his throne when kings still knelt to it.

vey/ill_ride_the_north_81a39f19.speaker: vey
vey/ill_ride_the_north_81a39f19.text: I'll ride the north road and see what Torvald brought. Light the beacon when you want the storm.

vey/ill_ride_to_emberfall_1ffd60eb.speaker: vey
vey/ill_ride_to_emberfall_1ffd60eb.text: I'll ride to Emberfall and find the old stair. Pay the hunters, then call me.

vey/it_does_not_count_4e1be036.speaker: vey
vey/it_does_not_count_4e1be036.text: It does not count as a tie.

vey/its_his_storm_not_dd511696.speaker: vey
vey/its_his_storm_not_dd511696.text: It's his storm, not mine. He lent it to me to keep you four alive.

vey/just_catching_my_breath_57416c1f.speaker: vey
vey/just_catching_my_breath_57416c1f.text: Just catching my breath. Keep lighting!

vey/just_resting_my_knees_d19fc930.speaker: vey
vey/just_resting_my_knees_d19fc930.text: Just resting my knees. Keep turning that key!

vey/keep_your_helpers_close_4d9d5426.speaker: vey
vey/keep_your_helpers_close_4d9d5426.text: Keep your helpers close! If one of them's away, the pulse breaks the turn!

vey/kindle_it_again_girl_7cf9b0b2.speaker: vey
vey/kindle_it_again_girl_7cf9b0b2.text: Kindle it again, girl. The relics are stronger than his pebble. If you hold them.

vey/last_storm_ive_got_6396a514.speaker: vey
vey/last_storm_ive_got_6396a514.text: Last storm I've got, Bishop. Let's see what you've got.

vey/leave_the_boars_their_e8e9beab.speaker: vey
vey/leave_the_boars_their_e8e9beab.text: Leave the boars their hill and they'll leave you yours. Take the beacon, not the fight.

vey/lightning_bishop_since_befor_97e2dd4.speaker: vey
vey/lightning_bishop_since_befor_97e2dd4.text: Lightning, Bishop. Since before you were born. Off the hill.

vey/mind_the_seventh_step_e39996fe.speaker: vey
vey/mind_the_seventh_step_e39996fe.text: Mind the seventh step. It bites.

vey/no_knives_at_our_373a8a0e.speaker: vey
vey/no_knives_at_our_373a8a0e.text: No knives at our backs tonight. Hush is still licking her wounds. Good.

vey/not_bad_girl_remember_074526d1.speaker: vey
vey/not_bad_girl_remember_074526d1.text: Not bad, girl. Remember it: the spark first. Then the storm.

vey/not_quite_the_greywater_5a1019db.speaker: vey
vey/not_quite_the_greywater_5a1019db.text: Not quite. The Greywater Lodge has mapped the deep for a hundred years.

vey/not_the_floor_under_fd27c446.speaker: vey
vey/not_the_floor_under_fd27c446.text: Not the floor. Under it. The old Warden roads run down there.

vey/obrens_wardens_they_guarded_84edb443.speaker: vey
vey/obrens_wardens_they_guarded_84edb443.text: Obren's Wardens. They guarded this door before he turned. Now they guard nothing.

vey/off_my_hill_well_545b1a48.speaker: vey
vey/off_my_hill_well_545b1a48.text: Off my hill. Well. Your hill. For now.

vey/older_than_the_kingdom_9d294cbd.speaker: vey
vey/older_than_the_kingdom_9d294cbd.text: Older than the kingdom. He sealed it the day he took the throne.

vey/one_gate_less_build_ebfc7ced.speaker: vey
vey/one_gate_less_build_ebfc7ced.text: One gate less. Build something on the rubble. He'd hate that.

vey/renegades_on_the_shadow_998fb941.speaker: vey
vey/renegades_on_the_shadow_998fb941.text: Renegades on the Shadow side! Whoever's nearest, lend the Bishop a blade.

vey/six_stakes_one_line_fd9aca9a.speaker: vey
vey/six_stakes_one_line_fd9aca9a.text: Six stakes, one line. The Hollow can't feed on this bank. Don't hand it the other one.

vey/so_you_do_point_b04c4a82.speaker: vey
vey/so_you_do_point_b04c4a82.text: So you do. Point it at the big statue, and try not to name it.

vey/stand_close_and_hold_ae5b6547.speaker: vey
vey/stand_close_and_hold_ae5b6547.text: Stand close and hold still. Fire comes when you stop chasing it.

vey/stay_behind_my_sword_686025ff.speaker: vey
vey/stay_behind_my_sword_686025ff.text: Stay behind my sword, girl. Knives hate a long reach.

vey/stay_close_girl_whatever_28b0bbfa.speaker: vey
vey/stay_close_girl_whatever_28b0bbfa.text: Stay close, girl. Whatever it throws at you, I'll ground it.

vey/stay_close_to_the_278dca0e.speaker: vey
vey/stay_close_to_the_278dca0e.text: Stay close to the light, girl. Down here the dark has teeth.

vey/stop_feeding_it_fight_9fd7252a.speaker: vey
vey/stop_feeding_it_fight_9fd7252a.text: Stop feeding it! Fight smart, or fight later. Later is worse.

vey/sunfoots_burning_back_to_9133059e.speaker: vey
vey/sunfoots_burning_back_to_9133059e.text: Sunfoot's burning! Back to the stair, girl, now!

vey/sunstones_he_set_them_9039deca.speaker: vey
vey/sunstones_he_set_them_9039deca.text: Sunstones. He set them for the Wardens, so they'd always see him coming home.

vey/thats_enough_my_storm_09504456.speaker: vey
vey/thats_enough_my_storm_09504456.text: That's enough. My storm is borrowed, and I've spent the loan.

vey/thats_what_waiting_buys_b3a538dc.speaker: vey
vey/thats_what_waiting_buys_b3a538dc.text: That's what waiting buys you, girl. Lightning, on time.

vey/the_pylons_down_now_5f25075b.speaker: vey
vey/the_pylons_down_now_5f25075b.text: The pylon's down! Now the Hollow knows your key is coming. Hold the ring!

vey/the_spark_first_girl_92374f56.speaker: vey
vey/the_spark_first_girl_92374f56.text: The spark first, girl. Then the storm.

vey/the_spark_first_then_4ed91055.speaker: vey
vey/the_spark_first_then_4ed91055.text: The spark first. Then the storm!

vey/the_spark_first_then_ced7e7e8.speaker: vey
vey/the_spark_first_then_ced7e7e8.text: The spark first, then the storm. Today the spark waits. I'll be below, talking to the sky.

vey/the_spark_was_yours_eb5573d9.speaker: vey
vey/the_spark_was_yours_eb5573d9.text: The spark was yours, Vessa. NOW the storm!

vey/then_we_go_and_457fc907.speaker: vey
vey/then_we_go_and_457fc907.text: Then we go and ask him. He asked for all four of you. Especially Malrik.

vey/there_he_is_took_b9aac373.speaker: vey
vey/there_he_is_took_b9aac373.text: There he is. Took his time.

vey/they_sell_that_map_61cf27c2.speaker: vey
vey/they_sell_that_map_61cf27c2.text: They sell that map to nobody.

vey/theyre_throwing_everything_a_428dbc7.speaker: vey
vey/theyre_throwing_everything_a_428dbc7.text: They're throwing everything at the forge. Hold the light, and they break on it.

vey/thieves_and_a_toll_e8839ce7.speaker: vey
vey/thieves_and_a_toll_e8839ce7.text: Thieves AND a toll? Girl, you do know how to throw a party.

vey/thirty_girl_count_with_e6ab44f0.speaker: vey
vey/thirty_girl_count_with_e6ab44f0.text: Thirty, girl. Count with me. One...

vey/those_were_obrens_woken_c47618a0.speaker: vey
vey/those_were_obrens_woken_c47618a0.text: Those were Obren's, woken by Obren. These are the Master's. They know whose storm I carry.

vey/three_and_the_one_0b4a0288.speaker: vey
vey/three_and_the_one_0b4a0288.text: Three. And the one who's always late on purpose.

vey/two_crafts_mastered_good_d0766f84.speaker: vey
vey/two_crafts_mastered_good_d0766f84.text: Two crafts mastered. Good. The gate won't open for a fool. Or so he told me.

vey/two_more_hours_girl_37d4d925.speaker: vey
vey/two_more_hours_girl_37d4d925.text: Two more hours, girl. Dawn always comes. It's the one thing it's good at.

vey/up_old_friend_your_5797117b.speaker: vey
vey/up_old_friend_your_5797117b.text: Up, old friend. Your master's walking again. Well. His sword is.

vey/vessa_a_spark_that_5c341e9e.speaker: vey
vey/vessa_a_spark_that_5c341e9e.text: Vessa! A spark that runs off alone goes out. Wait for your soldiers.

vey/wardens_doors_things_that_5710ed13.speaker: vey
vey/wardens_doors_things_that_5710ed13.text: Wardens. Doors. Things that hold. He was always better at holding than letting go.

vey/watch_the_chains_when_ec5bffc6.speaker: vey
vey/watch_the_chains_when_ec5bffc6.text: Watch the chains! When all four pull, he's bound. That's your window.

vey/we_are_today_girl_582fb19a.speaker: vey
vey/we_are_today_girl_582fb19a.text: We are today, girl. Today the ridge is his.

vey/well_look_at_the_6f3e1ec0.speaker: vey
vey/well_look_at_the_6f3e1ec0.text: Well. Look at the four of you. Thirty years I waited to see this, and it's ugly. I love it.

vey/you_called_twice_in_a26e3dc2.speaker: vey
vey/you_called_twice_in_a26e3dc2.text: You called twice in two days. I'll start to think you missed me.

vey/you_gave_two_away_5dddc29d.speaker: vey
vey/you_gave_two_away_5dddc29d.text: You gave two away. Without a fight. Are you ill, girl?

vey/you_heard_her_no_441b26d4.speaker: vey
vey/you_heard_her_no_441b26d4.text: You heard her. No problem at all.

vey/your_helpers_down_bring_319e9030.speaker: vey
vey/your_helpers_down_bring_319e9030.text: Your helper's down! Bring them back, or time the turn right after the pulse!

vey/your_keeps_burning_pull_95d6ec1e.speaker: vey
vey/your_keeps_burning_pull_95d6ec1e.text: Your keep's burning! Pull back and hold it, then go again.

vey/youre_getting_stronger_learn_1f9c9a4.speaker: vey
vey/youre_getting_stronger_learn_1f9c9a4.text: You're getting stronger. Learn to step out of trouble before you learn to start it.

whisper/a_hundred_years_in_672f8d08.speaker: whisper
whisper/a_hundred_years_in_672f8d08.text: A hundred years in the dark. I had time to practise my entrance.

whisper/a_thousand_years_he_a7feb6e7.speaker: whisper
whisper/a_thousand_years_he_a7feb6e7.text: A thousand years he held it. A hundred I lay under it. Now I hold everything.

whisper/a_wood_girl_a_5e98d365.speaker: whisper
whisper/a_wood_girl_a_5e98d365.text: A wood-girl, a snowman and a tired old man. I can wait. Stone is patient.

whisper/come_down_old_man_aa8b6ada.speaker: whisper
whisper/come_down_old_man_aa8b6ada.text: Come down, old man. Hold my door yourself. Learn how long a year is in the dark.

whisper/count_it_ice_king_ad07535a.speaker: whisper
whisper/count_it_ice_king_ad07535a.text: Count it, Ice-king. Count all of it. Someone is counting you.

whisper/enough_i_will_walk_879d0ef8.speaker: whisper
whisper/enough_i_will_walk_879d0ef8.text: Enough. I will walk to your little fire and put it out myself.

whisper/enough_of_your_little_913f6586.speaker: whisper
whisper/enough_of_your_little_913f6586.text: Enough of your little ring. I will walk to the weakest of you and sit on it.

whisper/every_one_who_falls_40e92772.speaker: whisper
whisper/every_one_who_falls_40e92772.text: Every one who falls is a step on my stair. Keep climbing for me.

whisper/every_winter_frost_man_1b17492e.speaker: whisper
whisper/every_winter_frost_man_1b17492e.text: Every winter, frost-man. I have nothing left but winters.

whisper/forty_years_he_dug_ee3849b1.speaker: whisper
whisper/forty_years_he_dug_ee3849b1.text: Forty years he dug here. Let me give him a body.

whisper/four_keys_bishop_count_53c24547.speaker: whisper
whisper/four_keys_bishop_count_53c24547.text: Four keys, Bishop. Count them in your sleep.

whisper/four_of_you_four_d9e2e8e5.speaker: whisper
whisper/four_of_you_four_d9e2e8e5.text: Four of you. FOUR. I only needed one to come close. You brought me a feast.

whisper/half_yours_half_mine_c5f6dc26.speaker: whisper
whisper/half_yours_half_mine_c5f6dc26.text: Half yours, half mine. We share so nicely, you and I.

whisper/hear_me_bishop_no_da4683fb.speaker: whisper
whisper/hear_me_bishop_no_da4683fb.text: Hear me, Bishop. No more whispers. Every battle you fought, I drank.

whisper/his_light_his_through_d1c51ba4.speaker: whisper
whisper/his_light_his_through_d1c51ba4.text: His light? HIS? Through MY throne? You'll break it! You'll break everything!

whisper/his_storm_impossible_that_28b979.speaker: whisper
whisper/his_storm_impossible_that_28b979.text: His storm? Impossible! That light should have faded a hundred years ago!

whisper/i_only_wanted_to_9bc58f51.speaker: whisper
whisper/i_only_wanted_to_9bc58f51.text: I only wanted... to build something that would last.

whisper/keep_me_bishop_i_5f461d11.speaker: whisper
whisper/keep_me_bishop_i_5f461d11.text: Keep me, Bishop. I made you strong.

whisper/keep_your_gate_then_8438d53a.speaker: whisper
whisper/keep_your_gate_then_8438d53a.text: Keep your gate, then. I will come up through your floor.

whisper/let_me_do_more_ecefa255.speaker: whisper
whisper/let_me_do_more_ecefa255.text: Let me do more than beat, Bishop. Let me help.

whisper/little_ember_you_came_b9b62049.speaker: whisper
whisper/little_ember_you_came_b9b62049.text: Little ember. You came alone. You always come alone.

whisper/master_you_came_yourself_4383fff.speaker: whisper
whisper/master_you_came_yourself_4383fff.text: Master. You came yourself. I am honoured. Kneel a little longer.

whisper/mine_hold_still_let_e4f6c8cf.speaker: whisper
whisper/mine_hold_still_let_e4f6c8cf.text: MINE. Hold still. Let me look out of your eyes.

whisper/more_bishop_the_sea_d6a69600.speaker: whisper
whisper/more_bishop_the_sea_d6a69600.text: More, Bishop. The sea is generous tonight.

whisper/my_door_is_open_cf36dc30.speaker: whisper
whisper/my_door_is_open_cf36dc30.text: My door is open, Queen of Fire. Come and close it. You know you want to.

whisper/not_once_not_once_5bde3fd9.speaker: whisper
whisper/not_once_not_once_5bde3fd9.text: Not once? Not ONCE? ...What ARE you?

whisper/not_sell_lend_you_9f118719.speaker: whisper
whisper/not_sell_lend_you_9f118719.text: Not sell. Lend. You will hardly notice the price.

whisper/one_chain_gone_one_7a74ab0b.speaker: whisper
whisper/one_chain_gone_one_7a74ab0b.text: One chain gone. One limb free. Feel how much stronger I am already?

whisper/pull_little_keys_pull_cba8408e.speaker: whisper
whisper/pull_little_keys_pull_cba8408e.text: Pull, little keys. Pull all you like. Chains are stone, and stone is mine.

whisper/so_much_green_bishop_f81412c3.speaker: whisper
whisper/so_much_green_bishop_f81412c3.text: So much green, Bishop. Let it grow red. I can help.

whisper/stay_in_your_garden_f1aedc6d.speaker: whisper
whisper/stay_in_your_garden_f1aedc6d.text: Stay in your garden, gardener. You were always so good at it.

whisper/step_aside_little_king_efd266e2.speaker: whisper
whisper/step_aside_little_king_efd266e2.text: Step aside, little king of snow. I built stairs before your mountains had names.

whisper/thank_you_for_opening_c7fad537.speaker: whisper
whisper/thank_you_for_opening_c7fad537.text: Thank you for opening the door, frost-man.

whisper/that_is_my_key_347b7719.speaker: whisper
whisper/that_is_my_key_347b7719.text: That is my key, frost-man. I made the lock. Give it back.

whisper/the_flag_falls_the_ebc91e55.speaker: whisper
whisper/the_flag_falls_the_ebc91e55.text: The flag falls. The tree is right there. Take it. TAKE it.

whisper/the_green_one_keeps_68e0da4a.speaker: whisper
whisper/the_green_one_keeps_68e0da4a.text: The green one keeps a tree, Bishop. A golden tree. HIS tree. Take it.

whisper/the_ice_cracks_torvald_13046c8c.speaker: whisper
whisper/the_ice_cracks_torvald_13046c8c.text: The ice cracks, Torvald. Even yours. Especially yours.

whisper/the_line_is_broken_efed5729.speaker: whisper
whisper/the_line_is_broken_efed5729.text: The line is broken. Feed me, little ember. Feed me everything.

whisper/the_third_one_sleeps_0896192f.speaker: whisper
whisper/the_third_one_sleeps_0896192f.text: The third one sleeps in the old tree. Wake it before he does.

whisper/the_third_sleeps_in_a8852455.speaker: whisper
whisper/the_third_sleeps_in_a8852455.text: The third sleeps in the old tree. Bring them together, and you'll never need a friend again.

whisper/there_doesnt_that_feel_2254b54d.speaker: whisper
whisper/there_doesnt_that_feel_2254b54d.text: There. Doesn't that feel like enough? It never is. Again.

whisper/there_it_is_his_1d1a6f26.speaker: whisper
whisper/there_it_is_his_1d1a6f26.text: There it is. His tree. Burn it, and he feels it in the deep.

whisper/there_was_that_so_e2d226b3.speaker: whisper
whisper/there_was_that_so_e2d226b3.text: There. Was that so hard? Again, whenever you like.

whisper/they_are_mine_now_4646b8ba.speaker: whisper
whisper/they_are_mine_now_4646b8ba.text: They are mine now, Bishop. Ask me nicely, and they kneel.

whisper/they_are_yours_bishop_435db985.speaker: whisper
whisper/they_are_yours_bishop_435db985.text: They are yours, Bishop. Take them back. Use me. Just a little.

whisper/this_body_cracks_no_d01072ed.speaker: whisper
whisper/this_body_cracks_no_d01072ed.text: This body... cracks... No matter. Stone is patient.

whisper/three_thank_you_little_e9a06c0c.speaker: whisper
whisper/three_thank_you_little_e9a06c0c.text: Three. Thank you, little ember. I'll take it from here.

whisper/too_slow_all_of_c2385cae.speaker: whisper
whisper/too_slow_all_of_c2385cae.text: Too slow, all of you. I'm already climbing.

whisper/torvald_old_frost_you_15088ea0.speaker: whisper
whisper/torvald_old_frost_you_15088ea0.text: Torvald. Old frost. You feel it too. Join us, and nothing will ever melt.

whisper/two_chains_two_limbs_0b524f5f.speaker: whisper
whisper/two_chains_two_limbs_0b524f5f.text: Two chains, two limbs. I'm free. I was always going to be free.

whisper/use_me_and_he_abd60584.speaker: whisper
whisper/use_me_and_he_abd60584.text: Use me, and he will stand up and answer you. One question. Any question.

whisper/wake_my_jailer_the_655df615.speaker: whisper
whisper/wake_my_jailer_the_655df615.text: Wake, my jailer. The door was always mine to open.

whisper/wake_my_masons_the_a7733422.speaker: whisper
whisper/wake_my_masons_the_a7733422.text: Wake, my masons. The Bishop's hand carries my heart. Obey it.

whisper/yes_bishop_a_whole_f519d99c.speaker: whisper
whisper/yes_bishop_a_whole_f519d99c.text: Yes, Bishop. A whole sea of them. Feed me, and I will crown you king of the deep.

whisper/yes_closer_hungry_fire_1bacb26d.speaker: whisper
whisper/yes_closer_hungry_fire_1bacb26d.text: Yes. Closer. Hungry fire feeds me best.

whisper/yes_come_both_of_b42e2981.speaker: whisper
whisper/yes_come_both_of_b42e2981.text: Yes. Come, both of you. Fight on my roof.

whisper/yes_fight_every_fallen_4ee563a9.speaker: whisper
whisper/yes_fight_every_fallen_4ee563a9.text: Yes. Fight. Every fallen soldier is a step on my stair.

whisper/you_came_down_yourself_dc2300d9.speaker: whisper
whisper/you_came_down_yourself_dc2300d9.text: You came down yourself. I knew you would.

whisper/you_fed_me_bishop_b5a978d5.speaker: whisper
whisper/you_fed_me_bishop_b5a978d5.text: You fed me, Bishop. Every time you used me, I grew. Thank you.

whisper/you_opened_my_door_ceb98175.speaker: whisper
whisper/you_opened_my_door_ceb98175.text: You opened my door with your own hands. Thank you. Now I come up.

whisper/you_will_use_me_12b4efda.speaker: whisper
whisper/you_will_use_me_12b4efda.text: You will use me at the end. Everyone does. Your Master did.

whisper/your_father_dug_these_207a3691.speaker: whisper
whisper/your_father_dug_these_207a3691.text: Your father dug these graves, Bishop. Shall I show you what I built from his work?

ysolde/a_horns_down_the_3e3c2fd1.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/a_horns_down_the_3e3c2fd1.text: A horn's down. The other one will have to sing for both.

ysolde/a_seed_doesnt_wait_df9c1b3b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/a_seed_doesnt_wait_df9c1b3b.text: A seed doesn't wait for the war to end, Maelis. Neither do I.

ysolde/a_tall_man_with_160c2abd.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/a_tall_man_with_160c2abd.text: A tall man with a burning hem found me coaxing a sapling through the frost.

ysolde/after_that_for_twenty_ae2e7615.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/after_that_for_twenty_ae2e7615.text: After that, for twenty years, he brought me dead things. A frozen rose. A burnt branch.

ysolde/and_something_down_there_7272d91c.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/and_something_down_there_7272d91c.text: And something down there is still fighting him. I feel it through the roots.

ysolde/because_you_froze_the_2785cd13.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/because_you_froze_the_2785cd13.text: Because you froze the spring, Torvald. Somebody has to go and get it.

ysolde/burn_it_then_it_24aeed9b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/burn_it_then_it_24aeed9b.text: Burn it, then. It grows back. That's the one thing I've always known.

ysolde/but_when_your_war_2ad722b8.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/but_when_your_war_2ad722b8.text: But when your war comes for my wood, and it will, remember that I warned you both.

ysolde/colossi_tall_slow_and_5fc8c258.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/colossi_tall_slow_and_5fc8c258.text: Colossi. Tall, slow, and stubborn. So are we.

ysolde/cover_the_gardens_sit_8cbe1734.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/cover_the_gardens_sit_8cbe1734.text: Cover the gardens! Sit on them if you have to!

ysolde/dont_fight_them_all_4358f09e.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/dont_fight_them_all_4358f09e.text: Don't fight them all on your own. Leave me a few.

ysolde/every_road_behind_me_453c563f.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/every_road_behind_me_453c563f.text: Every road behind me is open. I didn't close a single one.

ysolde/every_root_on_this_a33e3782.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/every_root_on_this_a33e3782.text: Every root on this hill knows your name now. That is not a kindness.

ysolde/every_time_he_said_605d6ece.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/every_time_he_said_605d6ece.text: Every time, he said the same thing.

ysolde/everyone_every_last_one_6e0e35ee.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/everyone_every_last_one_6e0e35ee.text: Everyone. Every last one. Now we only have to keep them.

ysolde/everyone_who_ever_wanted_85618bda.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/everyone_who_ever_wanted_85618bda.text: Everyone who ever wanted this tree said "only".

ysolde/fire_and_shadow_burning_c74f3969.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/fire_and_shadow_burning_c74f3969.text: Fire and Shadow, burning my wood for a trinket. I will remember you both.

ysolde/five_glades_still_remember_284e50.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/five_glades_still_remember_284e50.text: Five glades still remember being green. Break the rime, plant, and keep them warm.

ysolde/grow_slowly_if_you_acaa237a.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/grow_slowly_if_you_acaa237a.text: Grow. Slowly, if you must. Just grow.

ysolde/he_called_me_his_2d19ade1.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/he_called_me_his_2d19ade1.text: He called me his heart. A heart is the part that keeps going when the rest stops.

ysolde/he_gave_me_the_25e8e083.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/he_gave_me_the_25e8e083.text: He gave me the west and told me to keep it growing. Nothing that grows stays beaten.

ysolde/he_said_i_would_59f7425d.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/he_said_i_would_59f7425d.text: He said I would not take a side, not even while the world burned.

ysolde/he_said_show_me_79d79140.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/he_said_show_me_79d79140.text: He said: show me again. So I did, for twenty years, until he was gone.

ysolde/he_was_right_for_c69219bc.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/he_was_right_for_c69219bc.text: He was right. For far too long.

ysolde/hes_bending_everyone_everyth_9576.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/hes_bending_everyone_everyth_9576.text: He's bending! Everyone, everything you have!

ysolde/hold_them_all_of_b1cf3e88.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/hold_them_all_of_b1cf3e88.text: Hold them. All of them. Just a little longer.

ysolde/i_am_not_staying_1093dd82.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_am_not_staying_1093dd82.text: I am not staying. You knew that before I did.

ysolde/i_didnt_need_to_feabfd2b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_didnt_need_to_feabfd2b.text: I didn't need to. It came up green.

ysolde/i_grew_these_walls_3eff56ad.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_grew_these_walls_3eff56ad.text: I grew these walls to keep the war out. They did. They kept everything out.

ysolde/i_knelt_in_the_143cbc56.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_knelt_in_the_143cbc56.text: I knelt in the black, and I waited. Something green came up. It always does.

ysolde/i_promised_not_to_0a099167.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_promised_not_to_0a099167.text: I promised not to. So did someone else.

ysolde/i_warned_you_you_111da083.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_warned_you_you_111da083.text: I warned you. You didn't listen. Neither did he.

ysolde/i_was_born_on_fbe13b97.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_was_born_on_fbe13b97.text: I was born on that hill, the year nothing grew. Not one blade of grass.

ysolde/im_cheering_for_the_d90e344d.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/im_cheering_for_the_d90e344d.text: I'm cheering for the grass. Nobody ever cheers for the grass.

ysolde/im_sorry_i_couldnt_9e4c9f72.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/im_sorry_i_couldnt_9e4c9f72.text: I'm sorry... I couldn't keep them warm.

ysolde/in_spring_it_came_67120205.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/in_spring_it_came_67120205.text: In spring it came up green. I have never forgotten how that felt.

ysolde/it_grew_back_they_91b0cdef.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/it_grew_back_they_91b0cdef.text: It grew back. They always do.

ysolde/it_grows_back_it_180289f4.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/it_grows_back_it_180289f4.text: It grows back... it has to...

ysolde/it_wants_to_grow_ecad2a19.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/it_wants_to_grow_ecad2a19.text: It wants to grow. It only needs someone to wait with it.

ysolde/ive_left_the_garden_df87c318.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/ive_left_the_garden_df87c318.text: I've left the garden. Show me again, Master. I'm showing you.

ysolde/keep_it_until_the_fa0a0b05.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/keep_it_until_the_fa0a0b05.text: Keep it until the wood can.

ysolde/keep_them_under_the_b86fb013.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/keep_them_under_the_b86fb013.text: Keep them... under the tree... Maelis...

ysolde/knives_in_the_oak_2f63bd67.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/knives_in_the_oak_2f63bd67.text: Knives in the oak! Down, everyone down! Thornlings, into the ferns!

ysolde/last_winter_they_burned_e017cf01.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/last_winter_they_burned_e017cf01.text: Last winter they burned my wood and froze the ashes. My army with it.

ysolde/let_him_something_always_54b2f0e4.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/let_him_something_always_54b2f0e4.text: Let him. Something always grows back. It will not stop.

ysolde/let_him_want_it_654d363b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/let_him_want_it_654d363b.text: Let him want it. A ford is water and stones. Those farms are families.

ysolde/let_them_come_cut_d956830a.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/let_them_come_cut_d956830a.text: Let them come. Cut it. Burn it. Freeze it.

ysolde/let_them_have_the_3a7880a2.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/let_them_have_the_3a7880a2.text: Let them have the water. Everyone to the foot of the hill. Nobody passes the tree.

ysolde/maelis_the_heartwood_stands_04e41.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/maelis_the_heartwood_stands_04e41.text: Maelis! The Heartwood stands tall enough. Come home.

ysolde/maelis_the_horns_every_9752aa32.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/maelis_the_horns_every_9752aa32.text: Maelis, the horns. Every farm in the valley comes up this hill before dark.

ysolde/malrik_every_grave_you_1b830347.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/malrik_every_grave_you_1b830347.text: Malrik! Every grave you dig, I will plant over. Every single one!

ysolde/malrik_stands_up_there_5121c046.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/malrik_stands_up_there_5121c046.text: Malrik stands up there with his candle, his stone, and Torvald's winter.

ysolde/malrik_tells_his_life_52243579.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/malrik_tells_his_life_52243579.text: Malrik tells his life as a list of wounds. Mine is a list of winters.

ysolde/malrik_told_him_the_8409bb82.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/malrik_told_him_the_8409bb82.text: Malrik told him the Hollow is waking. He's right. I hear it under the roots.

ysolde/malrik_you_burned_my_54c71dfd.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/malrik_you_burned_my_54c71dfd.text: Malrik. You burned my people. You will not have their seed.

ysolde/master_you_cant_go_02532e37.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/master_you_cant_go_02532e37.text: Master. You can't go down there.

ysolde/mother_hush_so_thats_987bbd48.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/mother_hush_so_thats_987bbd48.text: Mother Hush. So that's where she went.

ysolde/my_mother_buried_seed_b7d7b32b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/my_mother_buried_seed_b7d7b32b.text: My mother buried seed in the snow. The village laughed. I watched it sleep.

ysolde/my_mother_did_it_0ba5df24.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/my_mother_did_it_0ba5df24.text: My mother did it. In spring it came up green. Help me keep the wolves off.

ysolde/my_wood_tries_to_b8352a5f.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/my_wood_tries_to_b8352a5f.text: My wood tries to eat everyone. It's very fair.

ysolde/nature_marches_out_again_5723976e.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/nature_marches_out_again_5723976e.text: Nature marches out. Again. It's getting easier.

ysolde/nature_too_win_it_01e88876.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/nature_too_win_it_01e88876.text: Nature too. Win it or lose it without us.

ysolde/natures_key_is_home_5e2e1874.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/natures_key_is_home_5e2e1874.text: Nature's key is home. The roots are holding it.

ysolde/no_keep_moving_we_43181b5e.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/no_keep_moving_we_43181b5e.text: No... Keep moving. We grieve at the border. Not here.

ysolde/no_no_no_ill_016019a5.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/no_no_no_ill_016019a5.text: No. No, no. I'll plant it again. Next year. I will.

ysolde/no_torvald_malrik_made_ac109781.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/no_torvald_malrik_made_ac109781.text: No, Torvald. Malrik made you choose. I'm only here to hear the answer.

ysolde/nobody_burns_while_i_98fc583f.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/nobody_burns_while_i_98fc583f.text: Nobody burns while I watch. Not any more. Go home, Pipwell. Grow it back.

ysolde/not_you_vessa_not_0c277871.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/not_you_vessa_not_0c277871.text: Not you, Vessa. Not Malrik. Not ever.

ysolde/obren_the_first_apprentice_183e09.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/obren_the_first_apprentice_183e09.text: Obren. The first apprentice. Every battle over the relics feeds him.

ysolde/one_down_it_felt_edf94878.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/one_down_it_felt_edf94878.text: One down. It felt like pulling out my own hair. Two more.

ysolde/one_road_the_fire_ce27b24b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/one_road_the_fire_ce27b24b.text: One road, the Fire border at the end of it, and everyone we kept alive. We walk them there.

ysolde/point_and_i_will_b24221fa.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/point_and_i_will_b24221fa.text: Point, and I will go. I am done waiting for wars to pass my wood by.

ysolde/put_three_together_near_fc54bb92.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/put_three_together_near_fc54bb92.text: Put three together near the Hollow and the door opens.

ysolde/see_it_fights_back_cbf09b8a.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/see_it_fights_back_cbf09b8a.text: See? It fights back. Things that grow always fight back.

ysolde/several_theyre_very_patient_75bfd.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/several_theyre_very_patient_75bfd.text: Several. They're very patient, and they hit like a landslide.

ysolde/she_waited_i_watched_f9ba8365.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/she_waited_i_watched_f9ba8365.text: She waited. I watched her do it. I may need to sit down.

ysolde/sheep_come_back_in_abf7e67b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/sheep_come_back_in_abf7e67b.text: Sheep come back in spring, Malrik. So do I.

ysolde/should_we_send_for_1da7315a.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/should_we_send_for_1da7315a.text: Should we send for Vessa and Malrik?

ysolde/stay_on_the_road_33dfeb19.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/stay_on_the_road_33dfeb19.text: Stay on the road. If anything moves in the trees, stop, and let the thorns go first.

ysolde/stop_both_of_you_3ddd216b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/stop_both_of_you_3ddd216b.text: Stop, both of you! You don't know what you're opening!

ysolde/thank_her_for_me_3e918c30.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/thank_her_for_me_3e918c30.text: Thank her for me. And tell her I'm not staying.

ysolde/that_gate_is_closed_7bd3087a.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/that_gate_is_closed_7bd3087a.text: That gate is closed. Roots don't forget.

ysolde/that_is_my_strength_7a8a1ecc.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/that_is_my_strength_7a8a1ecc.text: That is my strength. I come back. Every spring. Every time.

ysolde/that_water_is_older_115ce9a6.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/that_water_is_older_115ce9a6.text: That water is older than all four of us. Get out of it.

ysolde/the_east_seal_is_8134f5f3.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_east_seal_is_8134f5f3.text: The east seal is mine. Hold the west, Vessa. We have done this before.

ysolde/the_ford_is_his_7cd92c30.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_ford_is_his_7cd92c30.text: The ford is his. The hill is ours, and every family on it, and the tree.

ysolde/the_fords_gone_fall_81b233fd.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_fords_gone_fall_81b233fd.text: The ford's gone. Fall back to the stones and the standards. Nobody runs.

ysolde/the_heartwood_stands_tall_c352411.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_heartwood_stands_tall_c352411.text: The Heartwood stands tall again. Let the elders come.

ysolde/the_last_heartwood_you_30bed613.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_last_heartwood_you_30bed613.text: The Last Heartwood. You held on all winter, didn't you?

ysolde/the_last_root_my_69d9572e.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_last_root_my_69d9572e.text: The last root. My first wall. Goodbye.

ysolde/the_line_is_cut_c1ceb75a.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_line_is_cut_c1ceb75a.text: The line is cut! Now, before he crawls back!

ysolde/the_master_planted_this_049c4f15.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_master_planted_this_049c4f15.text: The Master planted this country with his own hands. He left it to me to keep.

ysolde/the_roots_are_cut_db452fb8.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_roots_are_cut_db452fb8.text: The roots are cut. All of them. I am sorry, Vessa.

ysolde/the_signet_is_home_66a1bdd6.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_signet_is_home_66a1bdd6.text: The Signet is home. I'm still out here. Who's next?

ysolde/the_signets_warm_its_38863c73.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_signets_warm_its_38863c73.text: The Signet's warm. It's pointing at the others. Let's not keep them waiting.

ysolde/the_wall_of_a_d3b09447.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_wall_of_a_d3b09447.text: The Wall of a Hundred Winters. While it stands, this war never has to stop for weather.

ysolde/the_wood_can_now_4bb9579d.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_wood_can_now_4bb9579d.text: The wood can, now. Thank you, Vessa.

ysolde/the_wood_cant_fight_317f2f0d.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_wood_cant_fight_317f2f0d.text: The wood can't fight this winter. I can.

ysolde/then_ill_teach_them_af88fa3b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_ill_teach_them_af88fa3b.text: Then I'll teach them a second word. It's a short one. Open.

ysolde/then_it_can_wait_b2ba48cf.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_it_can_wait_b2ba48cf.text: Then it can wait forever. Maelis, stay with the people.

ysolde/then_it_is_waiting_97d4b152.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_it_is_waiting_97d4b152.text: Then it is waiting for someone.

ysolde/then_its_enough_we_87dc6ab7.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_its_enough_we_87dc6ab7.text: Then it's enough. We march with Fire.

ysolde/then_the_people_go_b065c387.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_the_people_go_b065c387.text: Then the people go south today. All of them. The road is safer than this hill.

ysolde/then_they_walk_west_db6c38f4.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_they_walk_west_db6c38f4.text: Then they walk. West, through the old woods, to the Fire border.

ysolde/then_we_each_keep_a74df410.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_we_each_keep_a74df410.text: Then we each keep the other's. Fire and Nature, one front.

ysolde/then_well_be_warmer_b99162c2.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_well_be_warmer_b99162c2.text: Then we'll be warmer than the river.

ysolde/then_why_is_your_07a25391.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_why_is_your_07a25391.text: Then why is your winter standing in them, Torvald?

ysolde/they_broke_it_then_4eacfbef.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/they_broke_it_then_4eacfbef.text: They broke it. Then we plant it again. Roots don't count how often.

ysolde/they_call_me_soft_3535b2b2.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/they_call_me_soft_3535b2b2.text: They call me soft. Neutral. Slow. Slow is how an oak outlives an army.

ysolde/they_cut_it_then_e3d83435.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/they_cut_it_then_e3d83435.text: They cut it. Then we plant it again. That is the whole of my strength.

ysolde/they_have_a_standard_2dff24c4.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/they_have_a_standard_2dff24c4.text: They have a standard. Let them carry it. Banners are light. Hills are not.

ysolde/they_say_i_was_d0d20592.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/they_say_i_was_d0d20592.text: They say I was born the year nothing grew. I won't let there be two.

ysolde/theyre_coming_up_the_2952eb79.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/theyre_coming_up_the_2952eb79.text: They're coming up the ramps. Every keyhole, every side. Hold yours!

ysolde/theyre_in_my_roots_4377dcd9.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/theyre_in_my_roots_4377dcd9.text: They're in my roots! Please. Now, not in a season.

ysolde/theyre_through_ring_it_1cf42fce.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/theyre_through_ring_it_1cf42fce.text: They're through. Ring it again, Wren.

ysolde/this_one_i_can_d1112046.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/this_one_i_can_d1112046.text: This one I can do alone. Keep them off me, and do not set it on fire.

ysolde/those_relics_arent_a_9a6ba2bd.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/those_relics_arent_a_9a6ba2bd.text: Those relics aren't a prize. They're a lock.

ysolde/three_groves_along_your_6f6cb72e.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/three_groves_along_your_6f6cb72e.text: Three groves along your line, Vessa. Give me those, and I can give you a kingdom back.

ysolde/three_groves_enough_roots_ae16316.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/three_groves_enough_roots_ae16316.text: Three groves. Enough roots to stand on. Rise.

ysolde/three_messengers_three_answe_7c3b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/three_messengers_three_answe_7c3b.text: Three messengers, three answers. I could get used to answering.

ysolde/three_stones_in_our_fdd6c9c0.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/three_stones_in_our_fdd6c9c0.text: Three stones in our hands. The land listens to whoever stands on it.

ysolde/too_many_we_were_aed14d1e.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/too_many_we_were_aed14d1e.text: Too many. We were too slow, and the valley is empty.

ysolde/too_slow_i_was_7bd03a88.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/too_slow_i_was_7bd03a88.text: Too slow. I was always too slow for the ones at the border.

ysolde/torvald_didnt_come_for_ec361a15.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/torvald_didnt_come_for_ec361a15.text: Torvald didn't come for my wood. He came for your relics.

ysolde/torvald_froze_the_brook_8abe912d.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/torvald_froze_the_brook_8abe912d.text: Torvald froze the brook. The old folk will slip, and his archers know it.

ysolde/torvald_is_on_my_7b99f0ec.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/torvald_is_on_my_7b99f0ec.text: Torvald is on my bridge with half of winter. I could use some fire.

ysolde/torvald_its_breaking_on_897f7648.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/torvald_its_breaking_on_897f7648.text: Torvald! It's breaking on our side!

ysolde/torvald_you_let_me_afea7b82.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/torvald_you_let_me_afea7b82.text: Torvald. You let me go once, on your wall. I remember. I will not hold back today.

ysolde/twelve_years_ago_he_1f7e8540.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/twelve_years_ago_he_1f7e8540.text: Twelve years ago he sent for me one last time. Torvald too. Only us.

ysolde/two_im_taking_a_64e1878e.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/two_im_taking_a_64e1878e.text: Two. I'm taking a side, Maelis. It's theirs.

ysolde/vessa_hold_the_crest_e7a2fa87.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/vessa_hold_the_crest_e7a2fa87.text: Vessa, hold the crest. Please. Just once, wait.

ysolde/vessa_they_are_all_d7abf168.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/vessa_they_are_all_d7abf168.text: Vessa. They are all inside your wall. Ashby gave away his own blanket.

ysolde/when_the_snow_closes_e54e0821.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/when_the_snow_closes_e54e0821.text: When the snow closes them, the north feeds Malrik's war all winter. Out of reach.

ysolde/you_burned_their_wagons_8bfcf81d.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/you_burned_their_wagons_8bfcf81d.text: You burned their wagons. You don't get their children.

ysolde/you_came_i_always_5d43860d.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/you_came_i_always_5d43860d.text: You came. I always hoped someone would, when it was me.

ysolde/you_came_i_told_5b75d752.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/you_came_i_told_5b75d752.text: You came. I told you to remember. I didn't think you'd listen.

ysolde/you_came_when_i_091e4eda.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/you_came_when_i_091e4eda.text: You came when I called, Vessa. Next time, I come when you do.

ysolde/you_froze_a_grave_7fc47ff1.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/you_froze_a_grave_7fc47ff1.text: You froze a grave, Aldra. I've come to open it.

ysolde/you_know_how_he_efe9f1a1.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/you_know_how_he_efe9f1a1.text: You know how he found me. A girl, a sapling, the frost. That part is easy to tell.

ysolde/you_see_maelis_it_5cc81aed.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/you_see_maelis_it_5cc81aed.text: You see, Maelis? It always comes back.
